items.title: Irã diz que Catar transmitirá resposta dos EUA após conversas sobre propostas, segundo Irna
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Irã discutiu com mediadores do Catar propostas que serão apresentadas aos EUA e espera receber a resposta final de Washington por meio de Doha, afirmou o ministro das Relações Exteriores iraniano, Abbas Araqchi, nesta segunda-feira, segundo a agência de notícias estatal Irna, em meio a um novo esforço para pôr fim à guerra.
items.body:
O Irã discutiu com mediadores do Catar propostas que serão apresentadas aos EUA e espera receber a resposta final de Washington por meio de Doha, afirmou o ministro das Relações Exteriores iraniano, Abbas Araqchi, nesta segunda-feira, segundo a agência de notícias estatal Irna, em meio a um novo esforço para pôr fim à guerra.
Araqchi, falando em Nova York, disse que o Irã também informou aos EUA e à comunidade internacional as condições estabelecidas por seu líder supremo para a reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz, sem entrar em detalhes.
“Se os norte-americanos afirmam que estão buscando um acordo ou uma solução pacífica, nós apresentamos essa solução”, disse Araqchi.

items.title: Retooled Celtics forge into unknown after Jaylen Brown trade
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A week after their president of basketball operations said that breaking up their longtime star duo was "inevitable," the Boston Celtics faced life after Jaylen Brown as they kicked off the preseason at their media day Monday.
items.body:
A week after their president of basketball operations said that breaking up their longtime star duo was "inevitable," the Boston Celtics faced life after Jaylen Brown as they kicked off the preseason at their media day Monday.
Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla began the day by remarking on "an eventful offseason" and thanking Brown, who was traded to the Philadelphia 76ers for Paul George and a collection of draft picks.
"I want to pay my respects to Jaylen and everything he represented for this organization and the community over the last 10 years," Mazzulla said. "Obviously, what he's been able to accomplish has been great, and it's not a one-time thing to where you let go of that. There's obviously a short-term perspective and then a long-term perspective about what he did over the course of his time here, both on and off the court, and that should not be forgotten.
"At the same time, today is the first day of our 2026-27 season, and shifting our focus towards the players and that team and the season that we have."
Brown and Jayson Tatum had been teammates since the Celtics drafted Tatum third overall in 2017. Their nine-year partnership produced one championship (2023-24), another NBA Finals trip (lost to the Warriors in 2022), and an extended run as the cream of the crop in the East.
But after Brown led the Celtics for most of last season while Tatum recovered from Achilles surgery, their tenure together fizzled out in the form of a first-round playoff dismissal at the hands of the 76ers.
Brad Stevens, the head of Boston's front office, said in a SiriusXM interview last week that trying to play through both ball-dominant players wasn't a sustainable long-term path.
"At the end of the day, the biggest thing is that when evaluating how the team played in the past couple of playoffs, we have to build the depth to stay competitive as we can to build for a long, sustainable run; it was inevitable," Stevens said.
"For us, it was a really hard decision. There were a lot of things that went into it. You have two max players, two max usage; those are the things you have to make a decision on. ... Jaylen's a great player, but I like the team we have."
For his part, Tatum spoke highly of Brown in his press availability Monday.
"It's tough, obviously," Tatum said. "I always say, the business of the NBA always comes in and plays a part, always, and I've seen it throughout my 10 years of being in this league. For me, I'm just grateful for what we accomplished and what he meant to this city and this organization. Just the ups and downs in our career that we were able to grow and learn from and that made us the players we are today."
In an Eastern Conference that features the defending champion New York Knicks, the Miami Heat with Giannis Antetokounmpo and the Philadelphia 76ers with Brown and LeBron James joining Joel Embiid and company, the Celtics also move forward as a retooled unit. Tatum, Derrick White and Payton Pritchard will get to work with George, new center Mitchell Robinson and veteran Mike Conley Jr.
"The thing I'm most excited about is the unknown," said Mazzulla, who made clear this summer that he had no input on the decision to trade Brown. "I always get excited about that because there's risk to the unknown and there's also opportunity to the unknown -- what we can become, what we have to go through to get to where we want to get to. I'm inspired and motivated by the unknown more than anything else because I don't know what we can be."
Mazzulla also joked that the Celtics won't be able to foul Robinson anymore, a reference to Boston's strategy of constantly sending Robinson to the line when he played for New York.
In fact, Robinson told reporters that he demanded an apology when Mazzulla visited him in Nashville this summer.
"At first, we had a little issue," Robinson said. "I'm like, ‘You've got to say sorry for fouling me.' If he didn't want to do that, then we would have had some issues. But, he apologized and we're on the same team now, so it's going to be great. Just continuing to build and get to know him as the year goes on."
--Field Level Media

items.title: AstraZeneca to invest $2 billion in Summit Therapeutics for cancer drug tie-up
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Summit Therapeutics said on Monday that British drugmaker AstraZeneca would invest $2 billion in the company and collaborate on a series of studies testing their cancer treatments together.
items.body:
Summit Therapeutics (SMMT.O) said on Monday that British drugmaker AstraZeneca (AZN.L) would invest $2 billion in the company and collaborate on a series of studies testing their cancer treatments together.
Summit's shares rose over 15% in extended trading following the announcement.
Here are some details:
AstraZeneca will buy preferred shares in Summit at an equivalent price of $18.36 per common share, representing an 18.6% premium to Summit's Monday closing price of $15.48.
The investment marks a major vote of confidence in ivonescimab, a next-generation cancer treatment [USN:L4N32W2GR TEXT:"licensed"] by Summit from China's Akeso (9926.HK) .
Ivonescimab works by simultaneously blocking PD-1, which helps cancer evade the immune system, and VEGF, which tumors use to grow blood vessels, helping the immune system better find and attack cancer cells.
As part of the partnership, the two companies will also launch clinical trials combining ivonescimab with AstraZeneca's cancer treatments.
They have also signed a preliminary agreement to explore testing ivonescimab with several other AstraZeneca medicines, including its antibody-drug conjugates, a class of treatments that deliver cancer-killing drugs directly to tumor cells.
The transaction is expected to close by the end of the week.

O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, negou nesta segunda-feira ter oferecido ao Irã alívio das sanções e a liberação de fundos congelados em troca de concessões nucleares por parte de Teerã.
“Isso não é verdade. Eu NÃO lhes ofereci NADA”, escreveu Trump no Truth Social, depois que o Axios havia noticiado mais cedo que o presidente republicano estaria disposto a conceder o alívio em troca de concessões nucleares.

items.title: Juiz impede Trump de vincular verbas para combate ao terrorismo a mudanças eleitorais
items.author: Luc Cohen
items.creator: Luc Cohen
items.summary: Um juiz federal bloqueou, nesta segunda-feira, o governo Trump de condicionar a liberação de verbas para o combate ao terrorismo destinadas a governos estaduais e municipais à implementação de mudanças na administração eleitoral.
items.body:
Um juiz federal bloqueou, nesta segunda-feira, o governo Trump de condicionar a liberação de verbas para o combate ao terrorismo destinadas a governos estaduais e municipais à implementação de mudanças na administração eleitoral.
A decisão do juiz federal Amir Ali, de Washington, marca a mais recente derrota do presidente Donald Trump em sua tentativa de aumentar a autoridade do governo federal sobre as eleições antes das eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro, quando o Partido Republicano luta para manter a maioria nas duas Casas do Congresso.
No início deste ano, o Departamento de Segurança Interna (DHS) anunciou que reteria 20% dos recursos destinados a programas de subsídios relacionados à preparação para ataques terroristas e outras ameaças até que os governos estaduais ou locais adotassem medidas de administração eleitoral defendidas pelo governo.
Em sua decisão nesta segunda-feira, Ali deu razão aos condados e cidades do Texas, Ohio e Tennessee, que entraram com uma ação para bloquear as mudanças, alegando que a imposição de condições para a liberação desses recursos excedia a autoridade da Agência Federal de Gestão de Emergências (Fema). Uma coalizão de Estados governados em sua maioria por democratas entrou com uma ação judicial separada contra a diretriz, que ainda está pendente.
Os programas de subsídios, que totalizam cerca de US$1,1 bilhão, já existem há anos. Nenhum deles foi concebido especificamente com a segurança eleitoral em mente.
“O Congresso não autorizou que o programa de subsídios fosse usado para o tipo de reformas na administração eleitoral que a Fema exige neste caso — mudanças que, sejam elas válidas ou não do ponto de vista político, não são propostas para preparar ou responder a ‘atos de terrorismo’”, escreveu Ali, nomeado pelo presidente democrata Joe Biden.
Nem o DHS nem o Departamento de Justiça (DOJ), que representa o governo federal na Justiça, responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário.
Ao anunciar o plano para condicionar os recursos, o secretário do DHS, Markwayne Mullin, afirmou que os novos requisitos protegeriam os sistemas eleitorais contra interferências estrangeiras e ataques cibernéticos.
O plano exigiria que os beneficiários das verbas utilizassem equipamentos que aceitassem cédulas de papel preenchidas à mão, em vez de sistemas de votação eletrônica, auditassem manualmente pelo menos 5% das cédulas depositadas e comparassem suas listas eleitorais com um banco de dados do DHS para garantir que nenhum não-cidadão estivesse registrado para votar.
Trump há muito tempo faz alegações falsas sobre fraude eleitoral generalizada nas eleições dos EUA, incluindo a eleição presidencial de 2020, na qual foi derrotado.
Estudos e auditorias independentes constataram que a fraude eleitoral é rara.

items.title: 北朝鮮、米の韓国原潜建造承認を批判　「地域の不安定化招く」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２９日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮外務省は、米国が韓国初の原子力潜水艦の建造を承認したことについて、アジア太平洋地域の政治・軍事情勢に新たな不安定要因を加える「危険な動き」だと批判した。国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が声明を伝えた。

同省は、米政府による「急激な核軍備増強」が「国際核秩序の崩壊」を招いたとし、承認は米英豪の安全保障の枠組み「ＡＵＫＵＳ（オーカス）」を通じて核拡散を進める米国の姿勢を改めて示すものだと指摘した。

韓国は北朝鮮による潜水艦発射型の核・ミサイルの脅威に対抗する新たな計画の下、２０３０年代半ばまでに初の原子力潜水艦の進水を目指している。韓国の原潜建造計画は、米韓が昨年結んだ貿易協定の一環で合意された。

＜為替＞ ドルが主要通貨に対しほぼ横ばいで推移した。米国とイランの対立が続く中、原油価格が上昇し、米債利回りが押し上げられた。また市場では、３０日の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数、１０月２日の米雇用統計の発表にも注目が集まる。 

中東紛争の長期化を受けてホルムズ海峡を通過する石油・ガス輸送に障害が生じる中、米国債利回りは５％を上回る数十年ぶりの高水準を維持しているが、ドルの地合いは圧迫されている。

 円は対ドルで１ドル＝１５７．３９円。 財務省の三村淳財務官は２８日、都内でロイターとのインタビューに応じ、円の過小評価は問題とする意向を日米両政府が共有したメッセージは「非常にクリア」との認識を示した。「市場が素直に受け止めてくれればいい」との考えも述べた。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが上昇した。ただ、この日の最高水準からはやや上げ幅を縮小した。中東交渉再開への期待から原油先物が上げ幅を縮小したためで、根強いインフレと米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げを懸念する投資家に一定の安堵（あんど）をもたらした。

この日は一時、３０年債利回りが２００４年５月中旬以来、１０年債利回りは０７年６月中旬以来、２年債利回りは２４年５月以来の高水準を記録する場面があった。

利回り上昇の背景には、トランプ米大統領がホルムズ海峡を巡るイランの提案を拒否したとの報道があった。nL6N45I011

指標となる米１０年債利回りは４．８８ｂｐ上昇の５．２３％で、５営業日連続の上昇となる見通し。午前の取引では５．２７４１％を付けた。

３０年債利回りも同じく５営業日連続の上昇を視野に入れ、５．３６ｂｐ上昇の５．５５５６％。一時５．５８２９％を付けた。

ＦＲＢの金利見通しに連動して動くことが多い２年債利回りは４．９９ｂｐ上昇の４．９１４％。この日は一時４．９５５５％まであった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 反落。原油価格と米債利回りの上昇が相場の重しとなった。投資家は、米国とイランの和平合意を巡る不確実性や、それに伴う米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利の道筋への影響を見極めようとしている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の下落率は８月２０日以来の大きさとなった。

個別銘柄ではボーイングが６．９％急落し、ダウの主な押し下げ要因の一つとなった。米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）が、新たに判明したソフトウエアの問題が解決するまで「７３７ＭＡＸ１０」の認証を遅らせると発表したことを嫌気した。

一方、半導体大手エヌビディアは相場全体に逆行して１．６％上昇。自社株買い枠を１５００億ドル拡大したことが材料視された。nL6N45K0XP

テスラは３．９％安。ＪＰモルガンが第３・四半期の納車台数の低迷を理由に目標株価を引き下げた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 原油価格の上昇によるインフレ懸念や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融引き締め観測が強まり、金相場は７週間ぶりの安値まで下落した。中心限月の清算値（終値に相当）は３．５％安の１オンス＝４１６８．４０ドル。スポット金は一時４１１０．５５ドルまで下落し、午後１時３０分（米東部時間）時点で３．５％安の４１３６．８１ドルとなった。 

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ ホルムズ海峡再開に向けた和平合意を模索し、カタールが米国とイランとの協議を約束したものの、供給途絶の長期化への懸念が根強く、小幅上昇した。米ＷＴＩ先物の清算値は、前週末比０．１９ドル（０．２％）高の１バレル＝９２．６０ドルだった。北海ブレント先物は０．９６ドル（０．９％）高の１０５．２８ドルで清算した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞ ドルが主要通貨に対しほぼ横ばいで推移した。米国とイランの対立が続く中、原油価格が上昇し、米債利回りが押し上げら...
items.body:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（28日）ドル横ばい、利回り上昇も高水準から戻す　株反落
7:01 配信

＜為替＞ ドルが主要通貨に対しほぼ横ばいで推移した。米国とイランの対立が続く中、原油価格が上昇し、米債利回りが押し上げられた。また市場では、３０日の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数、１０月２日の米雇用統計の発表にも注目が集まる。 

中東紛争の長期化を受けてホルムズ海峡を通過する石油・ガス輸送に障害が生じる中、米国債利回りは５％を上回る数十年ぶりの高水準を維持しているが、ドルの地合いは圧迫されている。

 円は対ドルで１ドル＝１５７．３９円。 財務省の三村淳財務官は２８日、都内でロイターとのインタビューに応じ、円の過小評価は問題とする意向を日米両政府が共有したメッセージは「非常にクリア」との認識を示した。「市場が素直に受け止めてくれればいい」との考えも述べた。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが上昇した。ただ、この日の最高水準からはやや上げ幅を縮小した。中東交渉再開への期待から原油先物が上げ幅を縮小したためで、根強いインフレと米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げを懸念する投資家に一定の安堵（あんど）をもたらした。

この日は一時、３０年債利回りが２００４年５月中旬以来、１０年債利回りは０７年６月中旬以来、２年債利回りは２４年５月以来の高水準を記録する場面があった。

利回り上昇の背景には、トランプ米大統領がホルムズ海峡を巡るイランの提案を拒否したとの報道があった。nL6N45I011

指標となる米１０年債利回りは４．８８ｂｐ上昇の５．２３％で、５営業日連続の上昇となる見通し。午前の取引では５．２７４１％を付けた。

３０年債利回りも同じく５営業日連続の上昇を視野に入れ、５．３６ｂｐ上昇の５．５５５６％。一時５．５８２９％を付けた。

ＦＲＢの金利見通しに連動して動くことが多い２年債利回りは４．９９ｂｐ上昇の４．９１４％。この日は一時４．９５５５％まであった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 反落。原油価格と米債利回りの上昇が相場の重しとなった。投資家は、米国とイランの和平合意を巡る不確実性や、それに伴う米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利の道筋への影響を見極めようとしている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の下落率は８月２０日以来の大きさとなった。

個別銘柄ではボーイングが６．９％急落し、ダウの主な押し下げ要因の一つとなった。米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）が、新たに判明したソフトウエアの問題が解決するまで「７３７ＭＡＸ１０」の認証を遅らせると発表したことを嫌気した。

一方、半導体大手エヌビディアは相場全体に逆行して１．６％上昇。自社株買い枠を１５００億ドル拡大したことが材料視された。nL6N45K0XP

テスラは３．９％安。ＪＰモルガンが第３・四半期の納車台数の低迷を理由に目標株価を引き下げた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 原油価格の上昇によるインフレ懸念や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融引き締め観測が強まり、金相場は７週間ぶりの安値まで下落した。中心限月の清算値（終値に相当）は３．５％安の１オンス＝４１６８．４０ドル。スポット金は一時４１１０．５５ドルまで下落し、午後１時３０分（米東部時間）時点で３．５％安の４１３６．８１ドルとなった。 

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ ホルムズ海峡再開に向けた和平合意を模索し、カタールが米国とイランとの協議を約束したものの、供給途絶の長期化への懸念が根強く、小幅上昇した。米ＷＴＩ先物の清算値は、前週末比０．１９ドル（０．２％）高の１バレル＝９２．６０ドルだった。北海ブレント先物は０．９６ドル（０．９％）高の１０５．２８ドルで清算した。

items.title: China risks swinging the tax pendulum too far
items.author: Ka Sing Chan
items.creator: Ka Sing Chan
items.summary: For decades, entrepreneurs quietly parked assets offshore in Hong Kong and beyond. Beijing’s fresh scrutiny of this hoard will raise revenue for the government and reshape stock markets. It also risks crushing animal spirits in a fragile economy.
items.body:
Traditional Chinese wisdom warns against showing off wealth. For decades, the country’s entrepreneurs followed that advice by quietly parking assets offshore in Hong Kong and beyond. Now Beijing looks determined to bring those riches into the tax net to shore up government revenue. But the crackdown also risks crushing animal spirits in a fragile economy.
Although Beijing says its recent actions merely bring existing tax laws into effect and address ambiguities, in practical terms they mark a significant shift in the treatment of overseas assets.
The timing is hardly accidental. Since the property market bubble burst in 2021, local governments have lost roughly 4.5 trillion yuan ($630 billion) of annual land-sale revenue. At the same time, ever larger sums of Chinese wealth have accumulated offshore, creating an obvious potential tax base.
Since May, authorities have fined offshore brokers including Futu (6FHAy.F) , and ordered a wind-down of their mainland clients' accounts, tightened disclosure requirements for overseas banking arrangements, and sharpened oversight of outbound investments. Beijing has also clarified that China’s 20% individual income tax applies to offshore trusts, and tax authorities have begun levying taxes on insurance policy income earned offshore.
Taken together, what unnerves China’s wealthy is not any single measure but the pace of change and the fear it can upend an implicit bargain under which business owners could make money at home and protect it overseas and a potential blurring of the line between tax collection and capital controls.
The campaign comes just as offshore Chinese wealth has reached unprecedented levels. Hong Kong has overtaken Switzerland as the world's largest cross-border wealth hub, with $2.9 trillion under management, about 60% tied to mainland money, according to a Boston Consulting Group report published in April.
Mainland Chinese and Hong Kong investors' holdings of US equities have roughly doubled in five years. HSBC Life, Hong Kong's largest life insurer, collected HK$24 billion from just 1,516 single-premium policies in the first half of this year. The average ticket size of over $2 million reflects strong demand from affluent clients for products often used for succession planning and investment diversification. Meanwhile, China's capital and financial-account deficit, a broad measure of capital outflow, exceeded $800 billion in 2025, reflecting that a growing share of wealth is being stored abroad.
The bigger problem is uncertainty. Wealthy families are scrambling to assess the impact of the new trust rules, including how far Beijing will look back and how assets in them will be valued. A broader question looms if this marks the start of a new tax era under President Xi Jinping’s ‘Common Prosperity’ drive. Several advisers, including former central-bank chief Guo Shuqing, have recently advocated for the introduction of an inheritance tax , for example.
Markets are offering a preview of the impact. Besides a [USN:L4N443043 TEXT:"slump"] in shares of insurers including AIA (1299.HK) and Prudential (PRU.L) , this month hotpot chain Haidilao International's (6862.HK) shares fell after co-founder Shu Ping sold about HK$2.75 billion, roughly $350 million, of stock through a family trust vehicle. The company said the disposal reflected personal financial needs. As well as stock sales, Chinese entrepreneurs are also looking to borrow against their shares to fund tax bills, bankers have told Breakingviews.
Advances in data sharing, reporting requirements and artificial-intelligence tools have made offshore assets far easier to identify and trace. Still, Beijing’s crackdown may raise large sums of money without yielding all the benefits policymakers hope for.
Assets held under trusts in Hong Kong reached HK$6.2 trillion in 2025, according to Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission. If these are taxed at 20%, authorities will pocket $159 billion. That’s impressive but only a fraction of the lost annual land sales revenue. And if authorities also hope to convince people to invest their money onshore, they may be disappointed too: China's stock market remains one of the world's chronic underperformers.
The biggest danger is that an abrupt shift in taxing wealth could reduce the incentive to create it in the first place.
Beijing has long tolerated legal grey zones when they served broader economic goals. For example, offshore listings of China’s internet tech champions Tencent (0700.HK) and Alibaba (9988.HK) relied on variable-interest-entity structures that allowed foreign investors to gain economic exposure to a Chinese company without owning the Chinese operating business. It gave founders access to foreign capital and hard currency, though it sat awkwardly alongside foreign ownership restrictions.
But that bargain, and the exit door it offered, appears to be narrowing. Beijing told the co-founders of Manus not to leave China this year before forcing the AI startup to unwind its agreed $2 billion sale to Meta Platforms (META.O) . As well as tightening oversight of outbound investment, authorities have tightened rules on cross-border movement by individuals deemed to threaten national security or violate technology-export controls.
One number to watch will be the exodus of wealthy individuals attempting to move beyond China's tax net. Investment-migration consultancy Henley & Partners estimates that China saw a net outflow of 7,800 millionaires carrying roughly $55.9 billion of investable wealth last year, even as the United States attracted a net inflow of 7,500.
Ultimately Beijing may be less concerned about where money goes than ensuring it does not disappear from view. Officials have reiterated Hong Kong's role as an international financial centre and continue to call for further opening of China's financial system. That would imply capital can continue to move, provided officials can see where it goes and claim a share.
Most entrepreneurs can live with a 20% tax, but the sudden increased scrutiny of the well-heeled and uncertainty over where Beijing will draw the final lines on issues from offshore wealth to mobility will keep many on their guard.
Chinese residents will have to pay a 20% income tax on income derived from transferring assets into offshore trusts, as well as income generated during the lifetime of such trusts, the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration jointly announced on July 24.

items.title: La Unión Europea prepara la salida de Panamá de su lista negra de paraísos fiscales
items.author: Saim Saeed
items.summary: Garantizar la eliminación de empresas fantasma ha sido una prioridad absoluta para Panamá, según declaró su ministro de Hacienda, Felipe Chapman, a Bloomberg en junio.
items.body: Bloomberg — La Unión Europea se prepara para retirar a Vietnam y Panamá de su lista de paraísos fiscales cuando los ministros de Finanzas de la UE se reúnan en Luxemburgo el próximo mes. Vietnam pasará a una llamada “lista gris”, mientras que Panamá será retirado por completo, según personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Ver más: Ecuador y Panamá se acercan a un acuerdo comercial tras reunión entre Noboa y Mulino Los países de la UE actualizan dos veces al año la lista de jurisdicciones consideradas no cooperativas. Esta medida busca frenar la evasión fiscal y fomentar la transparencia. Los territorios estadounidenses de Guam, Samoa y las Islas Vírgenes, así como Rusia y Vanuatu, figuran entre los países que actualmente aparecen en la lista. Garantizar la eliminación de empresas fantasma ha sido una prioridad absoluta para Panamá, según declaró su ministro de Hacienda, Felipe Chapman, a Bloomberg en junio. El país aprobó en verano un proyecto de ley destinado a aumentar la transparencia fiscal y combatir las empresas fantasma. Según Chapman, Panamá figura en la lista de jurisdicciones no cooperativas de la UE —países con baja puntuación en transparencia fiscal y esfuerzos para combatir la evasión de impuestos— desde 2020, lo que ha perjudicado la inversión extranjera directa y las relaciones comerciales entre Panamá y la UE. Ver más: La gigantesca mina de cobre de Panamá es demasiado valiosa para desperdiciarla Vietnam, una de las economías de mayor crecimiento en el sudeste asiático, se sumó a la lista en febrero de este año. El país pasará a formar parte de la denominada “lista gris”, que incluye a los países que no cumplen con las normas fiscales internacionales pero se han comprometido a implementar reformas. Jordania, Montenegro y Marruecos, entre otros, figuran actualmente en dicha lista. Los ministros de finanzas de la UE tienen previsto debatir la lista negra en una reunión programada para el 9 de octubre en Luxemburgo. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: MLB sets umpiring crews for wild-card series
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Major League Baseball set the umpiring crews for its 2026 wild-card series Monday. Four crews of six were assigned for the best-of-three sets that begin Tuesday.
items.body:
Major League Baseball set the umpiring crews for its 2026 wild-card series Monday. Four crews of six were assigned for the best-of-three sets that begin Tuesday.
The group is a mix of young and old, with Bill Miller the most decorated as he receives his seventh wild-card assignment. He will serve as one of the four crew chiefs, along with Alan Porter, Mark Wegner and Jordan Baker.
Five umpires are making their postseason debuts, and another four are in either their second or third playoff series.
The full list, by crew, listed in order from home plate to right field for Game 1:
AMERICAN LEAGUE Chicago White Sox at Houston Astros:
Alex MacKay, Alex Tosi, Ryan Additon, Alan Porter (CC), Edwin Moscoso, Paul Clemons
Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees:
Nate Tomlinson, Scott Barry, John Libka, Mark Wegner (CC), John Tumpane, Emil Jimenez
NATIONAL LEAGUE Philadelphia Phillies at Atlanta Braves:
Dan Merzel, Adam Beck, Mark Ripperger, Jordan Baker (CC), Nestor Ceja, Charlie Ramos
Chicago Cubs at San Diego Padres:
Ramon De Jesus, Erich Bacchus, Chad Fairchild, Bill Miller (CC), Rob Drake, Clint Vondrak
MacKay, Clemons, Jimenez, Ramos and Vondrak are assigned to the postseason for the first time. All but MacKay, who has the plate for White Sox-Astros, will be in right field for their respective Game 1s.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Syria says gas pipeline fire between AL-shola and Deir Al-zour caused by "act of sabotage"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Syria's state petroleum company said a fire broke out on Monday evening on a gas pipeline between the Al-Shola area and Deir Al-Zour after an explosion at a pipeline isolation valve, which it attributed to sabotage, state news agency SANA reported.
items.body:
Syria's state petroleum company said a fire broke out on Monday evening on a gas pipeline between the Al-Shola area and Deir Al-Zour after an explosion at a pipeline isolation valve, which it attributed to sabotage, state news agency SANA reported.
The fire halted gas flows from the Jbeissa gas plant to power-generation stations, the company said.
Fire crews isolated the area on both sides of the blaze and were working to extinguish it as gas pressure fell.

items.title: EA Sports FC 27: cuánto cuesta el paquete con Nintendo Switch 2 y dónde comprarlo
items.author: Isaac Garrido
items.summary: El combo es una edición exclusiva para Latinoamérica y contiene la versión digital del juego de fútbol. Así se consigue en Brasil y México.
items.body: A pocos días del lanzamiento de EA Sports FC 27, Nintendo anunció un nuevo paquete de su consola Switch 2 que incluye una copia digital del videojuego de fútbol. El combo será exclusivo para América Latina y llegará a tiendas seleccionadas a partir del 15 de octubre, según informó la compañía japonesa en un comunicado. Su lanzamiento coincide con el inicio de la temporada de compras de fin de año, uno de los períodos de mayor actividad para las compañías de videojuegos y consolas. El paquete estará disponible en Brasil, donde el precio que circula entre distribuidores es de R$4.699, equivalentes a unos US$890. En México, el precio sugerido es de MXN$14.999, cerca de US$880. Hasta ahora, Nintendo no ha informado si habrá preventa a través de plataformas como Mercado Libre o Amazon. Además de la copia digital de EA Sports FC 27, el paquete incluye un diseño especial en el empaque inspirado en el videojuego. La edición representa un movimiento poco habitual para Nintendo, que suele comercializar este tipo de bundles con títulos propios, como Mario Kart o Pokémon. Semanas después del lanzamiento del paquete con EA Sports FC 27, la compañía japonesa presentará una edición conmemorativa por el 40 aniversario de “The Legend of Zelda” . Esta versión incluirá elementos decorativos inspirados en la saga y llegará antes del lanzamiento de una nueva versión de “The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time”, uno de los títulos más reconocidos de la franquicia y el primero de la serie principal desarrollado en 3D. EA Sports FC 27 llegó al mercado el 25 de septiembre con más de 21.000 futbolistas, más de 800 clubes y selecciones nacionales, más de 140 estadios y más de 35 ligas. Entre las novedades de esta edición se encuentra la incorporación de un modo de juego de mundo abierto. La versión para Nintendo Switch 2 también aprovecha GameChat, una función de la consola que permite mantener sesiones de chat de voz y video, además de compartir la pantalla durante las partidas. EA Sports FC 27 tiene un precio de US$69,99 en su edición estándar y llega hasta US$149,99 en la edición Ultimate.

items.title: OFAC actualiza licencias y mantiene vía para que empresas de EE.UU. operen con petróleo venezolano
items.author: Raylí Luján
items.summary: Las nuevas licencias 46E, 48D y 49B permiten desde el comercio y refinación de crudo hasta el suministro de bienes y servicios para el sector energético y la negociación de nuevos contratos de inversi ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — La Oficina de Control de Activos Extranjeros (OFAC, por sus siglas en inglés) del Departamento del Tesoro de Estados Unidos actualizó este lunes 28 de septiembre tres licencias relacionadas con Venezuela. Las medidas mantienen autorizadas determinadas operaciones con petróleo y productos petroquímicos venezolanos y permiten a empresas estadounidenses avanzar en negociaciones para nuevas inversiones en el sector energético. Las nuevas Licencias Generales 46E, 48D y 49B sustituyen a versiones anteriores y establecen condiciones específicas para las operaciones autorizadas. Ver más: EE.UU. alivia temporalmente algunas sanciones a los sectores petrolero y gasífero de Venezuela La Licencia 46E mantiene autorizadas las operaciones necesarias para levantar, exportar, reexportar, vender, revender, suministrar, almacenar, comercializar, comprar, entregar y transportar petróleo de origen venezolano, incluida su refinación. También permite determinadas operaciones con productos petroquímicos venezolanos destinados a Estados Unidos. El permiso está dirigido a las llamadas “entidades estadounidenses establecidas”, que OFAC define como compañías constituidas bajo las leyes de Estados Unidos o alguna de sus jurisdicciones antes del 29 de enero de 2025. La autorización contempla operaciones que involucren al Gobierno venezolano, PDVSA o empresas en las que la petrolera estatal tenga una participación de al menos 50%. La licencia también cubre la logística necesaria para estas operaciones, incluido el fletamento de buques, los seguros marítimos y los servicios en puertos y terminales. Además, permite determinados pagos mediante intercambios de crudo, diluyentes o productos refinados. El alcance incluye productos petroquímicos como fertilizantes y sus precursores químicos. La definición contempla, entre otros, urea, amoníaco, nitratos, fosfatos y muriato de potasio. La autorización, sin embargo, mantiene restricciones para operaciones que involucren, entre otros, a personas de Rusia, Irán, Corea del Norte y Cuba, así como determinadas entidades vinculadas con China. También excluye embarcaciones bloqueadas y ciertos mecanismos de pago, incluidos los realizados en oro o en monedas digitales emitidas por o en nombre del Gobierno venezolano. La Licencia 48D amplía el marco de operaciones al autorizar el suministro desde Estados Unidos de bienes, tecnología, software y servicios destinados a la exploración, desarrollo y producción de petróleo, gas y productos petroquímicos en Venezuela. La autorización también contempla determinadas actividades relacionadas con la generación, transmisión, almacenamiento y distribución de electricidad. La Licencia 49B permite a las empresas negociar y celebrar contratos contingentes para nuevas inversiones en los sectores de petróleo, gas, petroquímica y electricidad en Venezuela. Esto incluye la ampliación de operaciones existentes y la creación de nuevos proyectos de inversión. Los contratos quedan sujetos a una autorización posterior de OFAC para poder ejecutarse, por lo que la licencia no equivale por sí misma a una autorización para concretar esas nuevas inversiones. Ver más: EE.UU. flexibiliza sanciones a Venezuela para permitir transacciones del banco central Las tres licencias establecen distintos niveles de apertura para las operaciones relacionadas con Venezuela. La 46E mantiene el canal para determinadas operaciones con petróleo y productos petroquímicos venezolanos; la 48D autoriza el suministro de bienes, tecnología y servicios para actividades energéticas dentro del país; y la 49B permite avanzar en la negociación y celebración de contratos contingentes para nuevas inversiones, sujetos a autorización posterior. La actualización, por tanto, no representa un levantamiento general de las sanciones sobre Venezuela, sino una modificación del esquema de licencias mediante el cual Estados Unidos autoriza determinadas operaciones y mantiene otras sujetas a restricciones.

items.title: Knicks, Jalen Brunson ready for next journey after ending title drought
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: After the briefest of summer vacations, the New York Knicks are back to work, now with "NBA champions" attached to their name.
items.body:
After the briefest of summer vacations, the New York Knicks are back to work, now with "NBA champions" attached to their name.
Whether they are called the reigning or defending champions matters little to Jalen Brunson. His focus is on starting anew and getting this team in the right frame of mind for the start of the season.
"The way we approached it last year was take it one day at a time every single day. I've talked about certain things. Obviously, we know what it takes, but just go into the same mindset for this journey," Brunson said at the team's media day Monday. "We know it's a new journey, it's a different journey, but the mindset has to be the same, if not better."
The journey will not be easy at the beginning. The October schedule includes two games against the Philadelphia 76ers, one against the Boston Celtics and one with the Detroit Pistons, all teams looking to knock off the defending champions.
"The first couple weeks of the season is going to show who we are and where we are," Brunson said.
The Knicks swept the Sixers in the Eastern Conference semifinals, part of a 12-1 run across the final three series en route to the franchise's first championship in 53 years. The Pistons and Celtics finished ahead of New York (53-29) in the regular-season standings but never faced either in the postseason after Boston fell in the opening round and Detroit lost in the second.
Brunson said that communication and accountability remain key to success.
"No matter what we're doing, whether we're playing great or we're playing bad, how do we deal with it and learn? We'll hold each other accountable, just like we did last year, and be better," Brunson said.
Coach Mike Brown preached something similar.
"Upholding our commitment to our standards ... that's not going to change. Our standards are sacrifice, being connected, having a competitive spirit and having a belief in each other in the process. That's our primary focus going into the year. No matter what we accomplished, moving forward, like I said, our standards and how we approach our process is going to be real critical," Brown said.
The Knicks brought back almost their entire playoff rotation. The lone exception was backup center Mitchell Robinson, who signed a three-year, $47.4 million contract with the Celtics. His replacement is veteran Andre Drummond, who played for Philly last season.
But unity might be elusive if standouts Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart begin to wonder about their futures amid uncertainty about their potential contract extensions.
"Winning can either help us or hurt us, but I think we have the personnel and the character to talk with each other and not take things personal when things are said," Brunson said. "It helped us last year and we need to continue that."
Brunson said he'll see how his surgically repaired wrist reacts early on. He added that he felt fine playing through the injury in the playoffs.
--Field Level Media

items.title: AAR to buy majority stake in aircraft maintenance firm MRO Holdings for $1.8 billion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Aviation aftermarket services provider AAR said on Monday it would acquire a 65% controlling interest in aircraft maintenance company MRO Holdings for about $1.8 billion.
items.body:
Aviation aftermarket services provider AAR (AIR.N) said on Monday it would acquire a 65% controlling interest in aircraft maintenance company MRO Holdings for about $1.8 billion.
The deal would strengthen AAR's maintenance, repair and overhaul footprint and increase capacity as airlines ramp up demand for aircraft servicing in the face of supply-chain constraints and delays in new jet deliveries. Its shares were up 6% in extended trading.
"Through the acquisition of MRO Holdings, we will create the largest heavy maintenance MRO (maintenance, repair, and overhaul) in the world, servicing a combined total of nearly 3,000 aircraft per year in our hangars," said John Holmes, CEO of AAR.
MRO Holdings operates aircraft maintenance and modification facilities across the United States, Mexico, El Salvador and Colombia, with about 90% of its revenue coming from sales to US customers. The company is backed by investors including private-equity firm Bain Capital.
AAR will have the option to buy the remaining 35% ownership interest of MRO Holdings within six years of the deal's closing.
The Wall Street Journal first reported about the deal earlier on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
AAR expects to fund the transaction through new debt, about $780 million of equity issued to existing MRO Holdings shareholders, and proceeds from a private investment in public equity (PIPE) offering.
The transaction is expected to close in AAR's fiscal third quarter ending February 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.

items.title: Argentina dice iniciará arbitraje contra Reino Unido para detener explotación petrolera en Islas Malvinas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Argentina dijo el lunes que iniciará un procedimiento de arbitraje internacional contra el Reino Unido si no frena la explotación petrolera en la zona de las disputadas Islas Malvinas mediante el proyecto Sea Lion.
items.body:
Argentina dijo el lunes que iniciará un procedimiento de arbitraje internacional contra el Reino Unido si no frena la explotación petrolera en la zona de las disputadas Islas Malvinas mediante el proyecto Sea Lion.
La medida llega en momentos de [USN:L1N45F0IU TEXT:"tensión"] entre Argentina y el Reino Unido por la disputa de soberanía de las Islas Malvinas, cuyo control está en manos británicas.
En un comunicado oficial, el Gobierno indicó que la medida busca impedir la explotación de hidrocarburos en la denominada Cuenca Malvinas Norte y cita el procedimiento de arbitraje previsto por la Convención de las Naciones Unidas sobre el Derecho del Mar.
La medida también busca evitar la adopción de nuevas decisiones vinculadas a la explotación de recursos naturales en la Plataforma Continental Argentina.
"Si en dos semanas el Reino Unido no frena la explotación ilegítima, vamos a ir al Tribunal Internacional del Derecho del Mar", dijo el presidente libertario argentino, Javier Milei, en su cuenta de X, donde compartió el comunicado.
El Gobierno sostiene que Reino Unido lleva adelante un "accionar ilegítimo" en las Islas Malvinas, Georgias del Sur y Sandwich del Sur y en los espacios marítimos circundantes.
"La explotación unilateral de los recursos naturales (...) es contraria al derecho internacional y produce un perjuicio irreversible e irreparable a los derechos de soberanía de la República Argentina", indicó.
Los propietarios del proyecto Sea Lion, Navitas Petroleum (NVPTp.TA) , de Israel, y Rockhopper Exploration (RKH.L) , del Reino Unido, han dicho que cuentan con licencias válidas del Gobierno de las Islas Malvinas para operar en la zona.
El Gobierno dijo que intimó a Londres para que, en un plazo de dos semanas, adopte las medidas necesarias para impedir el inicio o la continuidad de actividades vinculadas con la explotación hidrocarburífera en la plataforma continental argentina.
Por otra parte, el Gobierno también denunció vuelos ilegales de la empresa británica THALES UK LIMITED en la ruta aérea entre las Islas Malvinas y Punta Arenas, en Chile, "sin autorización de las autoridades argentinas", y anunció sanciones.
Argentina y el Reino Unido pelearon una guerra de dos meses en 1982 por el archipiélago, que culminó con una victoria británica y 649 argentinos y 255 británicos muertos.
El Ejecutivo argentino presentó este mes al Congreso un [USN:L1N4590E7 TEXT:"proyecto de ley"] para fortalecer sanciones a empresas que operen en las Malvinas y para crear un Consejo Nacional de Seguridad.

items.title: Burnham offers Britain an 'honest conversation' on tackling problems
items.author: Elizabeth Piper
items.creator: Elizabeth Piper
items.summary: Andy Burnham will offer on Monday an "honest conversation" with Britain to spell out the trade-offs in tackling some of the nation's deepest problems, such as social care and the control of utilities, in his first conference speech as prime minister.
items.body:
[USN:L8N43L03M TEXT:"Andy Burnham"] will offer on Monday an "honest conversation" with Britain to spell out the trade-offs in tackling some of the nation's deepest problems, such as social care and the control of utilities, in his first conference speech as prime minister.
Taking the floor of a vast conference centre in the northwestern English city of Liverpool for his governing Labour Party's annual conference, [USN:L1N43M05W TEXT:"Burnham"] will press his message that his government will end "politics as usual", instead offering Britain hope he believes has long been lost.
Yet, Britain's seventh prime minister in a decade will say that underlying his belief that he can restore pride in Britain is a reckoning, one that needs offering a level of honesty "politicians usually avoid".
BURNHAM SAYS SOME DECISIONS MIGHT NOT BE POPULAR "We can't carry on as we are. Politics as usual has taken Britain backwards. More of the same isn't good enough and isn't going to get us where we need to be," Burnham will say, according to extracts of his speech provided by his office.
"Hope comes from honesty and from saying the things politicians usually avoid."
Burnham, a former mayor who replaced [USN:L8N41P1MT TEXT:"Keir Starmer"] as prime minister in July, has come under pressure to offer more detailed plans for government, beyond his initial bid to hand people "breathing space" from cost-of-living pressures.
When he came to power, Burnham promised to use his premiership as a "circuit-breaker for Britain", which, like many European countries, has struggled for years with soaring prices and anaemic economic growth.
But beyond some immediate measures, including capping bus fares and removing value added tax from electricity bills, his strategy to realise his bigger ambitions to tackle Britain's social care crisis, bring some utilities into public ownership and create more jobs has lacked detail, businesses say.
[USN:L6N45J04E TEXT:"On Sunday"], Burnham moved the goalposts for his pledge to do what several other prime ministers have failed to achieve, to tackle the social care system, by saying he would only present his plans at the next national election, due by mid-2029.
That offered some relief to a government wanting to avoid the immediate prospect of major tax rises or spending cuts, although Burnham might listen to those arguing for the end of the pensions triple lock, which guarantees that the state pension rises each year by whichever is highest among inflation, wage growth or 2.5%, to fund future social care reform.
In a speech his team says will contain a raft of policies and commitments, Burnham is also expected to offer more detail on his pledge for greater public control of energy, water and housing.
Saying he initially wanted to give "the usual tub-thumping conference speech", he decided instead to answer a call from those who wanted "less drift and more direction" by setting out "a more serious prospectus for Britain than people have been offered in a generation".
"I accept people will not agree with every part of it, but I believe it can turn Britain around," he will say, offering a route to build "a Britain where people feel the country has their back again".

items.title: Pentagon awards RTX's Raytheon $20.7 billion contract for AMRAAM missiles amid stockpile concerns
items.author: Mike Stone
items.creator: Mike Stone
items.summary: The Pentagon awarded RTX's Raytheon business a provisional multiyear contract worth $20.7 billion to accelerate production of AMRAAM missiles, as the military pushes to replenish stockpiles depleted by conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine.
items.body:
The Pentagon awarded RTX's Raytheon business a provisional multiyear contract worth $20.7 billion to accelerate production of AMRAAM missiles, as the military pushes to replenish stockpiles depleted by conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine.
The US has supplied large quantities of weapons to allies while also using munitions in its own military operations in Iran, raising concerns about inventories of key air defense and precision-guided weapons.
The AMRAAM is used in air-to-air jet fighter combat as well as in the National Advanced Surface-to-Air Missile System (NASAMS), which is used to defend the Washington area and is used by more than a dozen other countries, including Ukraine, Oman and Qatar.
The prospective AMRAAM deal is the latest in a series of large munitions contracts the Pentagon has pursued this year to pressure contractors into ramping output up faster. The award follows a similar pattern to a $58.6 billion Patriot interceptor deal awarded to Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) [USN:L1N43V1N1 TEXT:"in July"], a seven-year procurement plan running through fiscal 2032.
As with that contract, industry executives have cautioned that Congress has not yet appropriated the funding needed to support the full multiyear commitment, meaning contractors may be unable to invest at scale in components and facilities until lawmakers act.
The production agreements are designed to entice contractors to move faster on increasing output, part of a broader push by the Trump administration to prioritize weapons production over shareholder returns.
The contract, if Congress ultimately appropriates the funds, would let RTX continue to invest in its workforce, supply chain and facilities as US demand surges.
The company said it nearly doubled AMRAAM production in 2025, compared with the prior year.
The deal would be part of the Pentagon's "Arsenal of Freedom" initiative. RTX said earlier this year it would set an annual production goal of at least 1,900 AMRAAM missiles.

items.title: Wembanyama says Finals loss lingers as Spurs eye new season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama said the disappointment of the San Antonio Spurs' NBA Finals defeat by the New York Knicks has lingered into the offseason, with the Frenchman acknowledging he has endured some difficult nights ahead of the new campaign.
items.body:
Victor Wembanyama said the disappointment of the San Antonio Spurs' NBA Finals defeat by the New York Knicks has lingered into the offseason, with the Frenchman acknowledging he has endured some difficult nights ahead of the new campaign.
Wembanyama, speaking at the Spurs' media day on Monday, said he had allowed himself to confront the emotions of losing the [USN:L6N42M021 TEXT:"Finals"] after five games rather than trying to move past them too quickly.
"It evolves with time, but I've had a few sleepless nights," the 22-year-old said. "Maybe not sleepless nights, but hard to find sleep sometimes or hard emotions, haunting sometimes."
The Spurs' run to the Finals came in Wembanyama's third season, and the 7-foot-4 center said the team was ready to use the disappointment as motivation.
"We don't want to hide from anything. We're going to face these emotions," he said. "We're in a great spot. We're very hopeful, very ambitious, and we're ready."
Wembanyama signed a [USN:L6N43D003 TEXT:"multi-year contract extension"] with San Antonio in July after averaging career highs of 25 points, 11.5 rebounds and 3.1 assists in 64 regular-season games last season.
He became the youngest player to win the NBA's Defensive Player of the Year award and led the league with 3.08 blocks per game.

items.author: Dominique Patton
items.creator: Dominique Patton
items.summary: Global beauty brand L'Oreal Paris staged a star-studded runway show in the French capital on Monday, with pop icon Celine Dion making a guest appearance to close out the evening.
items.body:
Global beauty brand L'Oreal Paris staged a star-studded runway show in the French capital on Monday, with pop icon Celine Dion making a guest appearance to close out the evening.
The event held at the start of Paris Fashion Week featured models Kendall Jenner and Heidi Klum, actors Andie MacDowell and Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu, as well as US Olympic skier Lindsey Vonn and Italian Paralympian Beatrice Vio, sashaying down a catwalk against the backdrop of a lit-up Eiffel Tower.
Dion, who is in Paris for a [USN:L1N45406R TEXT:"series of concerts"], was a L'Oreal Paris brand ambassador in 2019.
L'Oreal Paris is L'Oreal group's (OREP.PA) biggest brand, used by about 600 million consumers, according to the company, and was the biggest contributor to its [USN:L6N43V153 TEXT:"growth"] in the first half of the year.

items.title: Infantino ordena revisar financiación FIFA, tras solicitud de más reparto de UEFA y CONCACAF
items.author: Julien Pretot
items.creator: Julien Pretot
items.summary: El presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, ordenó que se evalúen las propuestas para distribuir más fondos a las federaciones nacionales, tras las peticiones de la UEFA y la CONCACAF de que se destinen 2.100 millones de dólares procedentes de las reservas del organismo rector, pero no llegó a comprometer una cantidad concreta.
items.body:
El presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, ordenó que se evalúen las propuestas para distribuir más fondos a las federaciones nacionales, tras las peticiones de la UEFA y la CONCACAF de que se destinen 2.100 millones de dólares procedentes de las reservas del organismo rector, pero no llegó a comprometer una cantidad concreta.
En una carta dirigida a los presidentes de las seis confederaciones continentales, a la que Reuters tuvo acceso el lunes, Infantino dijo que la evaluación se sometería al Consejo de la FIFA el 15 de octubre, y que cualquier financiación extra estaría sujeta a controles financieros y a la aprobación formal.
"Hasta que no se haya completado el análisis y las aprobaciones necesarias, ninguna cifra preliminar podrá considerarse un compromiso aprobado para las federaciones miembro", escribió.
El presidente de la UEFA, Aleksander Ceferin, y el presidente de la CONCACAF, Víctor Montagliani, propusieron este mes que cada una de las 211 federaciones miembro de la FIFA reciba al menos 10 millones de dólares durante el ciclo 2027-30, además de la financiación para el desarrollo ya existente. Además, pidieron una revisión independiente de las reservas de la FIFA.
En su carta del 18 de septiembre, cuestionaban si la propuesta de inversión privada, que la FIFA descartó, había sido necesaria para aumentar la financiación, teniendo en cuenta que, según sus previsiones, las reservas ascenderían a unos 6.000 millones de dólares a finales de 2026.
La distribución que proponen mantendría las reservas sobre los 1.500 millones de dólares a lo largo del siguiente ciclo.

items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米AI開発企業アンソロピックと半導体大手エヌビディアは、企業環境に導入されるAIエージェントの挙動を管理・制御するための多層型セキュリティーフレームワーク「Open Agent Safety Platform」を共同開発した。

エヌビディアはオープンソースのランタイムソフトウエア「OpenShell」を提供し、アンソロピックは「Claude Managed Agents API」スイートを提供する

Claude Managed Agentsはエージェントの認証情報を保管庫で管理する。また、OpenShellはエージェントによるアクションをデフォルトでブロックする。

ノーション、楽天、Asanaなどが早期導入企業として、Claude Managed Agentsを本番環境で利用している。

原題：Anthropic Collaborates With NVIDIA on AI Agent Safety

COPENHAGEN, Sept 28 : FIFA President Gianni Infantino has ordered an assessment of proposals to distribute more money to national associations, following calls from UEFA and CONCACAF for a $2.1 billion payout from the governing body's reserves, but stopped short of committing to an amount.
In a letter to the six continental confederation presidents seen by Reuters on Monday, Infantino said the assessment would go before the FIFA Council on October 15, with any additional funding subject to financial checks and formal approval.
"Until the assessment and necessary approvals are complete, no preliminary figure can be treated as an approved commitment to the Member Associations," he wrote.
UEFA President Aleksander Ceferin and CONCACAF President Victor Montagliani proposed this month that each of FIFA's 211 member associations receive at least $10 million during the 2027-30 cycle, in addition to existing development funding. They also sought an independent review of FIFA's reserves.

Their September 18 letter questioned whether FIFA's abandoned private-investment proposal had been needed to increase funding, given reserves they projected at about $6 billion at the end of 2026. They argued their proposed distribution would leave reserves above $1.5 billion throughout the following cycle.
Infantino defended the rationale for the withdrawn commercial plan, saying it would have generated funding beyond what FIFA could distribute from existing resources.
"The recent commercial proposal, now withdrawn, was intended to enable FIFA to invest more in football – not to replace support that could responsibly be provided from existing resources," he wrote.
"So, it would actually have been on top of it."
The FIFA Forward Enterprise project was abandoned in July following opposition from confederations, including UEFA, CONCACAF and the Asian Football Confederation, over a lack of consultation. The dispute has fuelled demands for changes to FIFA's governance.
Infantino said FIFA's administration had already been examining how to provide further development and solidarity funding before receiving the confederations' submissions.
He asked the confederation chiefs to send their financial models, assumptions and supporting information to the secretary general, with relevant FIFA committees involved in verifying the assumptions.
The Council should determine the amount and timing of additional payments, the reserves needed to protect FIFA's obligations and financial independence, and the eligibility, reporting and audit requirements attached to any distribution, he said.
The assessment would also consider support for confederations facing demonstrable structural costs.
Where sufficient evidence was available, the Council should receive a recommendation on October 15. Otherwise, it should approve “the shortest reasonable timetable” for completing the work.
“I will not prejudge the amount. I will support the greatest level of additional funding that can responsibly be delivered through FIFA’s proper governance process, applied fairly and supported by transparent and auditable arrangements,” Infantino wrote.
He also reiterated his invitation for proposals to strengthen FIFA's decision-making, while urging the confederation presidents to respect decisions reached through its institutional processes.
“Trust is not the absence of disagreement,” he wrote. “It is demonstrated when we engage directly, test proposals against the facts and respect decisions properly reached through FIFA’s democratic and institutional processes – even when the outcome differs from the one we preferred.”

Source: Reuters

items.title: Papa Leão diz que preocupações com fim do mundo causado pela IA não são “fake news”
items.author: Joshua McElwee
items.creator: Joshua McElwee
items.summary: O papa Leão 14 afirmou nesta segunda-feira que as preocupações de que a inteligência artificial possa destruir o mundo não são “fake news” e devem ser levadas a sério, em uma aparente crítica ao presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump.
items.body:
O papa Leão 14 afirmou nesta segunda-feira que as preocupações de que a inteligência artificial possa destruir o mundo não são “fake news” e devem ser levadas a sério, em uma aparente crítica ao presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump.
O primeiro papa norte-americano, que tem alertado sobre os perigos da IA ao longo de seus 16 meses de papado, também criticou diretamente os CEOs do setor de tecnologia que defendem que não deve haver restrições à tecnologia.
“Eu realmente acho que as preocupações levantadas por muitos dos especialistas em IA devem ser levadas a sério”, disse o pontífice em uma coletiva de imprensa durante o voo de volta a Roma, após uma viagem de quatro dias à França. “Não acho que isso seja fake news, como alguns têm dito.”
Trump disse à Assembleia Geral da ONU na semana passada que acreditava que os temores sobre os perigos da IA para a humanidade eram uma “farsa”.
O papa disse ter lido nesta segunda-feira que o presidente da fabricante de chips Nvidia havia anunciado que poderia haver uma maneira de inserir medidas de segurança em certos modelos de IA. Mas Leão expressou ceticismo, acrescentando: “Ele é o mesmo que, no entanto, diz que não devem ser impostos limites nem haver regulamentação governamental.”
O presidente-executivo da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, disse à CBS News neste mês que concordava com Trump de que as preocupações com a segurança em relação à IA eram exageradas.
Trump se reunirá com CEOs do setor de tecnologia para discutir inteligência artificial na terça-feira, na Casa Branca. Huang, Mark Zuckerberg, da Meta, Dario Amodei, da Anthropic, e Greg Brockman, da OpenAI, estão entre aqueles que se reunirão com Trump e com o presidente da Câmara dos Deputados, Mike Johnson, segundo fontes a par do assunto. Outros possíveis participantes incluem o presidente-executivo do Google, Sundar Pichai, e o executivo da SpaceXAI, Elon Musk.
Johnson disse que as negociações se concentrariam em encontrar um equilíbrio entre inovação e supervisão regulatória e alertou que os EUA correm o risco de perder a corrida da IA para a China se decidirem "hiperregular isso".
Leão exortou o mundo a “promover o diálogo, o estudo e a investigação, para encontrar maneiras de garantir que a IA não chegue a um ponto em que possa destruir a humanidade”.
“Acho que há pessoas suficientes seriamente interessadas nisso… mas temos que continuar trabalhando”, disse o papa. “Não podemos simplesmente ficar de braços cruzados e fingir que nada vai acontecer.”

items.title: ＡＩ脅威論は「フェイクでない」、ローマ教皇がトランプ氏に反論
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: 教皇機内　２８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
教皇機内　２８日　ロイター］ - ローマ教皇レオ１４世は２８日、人工知能（ＡＩ）が世界を破壊しかねないとの懸念は「フェイクニュース」ではなく、真剣に受け止めるべきだと述べた。トランプ米大統領を批判したとみられる。

米国出身として初のローマ教皇であるレオ１４世は、就任から１６カ月にわたりＡＩの危険性に警鐘を鳴らしてきた。この日はさらに、同技術に規制を設ける必要はないと主張するテクノロジー企業の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）らを直接批判した。

教皇は、フランスへの４日間の訪問を終えてローマに戻る機内での記者会見で「多くのＡＩ専門家が提起する懸念は、真剣に受け止めるべきだと考える。一部の人が言うようにこれがフェイクニュースだとは思わない」と語った。

トランプ氏は先週、国連総会でＡＩが人類にもたらす危険への懸念は「うそ」だと信じていると述べていた。

レオ１４世は「対話、研究、調査を促進し、ＡＩが人類を破壊しかねない段階に至らないよう確実にする方法を見出す」よう世界中に呼び掛け。「これに真剣に関心を持つ人々は十分にいると考える。だが、われわれは取り組みを続けなければならない」と述べ、「ただ座視して、何も起こらないふりをすることはできない」とした。

items.title: Petróleo fecha em leve alta por preocupações com oferta, enquanto Trump rejeita proposta do Irã
items.author: Scott Disavino
items.creator: Scott Disavino
items.summary: Os preços do petróleo fecharam em leve alta nesta segunda-feira, em meio a preocupações com as contínuas interrupções no abastecimento, enquanto mediadores do Catar se comprometeram a realizar negociações com os Estados Unidos e o Irã na esperança de chegar a um acordo de paz para reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz.
items.body:
Os preços do petróleo fecharam em leve alta nesta segunda-feira, em meio a preocupações com as contínuas interrupções no abastecimento, enquanto mediadores do Catar se comprometeram a realizar negociações com os Estados Unidos e o Irã na esperança de chegar a um acordo de paz para reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz.
Os preços subiram mais de US$4 por barril no início do pregão, depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, rejeitou uma proposta do Irã que teria reaberto o estreito. Em seguida, o petróleo recuou um pouco, diante das expectativas de que os mediadores do Catar realizariam negociações com ambas as partes.
Os contratos futuros do Brent fecharam com alta de 96 centavos, ou 0,9%, a US$105,28 por barril. O petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos EUA subiu 19 centavos, ou 0,2%, fechando a US$ 92,60.
Espera-se que os mediadores do Catar realizem negociações separadas com o ministro das Relações Exteriores do Irã, Abbas Araqchi, em Nova York, e com a delegação dos EUA na segunda ou na terça-feira, disse à Reuters uma autoridade a par das negociações.
Espera-se que as negociações se concentrem em uma versão alterada da proposta de sete dias que o Irã apresentou na semana passada, durante Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas, disse a autoridade, que falou sob condição de anonimato.
No fim de semana, o Irã insistiu que somente a diplomacia pode resolver seu conflito com os EUA e Israel, depois que Trump rejeitou a proposta iraniana de reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz e pôr fim às hostilidades.
Mantendo aberta a porta para a diplomacia, no entanto, Trump disse à Axios em uma entrevista por telefone no domingo que esperava que os negociadores dos EUA participassem de mais conversas nesta semana.
O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Arábia Saudita, o príncipe Faisal bin Farhan, chegou a Washington nesta segunda-feira para conversas com o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, informou a agência de notícias estatal saudita, em meio à escalada das hostilidades entre Riade e os houthis do Iêmen, apoiados pelo Irã.

items.title: North Korea says US approval for South Korea's nuclear submarine increases regional instability
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: North Korea's foreign ministry said in a statement published by state media KCNA that the United States' approval for South Korea's building its first nuclear submarine is "a dangerous development" that added new instability to the political and military environment of the Asia-Pacific region.
items.body:
North Korea's foreign ministry said in a statement published by state media KCNA that the United States' approval for South Korea's building its first nuclear submarine is "a dangerous development" that added new instability to the political and military environment of the Asia-Pacific region.
The approval is also another demonstration of US nuclear proliferation through AUKUS pact, the North Korean ministry said, outlining a history of what it described as Washington's "radical nuclear arms buildup" that resulted in the "collapse of international nuclear order."
South Korea [USN:L1N42305L TEXT:"aims"] to launch its first nuclear-powered submarine by the mid-2030s, under a new programme aimed at countering North Korea's submarine-launched nuclear and missile threats.
The plan for Seoul's nuclear submarine was agreed upon with Washington under a [USN:FWN3WP2EM TEXT:"trade deal"] struck between the two allies last year.

items.title: Un múltiplo clave para invertir en el S&P 500 retrocede
items.author: Juan Pablo Álvarez
items.summary: El múltiplo precio/ganancias esperadas del S&P 500 cayó de 22 a 19 veces en lo que va del año, pese al avance de 14% del índice, y volvió a su promedio de 10 años.
items.body: El múltiplo que compara el precio de las acciones del S&P 500 con las ganancias que se espera que obtengan las compañías durante los próximos 12 meses cayó de 22 a 19 veces en lo que va del año, según un informe reciente de Goldman Sachs. La baja se produjo pese a que el índice acumula un retorno de 14% en el mismo período y llevó al indicador a igualar su promedio de los últimos 10 años. Este múltiplo, conocido como forward P/E o relación precio/ganancias esperadas, es una de las principales referencias que utilizan los inversores para evaluar cuánto están pagando por las ganancias futuras de las empresas. Una caída del indicador implica que los precios de las acciones se redujeron en relación con las ganancias proyectadas, o que estas últimas crecieron más rápido que los precios. VER MÁS: Las ganancias por acción del S&P 500 irán cayendo, pero no colapsarán: Goldman Sachs Goldman Sachs señala al aumento de las tasas de interés como una de las razones detrás de la reducción de las valuaciones. La prima de riesgo de las acciones del S&P 500 se ha mantenido cerca de 3% durante la mayor parte de los últimos dos años. El menor múltiplo también refleja las dudas de los inversores sobre la sostenibilidad de los niveles actuales de rentabilidad corporativa. En particular, el banco señala que existe preocupación por que el auge de la inversión en inteligencia artificial esté llevando a algunas compañías a obtener ganancias superiores a las que podrían sostenerse en función de sus flujos de caja y de un nivel sostenible de beneficios. La valuación actual del S&P 500 parece consistente con un retorno sobre el patrimonio (ROE) de 22%, de acuerdo con el modelo macroeconómico de Goldman Sachs. Ese nivel continúa siendo elevado frente a los registros históricos, aunque se encuentra 2 puntos porcentuales por debajo del nivel actual. Para Goldman, esto refleja cierto escepticismo del mercado respecto de la capacidad de las compañías para mantener los niveles actuales de rentabilidad. Las tasas de interés y la rentabilidad corporativa serán dos variables determinantes para los múltiplos de las acciones estadounidenses hacia adelante. El modelo de Goldman incorpora los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense, la inflación y la rentabilidad corporativa para estimar cuál debería ser el nivel de los múltiplos. Además de las variables macroeconómicas, los inversores están prestando especial atención al crecimiento de los ingresos de largo plazo. Goldman Sachs señala que el crecimiento de las ventas suele ser uno de los principales determinantes de las valuaciones de las compañías. El informe encuentra una diferencia entre los horizontes de corto y largo plazo: los inversores están pagando una prima superior al promedio por compañías con mayor crecimiento esperado de las ventas a tres años, mientras que la prima asociada al crecimiento esperado a un año está por debajo de su promedio. Según el banco de inversión, esto refleja una menor dependencia de los inversores respecto de la información que proporcionan las ganancias de corto plazo. Por eso, Goldman considera que la atención debería concentrarse en aquellas compañías respecto de las cuales existen visiones diferenciadas sobre sus perspectivas de crecimiento de largo plazo. VER MÁS: Meta va camino a su mejor mes desde 2013: sube 36% impulsada por Muse y roza los US$2 billones La relación entre la rentabilidad corporativa y las valuaciones sectoriales también aumentó hasta un máximo de varias décadas, mientras que se redujo la diferencia entre los múltiplos de las distintas acciones del mercado.

items.title: Tunisia’s miserable run continues after Botswana draw in AFCON qualifiers
items.author: Nick Said
items.creator: Nick Said
items.summary: Tunisia’s poor form continued as they were held to a 2-2 draw by Botswana in their Africa Cup of Nations Group H qualifier in Rades on Monday, extending their winless run to eight games.
items.body:
Tunisia’s poor form continued as they were held to a 2-2 draw by Botswana in their Africa Cup of Nations Group H qualifier in Rades on Monday, extending their winless run to eight games.
It is a second successive draw for the North African side at the start of the continental qualifiers having been held to a 1-1 home draw by Uganda on Thursday.
Botswana lead the pool with two points from as many matches, the same as Tunisia, while Libya and Uganda have a point each. They meet in Hoima on Tuesday.
Thatayaone Kgamanyane put Botswana ahead on 37 minutes but two goals from Hazem Mastouri either side of halftime turned the fixture in the favour of the hosts.
But Tunisia were denied victory when Lebogang Ditsele equalised for Botswana on the hour mark and the sparse home crowd left disappointed once again.
Yoane Wissa was on target as the Democratic Republic of Congo claimed a 2-1 win over Zimbabwe in Harare to move top of Group E with a full haul of six points.
Wissa opened the scoring before turning provider for Samuel Moutoussamy to net a second on the stroke of halftime. Marshall Munetsi scored his third goal in two games late on for the hosts, but the Congolese hung on for the win.
Equatorial Guinea defeated Sierra Leone 1-0 in the other match in the group thanks to a strike from Spanish-born forward Loren Zuniga inside the first minute in neutral Yaounde.
DR Congo head Group E with six points from their two games, followed by Zimbabwe and Equatorial Guinea with three each, while Sierra Leone are yet to get off the mark.
Burkina Faso moved to the top of Group F as they defeated Central African Republic 1-0 in neutral Casablanca.
RB Salzburg teenager Aboubacar Camara scored the only goal of the game on the hour-mark in his second appearance for the senior national team.
The top two nations in each pool qualify for the 24-team continental finals that will be staged in Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania from June 19 to July 17 next year.

items.title: Reports: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson (ankle) may play Sunday
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An MRI Monday revealed a sprained left ankle for Minnesota Vikings star wide receiver Justin Jefferson, but the two-time first-team All-Pro might suit up for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins, NFL Network and ESPN reported.
items.body:
An MRI Monday revealed a sprained left ankle for Minnesota Vikings star wide receiver Justin Jefferson, but the two-time first-team All-Pro might suit up for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins, NFL Network and ESPN reported.
In Sunday's 23-16 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, the four-time Pro Bowl selection injured his ankle on a 10-yard reception near the end of Minnesota's first possession. He left the field on his own and spent part of the second quarter on the Vikings' sideline, wearing his helmet, before retreating to the locker room.
Jefferson, who finished the game with two catches for 32 yards, played in all 17 games for Minnesota in 2024 and 2025. The seven-year veteran missed seven games in 2023 with a right hamstring injury.
Through three weeks, Jefferson, 27, has collected 13 receptions for 179 yards and two touchdowns. His departure came on the same day that quarterback Kyler Murray returned to action from a concussion sustained in Week 1.
Jefferson's teammate, tight end Josh Oliver, will undergo surgery to repair a torn biceps, ESPN reported Monday. The 29-year-old has three receptions for 46 yards this season, his fourth with Minnesota and eighth in the NFL.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Clippers F Brandon Ingram (Achilles, heel) to miss start of season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Acquired from the Toronto Raptors in the Kawhi Leonard trade earlier this month, two-time All-Star forward Brandon Ingram will miss the start of the Los Angeles Clippers' season while recovering from surgery on his right heel and a partially torn Achilles tendon.
items.body:
Acquired from the Toronto Raptors in the Kawhi Leonard trade earlier this month, two-time All-Star forward Brandon Ingram will miss the start of the Los Angeles Clippers' season while recovering from surgery on his right heel and a partially torn Achilles tendon.
Ingram underwent surgery on his right heel in May, which is when doctors noticed and addressed the Achilles tendon issue, according to Clippers interim president of basketball operations Trent Redden at media day Monday.
While there is no timetable set for Ingram's return, Redden said the recovery time for the forward's partially torn Achilles tendon is "about six months less" than if it was fully torn.
Ingram, who was acquired along with guard Gradey Dick in the trade, underwent surgery after missing the last two games of Toronto's first-round loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers.
"It wasn't until we got our hands on (Ingram) here that we started to see where he was at with his progression," Redden said. "He won't be ready for the start of the season, and we'll reevaluate when we get there."
Speaking at media day, the 29-year-old Ingram said his rehabilitation is going smoothly and called his timeline a "week-by-week thing."
"I'm doing well in my recovery," the 10-year veteran said. "I'm coming along. I've been in the facility for a little more than a month now. Getting on the court a little bit and getting stronger.
"I had been dealing with some pain throughout the year with the Raptors and especially coming down in crunch time. I didn't quite know what it was. Near the end of the season, we figured out what it was. We thought surgery was the best thing to do."
Slated to earn $40 million this season, Ingram holds a player option worth $41.9 million for the 2027-28 campaign.
Projected to be the revamped Clippers' top scorer once he returns, Ingram is coming off an All-Star season in which he averaged 21.5 points, 5.6 rebounds and 3.7 assists in 77 games for the Raptors.
Los Angeles guard Darius Garland is eager for Ingram to return to the court, calling him "super crafty."
"Whenever (Ingram) comes back, when he gets out there, I think our pick-and-roll will be the No. 1 thing we go to," Garland said at media day. "I think that can be really nasty."
Guard Bradley Beal will not begin training camp on time, Redden said, as the three-time All-Star is dealing with right knee inflammation following left hip surgery.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル横ばい、中東情勢にらみ原油高　週内の主要経済指標にも注目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２８日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対しほぼ横ばいで推移した。米国とイランの対立が続く中、原油価格が上昇し、米債利回りが押し上げられた。また市場では、３０日の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数、１０月２日の米雇用統計の発表にも注目が集まる。 

中東紛争の長期化を受けてホルムズ海峡を通過する石油・ガス輸送に障害が生じる中、米国債利回りは５％を上回る数十年ぶりの高水準を維持しているが、ドルの地合いは圧迫されている。

バノックバーン・フォレックスのチーフマーケットストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「米国がイランの提案を拒否したことで原油価格が急伸し、米利回りに上昇圧力がかかり、ドル全般を押し上げている」と述べた。

スコシアバンクのショーン・オズボーン氏率いるアナリストチームは投資家向けメモで「市場の主眼は依然として原油価格だ」と指摘。「エネルギー価格の上昇幅と持続期間は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の政策担当者にとって重要な考慮事項であり、主要先進国中銀の追加引き締め観測を継続的に押し上げている」との見方を示した。 

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．２０と、約２カ月ぶり高値近辺にとどまった。

円は対ドルで１ドル＝１５７．３９円。 財務省の三村淳財務官は２８日、都内でロイターとのインタビューに応じ、円の過小評価は問題とする意向を日米両政府が共有したメッセージは「非常にクリア」との認識を示した。「市場が素直に受け止めてくれればいい」との考えも述べた。 

ユーロは対ドルで１．１３７０ドルと、約２カ月ぶり安値付近で推移した。

英ポンドは対ドルで１．３２５０ドルと横ばいで、約３カ月ぶり安値近くにとどまった。

オフショア取引で中国人民元は対ドルで小幅上昇の１ドル＝６．７１３元。トランプ氏と中国の習近平国家主席による３日間にわたる首脳会談では、多岐にわたる懸案事項について大きな進展が見られなかった。

items.title: La IA ya ayuda a crear nueva IA: expertos de OpenAI y Anthropic alertan por una “explosión de inteligencia”
items.author: Seth Fiegerman
items.summary: En un nuevo documento, más de 20 líderes e investigadores de inteligencia artificial expresaron su preocupación por una práctica emergente: utilizar IA para ayudar a automatizar el proceso de desarrol ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Altos ejecutivos de Anthropic PBC, OpenAI, Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ) y Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ) instan a los responsables políticos a revisar detenidamente hasta qué punto los sistemas de inteligencia artificial se están perfeccionando y a tomar medidas para salvaguardar la tecnología, sumándose así a los llamamientos dentro del sector para una mayor supervisión de la IA. Ver más: Trump se reúne con el CEO de Anthropic tras meses de choques por los riesgos de la IA En un nuevo documento, más de 20 líderes e investigadores de inteligencia artificial expresaron su preocupación por una práctica emergente: utilizar IA para ayudar a automatizar el proceso de desarrollo de futuros modelos. Según los autores, esto podría algún día provocar una aceleración rápida del progreso de la tecnología, un fenómeno que denominan una “explosión de inteligencia”. Según el documento, un escenario así aumentaría el riesgo de que las capacidades de la IA avancen más rápido que la capacidad de la sociedad para orientar la tecnología y adaptarse a ella. El documento fue elaborado, entre otros, por Jack Clark, cofundador de Anthropic; Jakub Pachocki, científico jefe de OpenAI; y los pioneros de la IA Geoffrey Hinton y Yoshua Bengio. Los investigadores también advirtieron que “automatizar la investigación y el desarrollo de IA podría debilitar la supervisión humana”. El documento insta a los responsables políticos a comprender mejor cómo la IA está automatizando la investigación en los principales laboratorios de IA, así como a desarrollar mecanismos para “controlar y limitar la explosión de la inteligencia artificial”, incluyendo la implementación de medidas de seguridad más estrictas y una mayor supervisión de los centros de datos involucrados en la investigación y el desarrollo automatizados de IA. El grupo también solicita a los responsables políticos que consideren planes de respuesta ante emergencias para diversos escenarios de expansión de la IA. Los principales desarrolladores de IA han intensificado recientemente sus advertencias sobre el potencial de riesgos catastróficos derivados de los futuros sistemas avanzados de IA, impulsadas por una serie de incidentes recientes relacionados con agentes de IA y por la percepción, en algunas empresas, de que la tecnología está mejorando su capacidad para perfeccionarse a sí misma. Anthropic ha declarado este mes que más de una cuarta parte de su trabajo de I+D en IA está ahora dirigido por su chatbot Claude, frente a prácticamente nada a principios de año. Según el informe publicado el lunes, las evidencias preliminares sugieren que es posible una explosión de inteligencia artificial impulsada por software. “De producirse, podría ser el desarrollo tecnológico más trascendental de la historia”. Ver más: Científicos cuestionan el alcance del hallazgo genético de Claude anunciado por Anthropic El CEO de Anthropic, Dario Amodei, publicó a principios de este mes una extensa entrada en su blog en la que instaba a la industria a apoyar un esfuerzo más amplio para ralentizar el desarrollo de los modelos más avanzados. Sam Altman, de OpenAI, y Elon Musk no tardaron en respaldar el plan de Amodei.
