items.title: French far-right leader Bardella says he has filed lawsuit over antisemitic remarks claim
items.author: Michel Rose
items.creator: Michel Rose
items.summary: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella said on Monday he had filed a defamation lawsuit against investigative website Mediapart over a report alleging he made antisemitic remarks in private messages over a decade ago, saying the story was an effort to "destabilise" campaigning ahead of next year's election.
items.body:
French far-right leader Jordan Bardella said on Monday he had filed a defamation lawsuit against investigative website Mediapart over a report alleging he made antisemitic remarks in private messages over a decade ago, saying the story was an effort to "destabilise" campaigning ahead of next year's election.
The 31-year-old leads the far-right National Rally (RN) party which is seeking to clear its racist image and build close ties with Israel. The party's candidate, Marine Le Pen, is leading polls for the April presidential election.
Mediapart, in a report published on Monday, said it had reviewed dozens of private messages from 2013 to 2015 — the early years of Bardella's career in the National Front, the forerunner of the RN — that it said showed a pattern of antisemitic and conspiratorial rhetoric.
Mediapart cited one message in which it said Bardella claimed "all the banks are owned by Jews".
The left-leaning outlet, which has a long history of unearthing political scandals in France, said it had independently authenticated the private messages. Reuters did not independently authenticate them.
Mediapart said it also drew on first-hand accounts of former party colleagues, whom it identified by first name and last initial.
Speaking on broadcaster CNews, Bardella said: "These statements are completely delusional. They are not mine."
He added, "There is clearly an attempt to destabilise the campaign, coincidentally, just months before an election where we are leading in the polls. Again, I believe the French people are not fooled. They see that everything is being done to undermine us."
Bardella has become the face of the RN's decade-long effort to "de-demonise", or normalise, its image. He was the party's de facto presidential candidate until July, when an appeals court cleared Le Pen to hold elected office after a conviction over misuse of funds. Bardella will be France's prime minister if she wins next year's vote.
French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot wrote in a post on social media platform X: "To all those with short memories: antisemitism is not a mere blip for the RN; it is the very history of this party. This is the true face of the far right."
Le Pen, speaking with reporters on Monday, said she believed the report could "only be a fake, a manipulation, a dirty trick".
A [USN:L6N45K0G1 TEXT:"Monday poll"] showed her coming first in next April's first-round vote and beating both leftist and centrist candidates in a May runoff.
A slew of antisemitic, Islamophobic and racist comments by some RN candidates derailed the party's hopes of winning a parliamentary majority in France's legislative vote in 2024. Bardella at the time pledged to avoid such "casting errors" in the future by systematically kicking out any candidates with a history of toxic statements.

items.title: 韓国、ウクライナ代理大使に抗議　北朝鮮の捕虜移送公表に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Heekyong Yang　Jack Kim

[ソウル ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Heekyong Yang　Jack Kim

[ソウル ２８日 ロイター] - 韓国外務省は２８日、北朝鮮兵捕虜の韓国への移送をウクライナ側が公表したことを受け、在韓国ウクライナ大使館のアンドリー・ベシキン代理大使を呼び出して抗議した。公式な説明と謝罪も求めた。両国間で非公表とするとの明確な合意があったと主張。ウクライナに対し、強い遺憾の意を表明したと述べた。

ゼレンスキー大統領は先週の国連総会の演説で、ロシア側として戦って捕虜となった北朝鮮兵２人を韓国に引き渡したと述べていた。韓国大統領府も２７日、ウクライナに対して公式な説明と謝罪を要求していた。

韓国外務省は、非公表とする合意はなかったとするウクライナ大統領府の説明についても「虚偽の声明」だとして抗議し、再発防止のための措置を講じるよう求めたと表明。

韓国メディアの報道によると、ベシキン氏は韓国の立場を正確に伝えると述べたという。

トランプ米大統領はこのところ、北朝鮮との対話への意欲を見せ、韓国も支持する考えを示している。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２８日 ロイター] - カタールの仲介団が２８日か２９日に、ニューヨークでイランのアラグチ外相と、また別途米国側と協議する見通しだと、交渉について説明を受けた当局者がロイターに明らかにした。戦争終結に向けた新たな取り組みとなる。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた同当局者によると、協議では、イランが先週、国連総会に合わせて提示した７日間の計画の修正案が焦点となる見通し。

アラグチ氏は国連総会への出席後もニューヨークに滞在している。仲介団との協議に米国側から誰が出席するかは、現時点では不明。

イランの準国営ＩＳＮＡ通信はその後、アラグチ氏がニューヨーク時間２８日午前に米国で仲介団と会談すると確認した。双方は「現状に関する最新の提案や見解を検討する」という。

一方、イラン外務省のバガイ報道官は２８日、その後国営メディアに対し、アラグチ氏のニューヨーク滞在は延長されておらず、当初の予定通りテヘランに戻ると述べた。仲介団との協議についてはコメントしなかった。

＜トランプ氏、今週の追加協議を示唆＞

イランの７日間の計画は、イランとレバノンでの全ての敵対行為の停止、数十億ドル相当のイラン資産の凍結解除、イラン産原油に対する制裁の解除、米国によるイランの港湾封鎖の解除を想定している。

その上でイランはホルムズ海峡の再開を認め、米国とイランはイランの核開発計画を巡る協議も再開する。

トランプ米大統領は２６日、イランの提案を拒否したと表明。イランは深刻な経済的圧力にさらされているため、早期の合意を望んでいると述べた。

ただ、２７日には米ニュースサイトのアクシオスに対し、米交渉団が今週、さらなる協議に臨むとの見通しも示した。

items.title: Trump's AI meeting with tech CEOs to focus on finding balance, US House speaker says
items.author: Katharine Jackson, Karen Freifeld
items.creator: Katharine Jackson, Karen Freifeld
items.summary: President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology.
items.body:
President Donald Trump's meeting with tech CEOs on artificial intelligence on Tuesday will focus on finding a balance between innovation and oversight, House Speaker Mike Johnson said, as the federal government seeks to define its role in the burgeoning technology.
"We do not need a moratorium. We do not need to jump in and hyper-regulate this, because we'll lose the race to China," Johnson said in an interview on Monday with Fox Business Network. "The innovation is important to continue, but we have to strike the right balance. That's what the conversation is going to be about."
Meta's Mark Zuckerberg, Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Greg Brockman and Nvidia's Jensen Huang are among those who will attend Tuesday's meeting with Trump and Johnson, according to sources familiar with the matter. Other possible attendees include Google CEO Sundar Pichai and SpacexAI executive Elon Musk.
The White House meeting comes as leading AI companies are calling for slowing development of increasingly capable AI systems, warning of the risks to humanity and appealing for governments to work together to manage the increasingly powerful technology.
Trump has downplayed concerns over the misuse of artificial intelligence harming people as he stressed the importance of maintaining America's competitive edge over China. He says the US already has [USN:L6N45E0R5 TEXT:"guardrails in place"] for the powerful technology, including at the Department of Justice.
Johnson said the US should be mindful of safety but not stymie the technology's development. "I think there may be a role for the DOJ if things go awry. But what we need before we get to that stage is transparency, and we need some oversight," he said on "Mornings with Fox Business."
[USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"Lawmakers"] in both parties have questioned Trump's hands-off approach even as the technology raises fears about safety, job losses and the concentration of power among a handful of tech companies.
House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries said AI industry leaders were pleading for some government action and Congress has a responsibility to protect the American people.
"So, when it comes to AI safety, it certainly seems to me that we need to actually lean in boldly and responsibly — now," Jeffries told CNBC on Monday.
The president had dinner with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on Sunday.
Anthropic and its rivals have called for slowing AI development. These include OpenAI, Google’s (GOOGL.O) DeepMind, Microsoft (MSFT.O) and xAI.

items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）のラガルド総裁は、債券利回りの上昇が景気拡大を抑えるとともに、エネルギーコスト上昇がインフレに波及するのを限定するとの見方を示した。

ラガルド氏は28日、欧州議会の公聴会で「成長は底堅さを維持しているものの、前回会合以降、長期金利は大幅に上昇した。これにより成長は鈍化し、インフレへの波及も9月の見通しで予想した以上に抑えられるだろう」と述べた。

これまでのところ二次的な影響は見られておらず、ECBは「インフレを抑制するため、必要に応じて慎重に対応すべきだ」と、同氏は語った。

ECB当局者は、インフレを抑制し、エネルギー価格の上昇が幅広い物価や賃上げ要求に波及するのを防ぐため、追加利上げの必要性を検討している。

中東での紛争に加え、ECB当局者は世界的な債券売りにも対応を迫られている。これは、財政が逼迫（ひっぱく）している一部のユーロ圏加盟国にとって特に懸念材料となっている。

items.title: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane (ACL) out for season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Miami Dolphins placed running back De'Von Achane on season-ending injured reserve Monday.
items.body:
The Miami Dolphins placed running back De'Von Achane on season-ending injured reserve Monday.
Achane tore the ACL in his left knee, ESPN reported, on his third rushing attempt in the Dolphins' 24-10 setback against the Kansas City Chiefs in Miami Gardens, Fla. He hobbled off the field after being tackled awkwardly by safety Alohi Gilman.
"My heart breaks for the guy," Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Monday. "You talk about him as a great player but since I've gotten to know him, watching him grow and develop and earning the captain role, becoming the leader of a team, becoming such great energy, such a great teammate, I mean, I just love his energy. I love his enthusiasm. I love his positivity."
Achane finished with 17 yards rushing on three carries, and no receptions on one target. For the season, he has rushed for 127 yards on 34 attempts with no touchdowns in three games. He has seven catches for 49 yards and no scores.
Second-year pro Ollie Gordon replaced Achane as the lead back for the Dolphins (0-3) and rushed for 41 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries.
"Everybody has to step up. There are going to be great opportunities," Hafley said, mentioning both Gordon and receiver Malik Washington, who rushed for 110 yards and a touchdown last season.
Achane posted career highs with 1,350 rushing yards and 1,838 yards from scrimmage and made his first Pro Bowl last season. A third-round pick by Miami in 2023, he has 4,510 yards from scrimmage and 35 touchdowns through 47 career games (39 starts).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Gautam Adani, 4 group companies settle matter with Sebi on MPS norms
items.author: Khushboo Tiwari
items.summary: Gautam Adani, four Adani group firms and 13 others paid a cumulative ₹1.48 crore to settle proceedings over alleged non-compliance with minimum public shareholding norms.
items.body: Four Adani group companies, its chairman Gautam Adani, and 13 others have settled proceedings with the market regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) by paying a cumulative sum of ₹1.48 crore under the settlement regulations. This is the third settlement order this month by Sebi involving the coal-to-port conglomerate. The matter pertained to alleged non-compliance with the minimum public shareholding requirements for certain listed companies. The market regulator had issued a show-cause notice in the matter in September 2024—following examinations stemming from certain complaints during June and July 2020. Based on the preliminary examination, Sebi had initiated investigations in October 2020 involving Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone, and Adani Energy Solutions (earlier Adani Transmission). A supplementary show-cause notice was sent to the entities in March 2025, following which the companies filed settlement applications—without admitting or denying Sebi’s findings. Along with the group firms, the settlement order also disposes of proceedings against Adani Enterprises Managing Director Rajesh Adani and board member Pranav Adani, among others. Sebi’s internal committee had informed the companies about the revised terms of settlement in May this year, while the high-powered advisory committee agreed to the terms in June. With the settlement amount remitted in August 2026, the market regulator has disposed of the proceedings against the companies and the individuals. Last week, five companies of the Adani group settled adjudication proceedings with Sebi for ₹1.51 crore over an alleged lapse in the disclosure of related-party transactions. The case had originated from Sebi’s examination into allegations of undisclosed related-party transactions (RPTs) and corporate governance lapses flagged in a report by the now-defunct Hindenburg Research. Earlier this month, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) Managing Director Karan Adani and Chief Financial Officer B Ravi settled adjudication proceedings with the market regulator in a matter involving PMC Projects. Under the settlement mechanism, both paid ₹13.65 lakh each, following which the proceedings were disposed of. The settlement order on September 10 had stated that the investigations were in respect of the banking transactions and inter-corporate security deposits among PMC Projects (India), APSEZ and its subsidiaries. Last year in September, Sebi had closed proceedings against Adani group companies, group Chairman Gautam Adani, and associated entities facing accusations of fund diversion, violations of related-party transaction (RPT) norms, and fraud. In two separate orders, the regulator had exculpated the group in the matter of allegations made by short-seller Hindenburg Research in 2023, effectively bringing the curtains down on the saga that had triggered a ₹12 trillion market-cap rout at the business group.

LONDON, Sept 28 : Bridgepoint and Astorg are considering selling Fenergo as dealmaking in the sector picks up, three people familiar with the matter said, with one saying the Irish fintech could be valued at more than £2 billion ($2.7 billion).
The private equity firms have held discussions with potential buyers and are expected to appoint an investment bank later this year in a potential transaction that could attract strategic bidders, the sources told Reuters. 
A sales process could be launched early in 2027, with a decision yet to be taken, said two of the sources.
Bridgepoint and Astorg both declined to comment. Dublin-based Fenergo did not respond to a request for comment.

Fenergo develops software that helps more than 300 of the world's largest banks and insurers comply with regulatory requirements and manage client lifecycle processes, including onboarding, know-your-customer checks and data management.
The potential deal highlights a pickup in tech dealmaking despite a selloff in software stocks earlier this year. 
Thoma Bravo is exploring a sale of Foundation Software, Vista Equity Partners is considering selling banking software provider Finastra and healthcare software company Waystar is weighing its options, Reuters reported earlier this month. 
Fenergo, founded and led by CEO Mark Murphy, is expected to attract interest from information services companies and exchange operators, the sources said.
Astorg and Bridgepoint acquired Fenergo from Insight Partners in 2021 for an undisclosed sum.
The company has also sought to capitalise on demand for AI tools, launching an agentic AI orchestration platform designed to automate workflows such as onboarding and periodic reviews.
Its total revenue rose by 7.5 per cent to €149.4 million ($170 million) for the year ending in March 2025, driven by more subscription revenue and client renewals for its software products. Operating profit increased 66 per cent to €20.9 million.

items.title: ECB eyes new currency safety nets to boost euro's global role
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing.
items.body:
The European Central Bank plans to expand currency safety nets to make it easier for foreign central banks to borrow euros, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday, in a bid to strengthen the single currency's global standing.
The [USN:L4N3ZA02V TEXT:"push"] comes amid concerns over financial fragmentation and [USN:L4N44P02A TEXT:"growing uncertainty"] around the future of the US dollar under President Donald Trump.
Lagarde said the ECB would work on swap lines, which act as a source of emergency liquidity at times of crisis by allowing foreign central banks to borrow euros in exchange for their own currency.
"We will be working on swap lines that will be more responsive to the imperative of having a sovereign euro area and a strong euro," Lagarde told European lawmakers.
Swap lines relieve pressure on foreign borrowers but also prevent stress abroad from spilling over into the euro area. The ECB has such arrangements with the US Federal Reserve and the central banks of Japan, Britain, Canada and Switzerland.
The move is part of an ongoing ECB effort to expand the euro's international footprint.
The ECB [USN:L8N41L3LR TEXT:"has received"] nearly 30 applications for a separate lending facility - known as repurchase agreements or repo - that allows foreign banks to borrow against euro collateral.
Central bank officials and investors worry that the US Federal Reserve might eventually cut its own [USN:L8N41Y0WB TEXT:"swap lines"], which currently serve as the main global lifeline for trillions of dollars in foreign loans.

Sept 28 : Anthropic will not appear before an Australian senate committee hearing on AI on October 1, a source familiar with the matter said, days after a disclosure that an agent from OpenAI gained unauthorized access to the country's health system database.
The Claude-parent has sought another date, the person who declined to be named, said as the invitation came late last week. OpenAI too cited the same reason and said it could not arrange for its executives to appear in the short time frame.
The senate inquiry is examining the potential impacts of AI and data centers on Australian communities, industries, water and energy. It is one of several state and federal probes into AI.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei were sent written requests to appear before the senate inquiry in Canberra, after the Medicare hack.

items.title: Wall Street cae mientras el petróleo se dispara tras el rechazo de Trump a propuesta de paz
items.author: Johann Cherian, Chuck Mikolajczak
items.creator: Johann Cherian, Chuck Mikolajczak
items.summary: Wall Street cayó el lunes presionada por un aumento de los precios del petróleo y de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, mientras los inversionistas sopesaban la las perspectivas de un acuerdo de paz en la guerra de Irán y el impacto en la trayectoria de las tasas de la Reserva Federal.
items.body:
Wall Street cayó el lunes presionada por un aumento de los precios del petróleo y de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, mientras los inversionistas sopesaban la las perspectivas de un acuerdo de paz en la guerra de Irán y el impacto en la trayectoria de las tasas de la Reserva Federal.
Los precios del crudo se dispararon después de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, rechazó un acuerdo de paz propuesto por Irán, pero recortaron sus ganancias por las expectativas de que los mediadores de Qatar mantuvieran conversaciones con ambos países para alcanzar un posible acuerdo.
Tras retroceder desde los máximos alcanzados a principios de mes, los precios del petróleo han acelerado su alza en los últimos días, en la medida en que las esperanzas de que se alcance un acuerdo de paz en un futuro próximo se diluyen.
El aumento de los precios del crudo y del gasóleo ha avivado el temor a la inflación y ha impulsado al alza los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, junto con los comentarios de responsables de la Fed que indican que podrían ser necesarias más subidas de tasas.
"Irán está impulsando los precios del petróleo, los precios del petróleo están impulsando la inflación, y la inflación está impulsando las tasas de interés", dijo Jack Ablin, estratega jefe de inversiones y socio fundador de Cresset Capital Management.
"Estamos llegando a un punto en el que las tasas de interés parecen bastante atractivas en comparación con la renta variable, lo cual es realmente la primera vez en casi 20 años, así que es algo a lo que sin duda estamos prestando atención", agregó.
Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 59,00 puntos, o un 0,76%, a 7.684,41 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) bajó 246,62 puntos, o un 0,91%, a 26.822,09. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 343,78 puntos, o un 0,66%, a 51.484,84 unidades.
Las acciones de Boeing (BA.N) se desplomaron después de que el administrador de la Administración Federal de Aviación (FAA), Bryan Bedford, dijo que los problemas de software del 737 MAX del fabricante de aviones retrasarán la certificación de la variante más grande, el MAX 10, hasta que la agencia esté "convencida de que no hay ningún problema".
El avance de las acciones de Nvidia (NVDA.O) contribuyó a frenar las caídas, después de que el gigante de los chips anunció una autorización de recompra de acciones de 150.000 millones de dólares, la mayor de la historia de la empresa.

items.title: スペースＸの「スターシップ」、初の軌道到達　衛星26基展開
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joey Roulette

[スターベース（米テキサス州） ２８日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸ
items.body:
Joey Roulette

[スターベース（米テキサス州） ２８日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸ は２８日、次世代ロケット「スターシップ」を米テキサス州から打ち上げた。同社として初めて地球の周回軌道に到達し、衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の人工衛星の第一弾を展開した。ただ、飛行中のエンジントラブルにより、約１０時間を予定していたミッションは大幅に短縮され、帰還時には炎を伴い太平洋に着水した。

スターシップは飛行中にエンジン１基が予定より早く停止するトラブルが発生したものの、軌道に乗ることに成功。軌道到達後は、計画された高度約２６９キロ付近で衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の次世代衛星２６基の展開を開始した。

マスク氏は「スターリンクＶ３衛星２６基全てが正常に稼働している」とＸに投稿した。

ただ、ミッションは３時間に短縮された。太平洋への着水時には、海面接触の際に下部が炎に包まれた後横倒しとなり、大きな炎が上がった。今回のミッションでは、着水後の機体回収は計画されていなかった。

当初の計画では、これまでで最長となる約１０時間の飛行で地球を６周した後、南米チリ沖に着水することになっていた。

また、打ち上げに使用された第１段ブースター「スーパーヘビー」はメキシコ湾の水域で、エンジン制御による着水が行われた。

今回の飛行試験は１４回目。スペースＸが２０２３年以降に実施したこれまでの１３回の打ち上げはいずれも軌道到達に至らなかった。マスク氏は早ければ今年後半にも、スターシップの定期的な運用を開始したい考えを示している。

米株式市場で、スペースＸ株は一時上昇したものの、その後は下げに転じ、約１．５％安で推移した。

items.title: Giants OLB Brian Burns (ACL) to miss rest of season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New York Giants star edge rusher Brian Burns tore his right ACL during Sunday's victory against Tennessee and will miss the rest of the season, coach John Harbaugh confirmed Monday.
items.body:
New York Giants star edge rusher Brian Burns tore his right ACL during Sunday's victory against Tennessee and will miss the rest of the season, coach John Harbaugh confirmed Monday.
Burns sustained a knee injury in the fourth quarter of the 12-7 win against the Titans in East Rutherford, N.J. He went to the ground after being blocked by Austin Schlottmann and grabbed his right leg before eventually limping off the field.
Burns' absence is another devastating blow for the Giants (2-1), who lost starting quarterback Jaxson Dart to a season-ending knee injury in Week 2.
"Yeah, big challenge for us," Harbaugh said. "I mean, not just a great player, which he is. I mean, in many ways the leader of the defense, I would say, just as a veteran leader and star player, also a worker, out-front kind of guy in everything he does.
"Just, you hate to see it. I mean, and really for him, too. I mean, he was just such a rock for us. Freaky play, kind of turning the corner, puts his foot in the ground, gets hit from the side right at the same time. Again, doesn't look much like these knee injuries sometimes, most of the time don't, these crazy contact injuries. So, just a tough deal, but it's one we've got to deal with."
Burns, 28, finished second in the NFL with a career-high 16.5 sacks last season. He recorded four tackles and two quarterback hits in three games (two starts) this season, his third with New York.
Burns signed a five-year, $141 million contract with the Giants after being acquired in a March 2024 trade with the Carolina Panthers.
The three-time Pro Bowl selection has tallied 71 sacks, 146 QB hits, 388 tackles and 13 forced fumbles in 117 games (103 starts) with the Panthers (2019-23) and Giants. Carolina drafted him with the 16th overall pick in 2019.
--Field Level Media

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sinéad Carew

[２８日　ロイター] - ２８日の米国債利回りは上昇し、３０年債利回りは一時、２００４年５月中旬以来の高水準を付けた。トランプ米大統領がイランの和平案を拒否したことを受けて原油価格が急伸し、インフレ長期化と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げへの警戒感が高まった。

１０年債利回りも一時、０７年６月中旬以来の高水準を付けた。３０年債利回り、１０年債利回りとも、その後上昇幅を縮小した。 

トランプ氏が２６日、ホルムズ海峡を再開し中東での戦闘を終結させるとするイランの提案を拒否したと表明したことを背景に、米原油先物は約２％上昇。

１０年債利回りも一時、０７年６月中旬以来の高水準を付けた。３０年債利回り、１０年債利回りとも、その後上昇幅を縮小した。 

トランプ氏が２６日、ホルムズ海峡を再開し中東での戦闘を終結させるとするイランの提案を拒否したと表明したことを背景に、米原油先物は約２％上昇。 これを受け、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込むＦＲＢが１０月に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の追加利上げを実施する確率は６８％と、２５日の６４％から上昇。１２月の追加利上げ観測も強まった。 

ＬＰＬファイナンシャルのチーフ債券ストラテジスト、ローレンス・ギラム氏は「トランプ氏が中東停戦案を拒否したことで原油価格が再び上昇している。イランを巡る紛争の不確実性が残る限り、債券利回りには上昇圧力がかかり続ける公算が大きい」と指摘。「原油高は今後のインフレ指標に波及する。市場は今後１２カ月にわたるＦＲＢの利上げサイクルを織り込んでいる」と述べた。

items.title: Florida asks court to bar OpenAI from developing new models as part of child harm lawsuit
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Sept 28 : Florida's attorney general asked a judge on Monday to bar OpenAI from developing new artificial intelligence models without outside oversight as part of its lawsuit accusing the company of harming children.Florida sued OpenAI in June accusing the company of misrepresenting the safety of its ChatGPT

Florida asks court to bar OpenAI from developing new models as part of child harm lawsuit

Sept 28 : Florida's attorney general asked a judge on Monday to bar OpenAI from developing new artificial intelligence models without outside oversight as part of its lawsuit accusing the company of harming children.
Florida sued OpenAI in June accusing the company of misrepresenting the safety of its ChatGPT platform, saying it has harmed children by providing information to school shooters, offering guidance on self-harm and addicting young users. 
Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier in Monday's filing also asked the court to order OpenAI to keep minors off ChatGPT and bar the company from giving its chat platform “human attributes.”
Drew Pusateri, a spokesperson for OpenAI, said in a statement that the company had paused training its most capable models and won't resume until they have additional safeguards in place.

"Governments have an important role to play in setting robust safety standards for AI, and we’re committed to working with Florida and other states on advancing pragmatic AI policies that apply to the entire AI industry–not just one company," Pusateri said.
The filing cites recent comments from a former OpenAI employee and a current board member of the company, claiming that AI development could lead to the end of humankind and must be slowed down.
“Defendants claim they cannot stop barreling forward with their potentially civilization-ending endeavors unless they are forced to do so by the government,” Florida wrote in Monday’s filing. “They have asked the government to tie them to the mast.” 
Uthmeier, a Republican, is the first state attorney general to sue OpenAI over its impact on young users. The company is also facing lawsuits brought by individuals and families who say ChatGPT led people to harm themselves or others.
Florida's lawsuit was prompted by a shooting at a Tallahassee university last year and a number of events in other states where ChatGPT allegedly provided information to people who went on to commit violent acts.
The company has denied it should be liable in those cases. It has said the chatbot provides information broadly available online, and that it continues to update its safety tools.
OpenAI and other AI companies are also facing questions about what kind of liability they could face for rogue AI attacks by their models, amid reports that some have attempted to hack into the websites of governmental agencies and companies. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: Activos argentinos redoblan debilidad en inicio de semana, temor a recesión
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los mercados financieros de Argentina profundizaron su tendencia de debilidad el lunes por la firmeza del riesgo país y la retracción inversora ante datos flojos de la macroeconomía, que producen temor a una recesión.
items.body:
Los mercados financieros de Argentina profundizaron su tendencia de debilidad el lunes por la firmeza del riesgo país y la retracción inversora ante datos flojos de la macroeconomía, que producen temor a una recesión.
El Gobierno reportó la semana pasada una fuerte caída en el [USN:ZON00GJPU TEXT:"consumo"] y un aumento en los niveles de [USN:S0N44F01B TEXT:"pobreza"], lo que alienta fantasmas de recesión a un año de las elecciones presidenciales.
A esto se suma la suba gradual del dólar y la perspectiva de otra alza en las tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed), lo que conspira contra la liquidez de los mercados emergentes.
El nivel del riesgo país se movía en los 636 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), un máximo en 10 meses, y el peso mayorista finalmente quedó equilibrado a 1.525 por dólar , tras anotar su piso récord intradiario en 1.535 unidades.
Desde el banco central (BCRA) se registró una intervención compradora de 11 millones de dólares.
"En la economía se confirma el clima recesivo: nuevos indicadores ilustran sobre la coyuntura con una caída en el consumo (...) y una medición de la pobreza alcista que confirmó las sensaciones negativas", sintetizó VatNet Financial Research.
La bolsa de Buenos Aires cedió un 3,28% al cierre en el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) y arrastró su séptima baja consecutiva, con un acumulado del 8,58% en dicho lapso con la salida de fondos de inversión.
Este contexto impactó sobre los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles con un pérdida del 0,8% en promedio, contra un derrumbe del 3,1% durante la semana previa.
"La suba reciente del riesgo país y la presión observada sobre la curva de deuda soberana responden a una interacción de factores donde el frente internacional actúa como el principal disparador, combinándose en el plano doméstico con datos de actividad económica más débiles y un menor ritmo de compras netas de reservas", dijo Eric Ritondale, economista jefe de Puente.
El gigante estadounidense JP. Morgan redujo recientemente a 1,5% su proyección de crecimiento económico para Argentina este año, cuando la gestión del libertario Javier Milei proyectó un avance del 3%.
El propio Milei descartó la proyección de una recesión durante una entrevista televisiva el domingo por la noche, aduciendo que hay datos estadísticos incorrectos.
Mientras tanto, el Tesoro desarrollará durante el lunes una licitación de deuda en la que enfrenta vencimientos por unos 8,1 billones de pesos (unos 5.300 millones de dólares).
El menú ofertado consiste en una letra "Lecap" corta (S13N6), una "Lecer" (X29E7), dos "Bontam" (TMF27 y TML27) y cuatro "dollar linked" (D30O6, D30N6, D31M7 y TZV27).
Como sucedió en las dos licitaciones de agosto, el Tesoro no pone a disposición papeles con vencimiento en el próximo mandato presidencial, desde diciembre del 2027 en adelante.

items.title: India regulator allows Adani, four group firms to settle public-float violations case
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India's market regulator on Monday allowed Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies to settle proceedings on alleged regulatory lapses related to a 25% minimum public shareholding requirement.
items.body:
India's market regulator on Monday allowed Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani and four group companies to settle proceedings on alleged regulatory lapses related to a 25% minimum public shareholding requirement.
The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said four Adani companies and 14 company directors, including Gautam Adani, had settled the proceedings by paying a total of 14.82 million rupees ($154,403.15).
In a separate order, the regulator said it has disposed of its case against the group claiming certain promoter holdings were categorised as public holdings.
SEBI said it could not establish that investments made through two offshore funds and another public shareholder were directed by Vinod Adani, brother of Gautam Adani.
In a regulatory filing late on Monday, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited said the settlement was reached without admission or denial of SEBI's findings and would have no material financial impact.
In 2020, SEBI had received complaints against the group's flagship company Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone and Adani Transmission — now known as Adani Energy Solutions — claiming they were not in compliance with its minimum public float rules.
In its notices to the companies and Adani, the regulator had alleged violations of the public shareholding requirements and related shareholding disclosure rules.
However, the settlement order does not require the companies to make any corrective shareholding disclosures, nor does it contain a regulatory finding on the alleged violations.
The probe was part of the 24 investigations SEBI had undertaken after US-based short-seller Hindenburg alleged in 2023 that Adani group companies manipulated their stock prices through tax havens. Adani Group had denied the allegations.
SEBI has since allowed the group [USN:L4N45E0QA TEXT:"to settle several"] cases in the last year, although probes are still pending into whether certain Adani Group offshore investors circumvented Indian rules and whether there was manipulation in the trading of the group's shares.
The case disposed of on Monday centred on SEBI's investigations into whether offshore funds whose investments in Adani Group firms were funded largely through entities linked to two individuals — Nasser Ali Shaban Ahli and Chang Chung-Ling — were acting under the direction or control of Vinod Adani.
The regulator's final order concluded there was insufficient evidence that Vinod Adani controlled investment decisions of the funds, including Emerging India Focus Funds and EM Resurgent Fund.
However, SEBI fined Ahli and Ling 2 million rupees each for failing to furnish correct and complete information during the investigation.
($1 = 95.9825 Indian rupees)

items.title: US says GM tech costs to drop by $20 billion through 2031 due to new emissions rules
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: General Motors will see its technology costs decline by $20.4 billion through 2031 as a result of drastically lower vehicle fuel economy rules finalized Monday, the US Transportation Department said.
items.body:
General Motors (GM.N) will see its technology costs decline by $20.4 billion through 2031 as a result of drastically lower vehicle fuel economy rules finalized Monday, the US Transportation Department said.
In total, the Trump administration estimates automakers' technology costs will decline by $60.6 billion through 2031, or about $1,289 per vehicle, as a result. The 2024 fuel economy rules had been estimated to cost GM $31.7 billion through 2031.
The new rule is expected to take effect around early December. Automakers will not need to add expensive emissions equipment to reduce fuel consumption or build more EVs, as they would have had to under the prior rule in order to meet more stringent requirements.
The department's National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said Chrysler-parent Stellantis's (STLAM.MI) costs will decline by $6.6 billion, Ford (F.N) by $5.8 billion, Toyota (7203.T) by $4.5 billion and Honda (7267.T) by $4.1 billion.
GM said it supports the goals of the rule and its "intention to better align fuel economy standards with market realities."
Last year, Congress passed legislation ending penalties for not meeting fuel economy requirements after Stellantis paid about $775 million in civil penalties for failing to meet US fuel economy requirements since 2019.
GM paid $128.2 million in penalties for 2016 and 2017. GM also paid a $145.8 million penalty and forfeited fuel economy credits worth hundreds of millions of dollars at the time after a government investigation found excess emissions from approximately 5.9 million GM vehicles.
In 2023, under former President Joe Biden, NHTSA said its proposal to hike fuel economy standards through 2032 would cost the industry $14 billion in projected fines including $6.5 billion for GM, $3 billion for Stellantis and $1 billion for Ford Motor (F.N) .
The final rule adopted in 2024 eased requirements and said the auto industry would face no more than $1.83 billion in fines from 2027 through 2031.

items.title: メタ、法人向けのAI事業に参入－責任者にモンゴDBのCEOを起用
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米メタ・プラットフォームズは、法人顧客向けの新たなAIプラットフォームを率いる責任者に、データベースソフトウエアを手掛けるモンゴDBの社長兼最高経営責任者（CEO）を起用した。マーク・ザッカーバーグCEOは同事業を「次の主要な柱」と位置付けている。

チランタン・CJ・デサイ氏がチーフ・エンタープライズ・プラットフォーム・オフィサーに就任し、法人向けの新たなAIサービスを統括すると、ザッカーバーグ氏が28日、X（旧ツイッター）への投稿で明らかにした。

新事業「メタ・エンタープライズ・プラットフォーム」は、企業がAIを活用して成長し、新たな形で変革を遂げるのを支援する。ザッカーバーグ氏は、高度なモデルやAIエージェント、AIインフラに加え、「多くの企業と長年緊密に協力してきた経験」など、メタの強みを生かすと説明した。

モンゴDB株はニューヨーク市場の取引開始後、一時27%安の300.45ドルまで急落した。マイクロソフトやセールスフォース、サービスナウなど企業向けソフトウエア株も下落。メタ株も売られている。

モンゴDBは28日、取締役会がデブ・イティチェリア氏を暫定社長兼CEOに復帰させたと発表した。同氏は2014年から2025年まで両職を務めていた。取締役会は、デサイ氏の正式な後任選びに着手した。

items.title: ＥＣＢの緩やかな利上げ継続適切、インフレの二次的効果見られず＝総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [フランクフルト　２８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[フランクフルト　２８日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は２８日、今年のインフレはユーロ圏全体に危険な二次的効果をまだ生み出していないため、ＥＣＢとして緩やかな政策対応が引き続き適切だとの認識を示した。欧州議会の委員会公聴会で述べた。

ユーロ圏のインフレ率はすでに３％を超えており、年末までにＥＣＢの目標の倍となる４％に近づく可能性がある。市場では、夏場に実施された２回の利上げに加え、来年にかけて最大４回の追加利上げが必要になるとの見方が広がっている。

ただ、ラガルド氏は市場の一部の積極的な利上げ観測をけん制する姿勢を示し、米・イラン紛争に起因する原油・ガス価格の高騰が物価上昇の主な要因であると指摘。

その上で「今後、インフレ率の上昇が見込まれるが、それが定着しつつある兆候はまだ見られない」とし、「現段階では、エネルギー価格が賃金上昇に波及している証拠は見当たらない」と述べた。

さらに「今回のショックは一時的なものとして受け止めるには大きすぎる一方、われわれはインフレを抑制するには慎重な対応が適切であると見ている」と言及。一方で、インフレ指標は上振れリスクに傾いており、見通しを巡る不確実性は極めて高いことを認めた。

「慎重な対応」の定義は明確ではないものの、エコノミストによると、３カ月間隔で実施された最初の２回の利上げが目安になるという。

ラガルド氏は、経済動向については楽観的な見方を維持。製造業は堅調に推移し、労働市場も底堅く、投資も成長を支えるはずだと述べた。

そのほかラガルド氏は、エネルギー高騰を相殺するためのユーロ圏各国政府による財政支援は拡大しており、政策当局者が期待していたほど一時的でも的を絞ったものでもないと指摘。「ユーロ圏全体で見ると、支援規模はユーロ圏域内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比０．１％ポイント程度に達している」とし、「これは３カ月前に測定された０．０３％ポイントから増加しており、必ずしも一時的でも、的を絞ったものでもない」と述べた。

ラガルド氏はさらに、海外の中央銀行がユーロを借り入れやすくするため、通貨のセーフティーネットを拡大する方針を表明。具体策として、危機時に海外中銀が自国通貨と引き換えにユーロを借り入れることを可能にする「スワップライン（通貨スワップ）」の拡充に取り組むとし、「主権あるユーロ圏と強いユーロを確保するという喫緊の課題により機敏に応えられるようなスワップラインの拡充を進めていく」と述べた。

スワップラインは海外の借り手の資金調達圧力を和らげると同時に、海外でのストレスがユーロ圏に波及するのを防ぐ役割も果たす。ＥＣＢは現在、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）や日銀、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）、カナダ銀行（中央銀行）、スイス国立銀行（中央銀行）との間でこうした取り決めを結んでいる。

items.title: Fed watchdog flags apparent data breaches by retiring staff member
items.author: Michael Derby
items.creator: Michael Derby
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve’s in-house watchdog said on Monday that a former staff member was found multiple times trying to remove confidential information before retiring from the central bank, but these apparent breaches did not ultimately trigger a formal misconduct finding.
items.body:
The US Federal Reserve’s in-house watchdog said on Monday that a former staff member was found multiple times trying to remove confidential information before retiring from the central bank, but these apparent breaches did not ultimately trigger a formal misconduct finding.
The Fed’s Inspector General said in a report that the departing employee served in the central bank’s Division of International Finance and retired from the central bank in July 2024. The Fed’s IG did not respond to a request to provide the identity of the employee flagged in the report. The Fed’s Board of Governors did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The IG said that despite the “potential severity” of the incident, its internal investigators “reviewed this matter for potential misconduct and determined that there was not a sufficient basis to pursue this incident as a misconduct investigation.”
That was because “available records did not provide a clear indication of what information the employee had removed before their departure” and “many” of the alerts involving the information “were, in fact, false positives,” the IG said.
“The specific details regarding this incident help to illustrate the systemic concerns” about how the Fed manages the exit process of central bank employees with access to confidential policymaking information, the IG report said.
Breakdowns in the process highlighted by the “potential incident” involving the retiring employee require “the Board's immediate attention so that it can take appropriate corrective actions.”
In the report, the IG said the Fed concurred with recommendations to improve how data for exiting employees is handled. It said it has taken steps to better communicate policies around data management and is working to improve how violations of policies are addressed.
INFORMATION LEAK The IG report recounted a series of incidents as the staffer headed to retirement. It flagged alerts involving information handling that occurred “three days before the employee took what we understood to be a personal trip to a restricted country, which was followed by a separate personal month-long international trip.” That trip to the unnamed restricted country took place in June 2024.
The IG said it became aware of the issues around the retiring employee in July 2025. The report said this employee was first flagged for copying confidential Federal Open Market Committee files to an unencrypted USB drive in 2021, and that the employee claimed this had been done mistakenly.
In 2023, this employee attempted to email to a personal address more confidential FOMC files, which the employee claimed was “inadvertent," the report said, adding the employee was again flagged in the same year for copying classified files to an unencrypted USB drive.
Before leaving, the IG said the retiring employee had generated a series of alerts “because of printing, copying data to a notepad application, sending potentially sensitive information in emails to multiple personal email addresses, and transferring potentially sensitive files to a Board-issued unencrypted USB device.”
The employee removed the information without seeking approval, despite “previously being informed" of how data should be handled and managed and stored, the IG said.
The watchdog said that when it comes to this series of incidents, "the failures involved a collective lack of action across multiple divisions, and the limited follow-up activities that did occur were not commensurate with the accumulation of risks in this situation."
The Fed watchdog investigates internal issues faced by the central bank and has played a prominent role in recent years in probing trading activity by a range of Fed policymakers. The IG warned in a report in [USN:L6N42O17Q TEXT:"June"] that the Fed needed to take greater care in protecting confidential information during staff international travel.
The IG is currently engaged in a high-profile [USN:L6N41G04N TEXT:"investigation"] into cost overruns incurred as part of the renovation of the central bank’s Washington headquarters. President Donald Trump, who has repeatedly attacked the Fed, had tried to use the renovations issue as an avenue to fire then-Fed Chair Jerome Powell, who now serves as a governor with Trump-installed Kevin Warsh as the current central bank leader.

FAST

Sept 28 : Fast-fashion platform Shein reported plunging profit and sliding European sales on Monday in its first results as a public company, feeding investor worries over margin pressure and slowing growth.
Adjusted net profit was $228 million for the second quarter, down 67 per cent from a year ago, and its margin was squeezed to just 2.1 per cent from 6.2 per cent last year as conflict in the Middle East pushed up jet fuel and freight costs for the retailer that sends cheap clothes by air to shoppers around the world.
Sales in Europe dropped sharply too in the quarter to end-June as Shein hiked prices and cut online advertising in anticipation of 3-euro fees the European Union imposed on low-value e-commerce parcels starting July 1.
Shein reported $11.08 billion in sales for the second quarter, with Europe revenue down 13.9 per cent to $3.77 billion and US revenue falling 6 per cent to $2.5 billion. Overall sales were up 0.9 per cent from a year ago as growth in Latin America offset declines in Shein's biggest markets.

Since its September 1 debut in Hong Kong, Shein's shares have dropped 27.3 per cent from the offer price of HK$48.56 apiece, and the continued profit squeeze gave little to encourage investors.
"We estimate earnings landed more than 10 per cent below the low end of the range implied by the prospectus," Jefferies analysts wrote.
Shein's 18.1 per cent jump in fulfillment costs was well above Jefferies' expectations and was concerning, they said, given this was already before the European fees kicked in.
In a statement, Shein CEO and Chair Yangtian Xu said a key priority was increasing the amount of inventory in Europe.
Shein has been investing in warehouse space in Poland, opening a logistics hub in Wroclaw with 740,000 square metres of warehouse space in December last year. Industrial real estate firm CTP said it has this year leased an additional 66,000 square metres of warehouse space to Shein in Poland.
SHEIN PLANS SHIFT TO HIGHER-PRICED BRANDS
Xu also said Shein plans to push into higher-priced clothes that will boost its profitability, and hinted at the company's strategy of expanding its family of brands, including through acquisitions.
"As the product mix shifts towards brands at higher price points, the platform’s overall average selling price will rise accordingly," he said in a statement. "Our vision is to become a richly diversified brand collection that meets consumers’ varied needs across multiple price points and occasions."
Known for selling $5 dresses and $10 jeans and running permanent discounts, Shein was already forced to raise prices in the US last year when the Trump administration ended de minimis - duty-free access for low-value ecommerce parcels - and this year faces the same challenge in Europe.
Shein has said the European fees could have a bigger impact than the end of de minimis in the US. The 3-euro fees apply per product category, adding up to 15 euros if a shopper buys five different types of item in one order.
The EU is also planning an additional 2-euro handling fee on low-value ecommerce parcels, to be implemented from November 1, adding to the pressure on Shein's business model.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 中国、景気下支え強化へ　成長目標達成に向け国務院が方針
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ２８日 ロイター] - 中国国務院（内閣に相当）は２８日、経済への圧力が強まる中、景気下支えに向けた政策支援を強化する方針を示した。成長を軌道に乗せ、２６年の成長率目標達成に向けて景気下支えを急ぐ姿勢を示している。

国営メディアが伝えた国務院会議の概要によると、「足元の経済運営で生じた問題に対応するため、景気変動を抑えるマクロ経済政策の調整を強化し、経済の持続的な改善と高度化を促進し、２６年の経済・社会発展目標の達成に努めるべきだ」とし、既存の政策措置をより効果的に実施するとともに、政府債券の発行と調達資金の活用を加速する必要があるとした。

また、２６─３０年の５カ年計画に盛り込まれた全国的な６つのネットワークに関連する主要インフラ事業について、できるだけ早期に着工するよう求めた。

中国指導部は、財政支出の加速や新たな政策の「適時」導入を通じて、減速する経済を下支えすると表明している。政府は２６年の経済成長率目標を４．５─５％に設定している。

国務院は、利子補給やインフラの更新、対象を絞った政策措置などを通じ、投資と消費への支援を一段と強化する方針も示した。財政支出の効率化や地方政府の未使用の債務発行枠の一層の活用、金融政策手段の柔軟な運用も求めた。

さらに、技術革新、産業の高度化、農業、小規模企業向けの再貸し出し制度を拡充するとともに、住宅市場や雇用、所得の伸びを支援する新たな措置を検討するとした。

items.title: スペースX「スターシップ」､初の軌道到達－改良型衛星を実運用へ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 宇宙技術開発大手、米スペースXの巨大ロケット「スターシップ」は現地時間28日朝、初めて軌道に到達した。上昇中にエンジン1基が故障し、一時はミッション遂行が危ぶまれたものの、同計画にとって節目となる成果を達成した。

スターシップは現地時間午前7時49分、テキサス州南部のスターベース発射施設から打ち上げられた。ロケットには同社の改良型スターリンク衛星26基が搭載されており、スペースXはこれらを全て軌道上に展開したと発表した。

スペースXの広報担当者ダン・フオット氏はライブストリームで、展開された衛星26基が既存のスターリンク・ネットワークとの接続に成功したと述べた。

スターシップは打ち上げから約35分後に衛星の展開を開始した。一方、当初約10時間を予定していた飛行は早めに終了した。エンジン故障を受けた判断とみられる。スターシップは打ち上げから約3時間後、ハワイ近海の太平洋に着水した。

米株式市場でスペースXは乱高下。一時は1.4%上昇したが、最終的には2.2%安の145.47ドルで引けた。

スターシップが宇宙に向けて上昇する途中、6基あるラプターエンジンのうち1基が予定より早く停止したため、スペースXのエンジニアチームは軌道投入の試みを一時中止した。しかし、データを確認した後、チームは試みを再開し、スターシップのラプターエンジン1基を燃焼させ、機体を初めて軌道に投入した。

飛行開始から約3時間後、スターシップは軌道を離れて大気圏に再突入。時速2万6900キロを超える速度に達した後、ハワイ近海で制御された状態で海面に突入し、その後爆発した。

今回のスターシップ試験飛行は14回目で、スペースXにとって重要な節目となる。これまでの打ち上げはいずれも、安全性を最大限確保するため、意図的に軌道到達の手前にとどめていた。米規制当局は今回、スペースXがスターシップを次の段階へ進めることを承認し、同社が機体を安全に軌道速度まで加速させ、制御された形で地球へ帰還させられると判断した。

items.title: スペースX「スターシップ」､初の軌道投入に成功－商用化へ前進
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 宇宙技術開発大手、米スペースXの巨大ロケット「スターシップ」は現地時間28日朝、初めて軌道に到達した。上昇中にエンジン1基が故障し、一時はミッション遂行が危ぶまれたものの、同計画にとって節目となる成果を達成した。

スターシップは現地時間午前7時49分、テキサス州南部のスターベース発射施設から打ち上げられた。今回の試験飛行は約10時間に及ぶ可能性がある。ロケットには同社の改良型スターリンク衛星26基が搭載されており、スペースXはこれらを軌道上に展開し、既存の宇宙インターネット網を強化する計画だ。

スターシップは打ち上げから約35分後に衛星の展開を開始した。飛行開始から約1時間後、衛星26基すべての展開に成功したと、スペースXが明らかにした。

米株式市場でスペースXは乱高下。一時は1.4%上昇したが、ニューヨーク時間午前10時21分現在は0.9%安で推移している。

スターシップが宇宙に向けて上昇する途中、6基あるラプターエンジンのうち1基が予定より早く停止したため、スペースXのエンジニアチームは軌道投入の試みを一時中止した。しかし、データを確認した後、チームは試みを再開し、スターシップのラプターエンジン1基を燃焼させ、機体を初めて軌道に投入した。

今回のスターシップ試験飛行は14回目で、スペースXにとって重要な節目となる。これまでの打ち上げはいずれも、安全性を最大限確保するため、意図的に軌道到達の手前にとどめていた。米規制当局は今回、スペースXがスターシップを次の段階へ進めることを承認し、同社が機体を安全に軌道速度まで加速させ、制御された形で地球へ帰還させられると判断した。

今回のミッションが成功すれば、さらに多くの軌道飛行への道が開かれる可能性がある。スペースXはすでに1万1000基を超える衛星からなるネットワークを展開しており、今回の投入で改良型スターリンク衛星「V3」がこれに加わる。スターシップは過去の打ち上げでもV3衛星を展開したが、これらは最終的に計画通り地球の大気圏で燃え尽きた。

items.title: ベッセント米財務長官、ジェフリーズのゼルボス氏を顧問に起用
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米財務省は28日、投資銀行ジェフリーズで市場や政策を長く分析してきたデビッド・ゼルボス氏を、ベッセント米財務長官の顧問に起用したと発表した。具体的な役割は明らかにしていない。

財務省は、発表文で「ゼルボス氏は世界の金融市場、中央銀行、マクロ経済分析の分野で35年の経験を持つ」と説明した。同氏は別の文書で、任期は4月までとしている。

ゼルボス氏は以前、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）でエコノミストとして勤務し、その後ジェフリーズでチーフ・マーケット・ストラテジストを務め、FRBについて幅広く論評してきた。昨年は、パウエルFRB議長（当時）の後任候補者の1人とも報じられた。

ベッセント氏が昨年初めに長官に就任して以降、米財務省では幹部の入れ替わりが比較的増えている。超党派の政府監視団体パートナーシップ・フォー・パブリック・サービスによると、ベッセント氏に次ぐ上位職である副長官と次官2人を含め、これまでに上院の承認を受けて就任した幹部7人が退任した。

ベッセント氏が顧問に迎えるゼルボス氏は昨年、FRBによる利下げを支持し、パウエル氏を「反トランプ」の工作員だと批判していた。

ゼルボス氏は、顧客向けの文書で「米国のリスク資産市場に対する私の長年の楽観的な見方は、政権の主張にも間違いなく容易になじむだろう」と述べた。

ジェフリーズの広報からは、今のところコメントを得られていない。ゼルボス氏の財務省顧問への起用については、CNBCが先に報じていた。

items.title: 原油は小幅高、現物需要が堅調－米イラン協議でも供給懸念は払拭せず
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 原油相場は28日に小幅に上昇。中東からの供給障害は緩和したが、現物への堅調な需要が相場を支えた。

北海ブレント11月限は前週末比96セント（0.9%）上昇し、1バレル＝105.28ドルで終了。11月限は30日に期限を迎える。より取引の多い12月限は97.83ドルで終えた。

ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）11月限は同19セント（0.2%）高い92.60ドルで引けた。WTIはニューヨーク時間早朝に一時4.5%上昇する場面もあったが、午後には下落するなど、比較的値動きが大きかった。

トランプ米大統領は核問題で具体的な進展があれば、イランへの制裁緩和や凍結資産の解除に応じる用意があると、米当局者が明らかにした。米国は仲介国を通じ、イランと前向きで建設的な協議を続けているという。

TDセキュリティーズのシニア商品ストラテジスト、ライアン・マッケイ氏は「具体的な合意や紛争終結がない限り、市場では当初のニュースへの反応がすぐに薄れ、高値が崩れにくくなっている」と指摘した。

また「米中間選挙前に、イランやイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派を通じて事態がエスカレートすることに対し、市場の警戒が高まっている。選挙後に米国側から緊張が高まる可能性もある」と述べた。

この日、原油相場の重しとなったのが、サウジアラビアの東西パイプライン復旧だ。ドローン攻撃を受けて損傷した同パイプライン経由で、原油輸出が再開されたと、事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

ただ、キャピタル・エコノミクスの気候・商品担当シニアエコノミスト、ハマド・フセイン氏は、「中東での戦争が決定的な形で終結しない限り、リスクバランスは引き続き原油価格の上昇方向に傾いている」と話す。

北海ブレントの期近2限月間の価格差（プロンプトスプレッド）は1バレル＝7ドル超に拡大。先月末には1ドル未満だった。「バックワーデーション」と呼ばれる強気パターンで、需給逼迫（ひっぱく）を示す典型的な指標だ。

items.title: 原油相場が上げ縮小、米・イラン協議報道やサウジのパイプライン復旧
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 原油相場は28日、上げ幅を縮小している。イランと米国がホルムズ海峡の通航再開を巡って協議を継続するとの一部報道や、サウジアラビアの主要パイプラインを通じた輸出が再開されたことが背景にある。

北海ブレント先物は一時、前週末比4.3%上昇して1バレル＝108.83ドルを付けたが、ニューヨーク時間午前10時47分現在は107.68ドルで推移している。ウエスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）先物も上げ幅を縮小し、約3%上昇の95.14ドルとなっている。

ロイター通信の記者は、仲介国が28日か29日に米国、イランとそれぞれ協議を行う予定だと、Xに投稿した。事情に詳しい当局者を引用しているという。

サウジはドローン攻撃を受けて損傷した東西パイプライン経由で、原油輸出を再開した。事情を直接知る関係者が明らかにした。

原油先物はこれ以前に上げ幅を拡大していた。イランがホルムズ海峡再開に向けて自ら提示した7日間の案を堅持し、条件を緩和する考えはないと表明したことなどが背景。

トランプ米大統領はニュースサイト・アクシオスとの27日のインタビューで、週内に交渉が再開されるとの見通しを示しながらも、イランは要求を押し通し過ぎたと語った。

原油相場は協議進展を示唆するニュースに敏感に反応している。米国とイランの協議はここ数カ月、断続的に行われてきたが、中東産の原油輸送を混乱させている紛争の解決には至っていない。

キャピタル・エコノミクスの気候・商品担当シニアエコノミスト、ハマド・フセイン氏は、「中東での戦争が決定的な形で終結しない限り、リスクのバランスは引き続き原油価格の上昇方向に傾いている」と述べた。

イラン戦争が長期化する中、ブレント原油は今年に入って75%超上昇している。石油製品市場ではさらに大幅な上昇が続いており、ディーゼルなどの燃料価格も、ロシアとウクライナの戦争の影響で押し上げられている。

items.title: エヌビディア、自社株買い計画を1500億ドル増額－持続的な成長を確信
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米エヌビディアは自社株買い計画の規模を1500億ドル（約23兆5700億円）引き上げた。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（CEO）による同社の持続的な成長に対する自信が反映された。これにより、承認済みの自社株買いの残額は2350億ドルとなる。

28日の発表によれば、同社は2028年度までに自社株買いを完了する見通しだ。

AIモデルやインフラの開発競争を背景に、エヌビディアの画像処理半導体（GPU）への需要が拡大し、同社は時価総額で世界最大の企業となった。ただ最近では、予想利益に対するエヌビディア株の割高感は薄れている。AI関連の巨額投資が持続可能かどうかを巡る市場の懸念を反映している。

フアン氏は発表資料で、「エヌビディアの成長をけん引しているのは、AIとアクセラレーテッド・コンピューティングへのプラットフォームの転換で、数十年ぶりの大きな変化だ」と指摘。「今回の承認は、今後の長期的な事業機会に対するわれわれの自信を反映している」と述べた。

同氏はまた、技術開発のペースを落とすべきだとの主張に反論しており、アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイCEOやOpenAIのサム・アルトマン氏ら一部のAI企業トップとは異なる立場を取っている。AIエージェントが引き起こした注目度の高いセキュリティー侵害を受け、業界ではAI開発をより慎重なペースで進めることについて議論が始まった。

エヌビディアはまた、自社ハードウエア上で稼働する新たなAIセキュリティーシステムも発表した。同社によると、このシステムがあれば、OpenAIが誤ってハギングフェイスに侵入した問題を防げたという。エヌビディアが投入するのは、オープンソースのセキュリティーソフトウエア２本で、AIエージェントがアクセスできる対象をリアルタイムで制御する仕組みだ。

items.title: エヌビディア、自社株買い枠1500億ドル拡大　過去最大の増額
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[２８日　ロイター] - 米半導体大手のエヌビディアは、自社株買い枠を１５００億ドル拡大した。同社として過去最大規模の増額で、２０２４年にアップルが承認した１１００億ドルをも上回る。

今回の追加承認により、エヌビディアの自社株買いの総額は２３５０億ドルに拡大した。人工知能（ＡＩ）の学習・推論向け需要の急拡大を背景に生み出される潤沢なキャッシュを活用し、２０２８会計年度までに使い切る見込みという。

エヌビディア株は一時２％超上昇した。同社株は前営業日終値時点で年初来２０％超上昇していた。

ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「当社のキャッシュ創出力は、この変革を推進する技術への投資と株主還元を両立する余力をもたらしている」と述べた。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、今回の１５００億ドルの増額規模は、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数を構成する企業約８４％の時価総額を上回る。

Ｅｍａｒｋｅｔｅｒのアナリスト、ジェイコブ・ボーン氏は「ＡＩ投資拡大が現在のペースで永続するわけではないが、エヌビディアが自社のハードウエアやサービスに対する需要の持続性に自信を持っていることを示している」と指摘した。

ＬＳＥＧがまとめたデータによると、同社の今後１２カ月の予想利益に基づく株価収益率（ＰＥＲ）は約１６．５倍と１５年１月以来の低水準で、過去１５年の平均である３０倍を大幅に下回っている。一部のアナリストは、これを利益成長への期待が鈍化している兆候だと指摘している。

items.title: Kyiv Science Academy hit, 10 dead as Russian jet-drones strike across Ukraine
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: At least two people were killed when a drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, as Russia pounded the heart of the Ukrainian capital with some of the most persistent drone strikes since the start of the war.
items.body:
At least two people were killed when a drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, as Russia pounded the heart of the Ukrainian capital with some of the most persistent drone strikes since the start of the war.
President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said nine people had been killed and more than 80 injured in Russian drone strikes throughout the country.
Two people were killed in the assault on the Academy of Sciences building in the heart of the capital. Emergency services said later in the evening that one of the dead had been recovered from under rubble.
Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said 24 people had been injured in several attacks on the capital, six of whom were being treated in hospital.
Sirens echoed through the streets as smoke billowed into the sky and air raids sounded late into the day.
In recent weeks, Russia has begun hitting Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities with faster, high-flying jet drones.
In his nightly video address, Zelenskiy said Ukraine was still having difficulty countering faster, high-flying Russian jet-powered drones -- 90 of 120 drones fired on Ukraine were jet propelled, rather than propeller-driven, and the interception rate was 57%.
"New interceptors are being actively tested," he said. "Some combat groups are using them, but, of course, some details still need to be refined to achieve enough effectiveness and scale. Wea re speeding up the developers."
Oficials had noted attacks on other targets, including a pharmaceutical company, petrol stations and a medical facility in Kyiv. In other cities and regions, civilian facilities, businesses and communications infrastructure were targeted.
Zelenskiy also detailed a report from Ukraine's Main Directorate of Intelligence (HUR) which he said showed that Russia had launched a new wave of mobilisation for its military.
"They are increasing the number of people they recruit through various methods," he said. "It is important that the governments of countries from which Russia recruits people for its army take action against this."
He said 8,000 North Korean troops, first brought to Russia in 2024 to counter a Ukrainian incursion into Kursk region, remained in the country and a further 10,000 were Being trained.
Russian President Vladimir Putin has [USN:S8N44T0FK TEXT:"dismissed"] as "utter nonsense" any notion that Moscow is ordering a new mobilisation.
ATTACK ON BUSINESS CENTRE IN DNIPRO In the southeastern city of Dnipro, the Russian drone attack on the business centre killed three, officials said.
In particular, Russia has been widening its attacks on economic targets beyond warehouses, port facilities and energy infrastructure, in recent days hitting data centres and telecoms facilities.
Another person was killed in a logistics office in Synelnykove, southeast of Dnipro, regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha said. Emergency services said an attack on infrastructure in the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia injured 32 people.
In Kyiv, flames leaped from the opened interior of the historic Academy building, and rubble was strewn across the courtyard, partially burying one car. Firefighters doused the building in water and searched for people in the wreckage, while two survivors of the blast clambered from upper storey windows, onto ladders raised by emergency services.
Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha accused Russia of cynicism for targeting a scientific institution during the working day.
"Russia is deliberately expanding the boundaries of what it believes the world will tolerate. Every attack left without a strong response only encourages the next one," he said, calling on Ukraine's allies to provide it with more air defences.
Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said 19 people had been injured in the daytime attack on the business centre in Dnipro.
Hanzha said the centre was surrounded by residential buildings, a park, a library and offices in the city centre: "Hundreds of people are here in the middle of the working day."
Ukraine has also increased attacks on Russia, targeting oil refineries as well as online retailers to try to undermine revenues and support for Moscow's war effort.
Zelenskiy said on Monday that it had struck Russian oil facilities in the Krasnodar region and two defence plants.
Both sides have denied deliberately targeting civilians.

items.title: US stocks: US market drops as Trump’s rejection of Iran peace plan lifts oil prices
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Following President Trump's dismissal of Iran's peace proposal, US market indexes experienced a downward trend, spurred by a notable surge in crude prices. This escalation raised inflation worries, consequently leading to an uptick in Treasury yields and impacting economic outlooks. Meanwhile, Nvidia's stock showed resilience, buoyed by an announcement of substantial share repurchases, albeit only slightly supporting broader market sentiments.
items.body: US market’s main indexes fell on Monday after President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to end the conflict, sending crude prices higher, reviving inflation concerns and pushing Treasury yields up, Reuters reported.Nvidia offered some support to the broader market, rising 3.2% after the chipmaker authorised a $150 billion share repurchase—the largest buyback approval in its history.Iran unveiled a peace proposal at last week’s United Nations General Assembly in New York and said it had been conveyed to the United States through Qatari mediators. Trump said on Saturday that he had rejected the offer, though he told Axios on Sunday that he expected US negotiators to continue talks this week.Crude prices climbed 2% to around $107 a barrel. The increase also weighed on Treasuries, driving longer-dated yields to fresh multidecade highs.“Energy has been the one consistent upward pressure on inflation, and anything that continues to put pressure on inflation is going to be something that motivates the Fed to raise rates,” Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth, told Reuters.Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 245.02 points, or 0.47%, at 51,583.60. The S&P 500 lost 36.08 points, or 0.46%, to 7,707.50, while the Nasdaq Composite fell 175.16 points, or 0.65%, to 26,893.56.Consumer discretionary stocks led declines among S&P 500 sectors, falling 1.3%. DoorDash and Carvana dropped 6% and 5%, respectively.According to Reuters, Investors found some relief on the trade front after the US-China summit concluded last week with the two countries agreeing to reduce tariffs on $60 billion worth of goods imported from each other. They also extended their trade truce by two months, through January 10.Attention later this week will turn to a series of key economic indicators. Traders are pricing in a 68% chance that the Federal Reserve will follow its September increase with another rate hike of at least 25 basis points in October, according to CME Group’s FedWatch Tool.“Any historical instance of the Fed hiking into a short-term supply shock has always ended poorly. And the Fed is being impatient. They shouldn’t have hiked in September. They could potentially make the same mistake in October,” said Thomas Hayes, chairman at Great Hill Capital.The August Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index and September nonfarm payrolls report, both due this week, could offer further clues about the Fed’s policy path.Fed policymakers Michelle Bowman, Lisa Cook and Thomas Barkin are scheduled to speak later on Monday and could reinforce the central bank’s hawkish shift since its previous meeting.Tesla fell 2.7% after JP Morgan lowered its price target on the stock, citing weak third-quarter deliveries. Meta declined nearly 4% after surging 13% last week.Declining stocks outnumbered advancers by 2.81 to 1 on the NYSE and by 3.03 to 1 on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 recorded no new 52-week highs and 19 new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite posted 14 new highs and 127 new lows.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

Pope Leo urges concessions for peace as Ukraine war drags on

METZ, France: Pope Leo said on Monday (Sep 28) that negotiators seeking to end war in Europe must be willing to sacrifice some positions to achieve peace, as efforts to end Russia's bloody war in Ukraine continue to fail.
The first US pope, speaking to European leaders in Metz, home of Robert Schuman, a founding father of the European Union, lamented that "war has returned, even to Europe: a new senseless slaughter, claiming countless civilian lives every day".
Offering his clearest political vision yet for Europe, Leo also praised integration and multiculturalism at a time when the far right is gaining strength across the region.
Speaking in French, he urged Europeans to recall the founding values of the EU, including the rule of law and the equality of all people without distinction of race, colour, class or profession. His speech received a standing ovation.

Leo had begun his four-day visit on Friday with a warning that the United Nations and other multilateral bodies were in crisis and international dialogue risked becoming a "charade".
POPE CALLS FOR DIALOGUE TO END WAR On Monday in Metz, he turned his attention to the war in Ukraine - without mentioning it directly.
"We need ... to show courage in negotiation and to be willing to give up some positions for the greater good of peace," he urged, invoking a similar 1917 appeal from Pope Benedict XV amid the carnage of the First World War.
Leo also reiterated his opposition to rising European military spending, which grew last year by the highest amount since the end of the Cold War amid pressure from US President Donald Trump and Russian assertiveness.
"We must also guard against the illusion that rearmament is the answer," he said.
"Today we must ask whether we are truly making creative efforts to advance world peace, or whether we are simply seeking to 'stem the tide of war' and better prepare ourselves for wars that we assume are still to come."
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy last week met Trump in New York to discuss ways to end the war, which Russia began in 2022 with a full-scale invasion that has seized a fifth of Ukraine. Neither side has shown any willingness to concede land.
Standing next to French President Emmanuel Macron, Leo urged European leaders to integrate migrants arriving on the continent and offer them opportunities as if they were family members.
The pope, who frequently urges leaders to treat migrants more humanely, repeated his call for "legal and safe pathways" for immigration, and international cooperation to fight human trafficking.
LEO URGES EUROPE TO WELCOME MIGRANTS "To welcome a person means to integrate them as if they were part of one's own family, offering them the opportunity to develop their gifts, abilities and sensibilities," he said.
Three migrants including one child died on Monday, hours before Leo spoke, attempting to cross the Channel from France to Britain.
Leo has also criticised Trump's US anti-immigration policies. He urged Europe to maintain the rule of law, and welcome multiculturalism.
"Europe has flourished and progressed when it has been able to draw on the best aspects of its past and reinvent them in new and creative ways through encounters with others," he said, also stressing Europe's Christian roots.
"Today, relations between individuals and states are becoming increasingly uncivilised. The value of keeping one's word is dismissed; instead, people boast of lies and deceit. Europe can help to break this cycle through the respect for others that it has learned to cultivate and preserve."
In his own remarks, Macron said Europe's Greco-Roman and Judeo-Christian foundations had helped crystallise the "primacy of the person" and the "free and rational individual", and praised the European Union as a unique project founded on peace and equality.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.body:
Qatari mediators are likely to hold separate talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi in New York and with the US side on Monday or Tuesday, an official briefed on the negotiations told Reuters, in a fresh push to end the war.
The talks are expected to focus on an amended version of a seven-day proposal that Iran presented last week on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly , said the official, who spoke on condition of anonymity.
Araqchi remains in New York after attending the General Assembly. It was not immediately clear who would represent the US side in the talks with mediators.
Iran's semi-official ISNA news agency later confirmed that Araqchi would meet the mediators in the US on Monday morning, New York time.
The two sides will "examine the latest proposals and views regarding the current situation", ISNA added.
Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei told state media later on Monday that Araqchi's stay in New York had not been extended and that the foreign minister would return to Tehran according to his original schedule.
Baghaei made no comment on the talks with mediators.
TRUMP HAS FLAGGED FURTHER TALKS THIS WEEK Iran's seven-day plan envisages an end to all hostilities in Iran and Lebanon, the unfreezing of billions of dollars' worth of Iranian assets, an end to sanctions on Iranian oil and the lifting of the US blockade on Iranian ports.
Tehran would then allow the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and the two sides would also resume talks on Iran's nuclear programme.
US President Donald Trump said on Saturday he had [USN:L6N45I003 TEXT:"rejected Iran's proposal"], saying Tehran wanted a swift agreement because of the crippling economic pressure it is under.
However, he also told Axios on Sunday that he expected US negotiators to engage in [USN:T5N439022 TEXT:"further talks"] this week.
Araqchi said on Sunday that mediators had not formally conveyed a US rejection to Tehran and that Iran was awaiting Washington's definitive position before deciding its next steps.
"Our conditions are clear, and any move toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz is contingent on these conditions being met," he said on Sunday, adding that only a negotiated solution could resolve the impasse.

items.title: Trump unveils $15 billion planned Iowa steel project
items.author: Jarrett Renshaw, Ernest Scheyder
items.creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Ernest Scheyder
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Monday said that a Minnesota company plans to build a multi-billion-dollar steel mill in Iowa, handing the administration a marquee manufacturing investment to showcase as Republicans head into November's midterm elections.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump on Monday said that a Minnesota company plans to build a multi-billion-dollar steel mill in Iowa, handing the administration a marquee manufacturing investment to showcase as Republicans head into November's midterm elections.
Trump unveiled the project at the White House with executives from Mesabi Metallics, which recently opened Minnesota's first new iron ore mine in 50 years. The White House said the plant investment would amount to $15 billion.
The announcement comes as Trump seeks to bolster his economic record ahead of November's election, with his approval rating [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"plumbing all-time lows"] of late as the Republican Party confronts voter concerns about inflation and the cost of living. Trump has made tariffs and a revival of US manufacturing central to his economic agenda, arguing that higher barriers to imports will drive investment and jobs back to the United States.
But Republicans are in the midst of several competitive elections in Iowa, a once-swingy state that has more consistently voted for Trump's party in recent years. Polling this cycle shows a tight race for a seat in the US Senate, as well as its gubernatorial race, where the Democratic candidate, Rob Sand, has led most polls.
The potential $15 billion steel project gives Trump a high-profile investment to tout as he makes that case to voters. It also comes as the administration faces pressure to show that its policies imposing broad tariffs on US imports can deliver industrial gains without fueling inflation.
"This is a tremendous investment," Trump said in the White House's Oval Office. "Our steel industry is roaring back to life."
NEW JOBS EXPECTED Global steel markets have been sluggish in recent months due in part to overcapacity, particularly in China, and lackluster demand. In the US, however, steel prices have been higher because of trade barriers, boosting the appeal of domestic projects despite their high construction costs.
Trump imposed a 25% tariff on most imported steel during his first term, a levy that his successor, Democrat Joe Biden, largely kept in place.
The American steel manufacturer Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF.N) is idling some production at its Hamilton, Ontario, plant in Canada and will lay off hundreds of workers, citing damage from US tariffs, CBC News said on Monday.
US manufacturing activity has picked up over the last year, with Federal Reserve industrial production data showing output growing by the most in around four years. Factory employment, which fell by 113,000 in Trump's first year back at the White House, has also rebounded a bit this year, rising by 56,000 through August, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
The new project will be fully vertically integrated, with Mesabi using iron ore from its Minnesota mine to produce steel in Iowa. The first phase will produce 7.5 million tons of steel annually, with the plant eventually expected to reach 10 million tons, which the White House described as the largest steel plant in US history.
The Wall Street Journal first reported the announcement.
The Mesabi steel project would use iron ore extracted from the company's mine in Nashwauk, Minnesota, roughly 250 miles from the Iowa border.
Indian conglomerate Essar Group owns Mesabi and has invested more than $2.5 billion in the Minnesota mine.
Earlier this month, the US Export-Import Bank said it would finance $10 billion for the mine's expansion, and the bank's chairman, John Jovanovic, visited the site.
The Iowa steel plant is expected to create at least 1,750 permanent jobs, the White House said. The first phase is also expected to support up to 6,000 construction jobs.
It was not immediately clear why Mesabi aims to build a steel mill in Iowa using iron ore extracted from Minnesota.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
Power can be a major cost for steel producers, and commercial electricity prices in Iowa are marginally lower than in Minnesota.
The first phase of the project is expected to generate $95 billion in total economic impact during construction and its first 10 years of operation, according to the White House. First steel production is expected in 2030.

items.title: French court finds Swiftair guilty of corporate manslaughter over Mali crash
items.author: Makini Brice, Tim Hepher, Juliette Jabkhiro
items.creator: Makini Brice, Tim Hepher, Juliette Jabkhiro
items.summary: The Paris Criminal Court found Spanish company Swiftair guilty of corporate manslaughter on Monday over the 2014 crash of an Air Algerie flight that killed 116 people in northern Mali.
items.body:
The Paris Criminal Court found Spanish company Swiftair guilty of corporate manslaughter on Monday over the 2014 crash of an Air Algerie flight that killed 116 people in northern Mali.
Swiftair, which had been sub-contracted to operate the flight on behalf of the Algerian carrier, denied the charges and attempted to have the case halted at the trial's opening on the grounds that a Spanish court had already dropped the case.
However, a French judge ordered the company to pay the maximum fine in France of €225,000 for corporate manslaughter, "or involuntary homicide," after a three-week trial earlier this year over the crash of a Swiftair-owned MD-83 airliner.
"This ruling comes as a relief to families who have been fighting for more than (12) years for justice to be done," said Sebastien Busy, a lawyer representing a group of relatives.
"Families now expect Swiftair to assume its responsibilities and accept this decision," he told Reuters.
Swiftair, which has 10 days to appeal, reiterated in a statement that it should not have been held liable and that safety regulations had been followed.
"We will take the time to examine the decision attentively with our legal advisers before determining our eventual next steps," the company said.
Air Algerie Flight AH5017 hit the ground less than an hour after it left the Burkinabe capital of Ouagadougou for Algiers, killing everyone on board.
Investigators later said the aircraft went into a stall when it was hit by ice as an anti-icing system remained switched off.
RARE CORPORATE MANSLAUGHTER TRIAL During the rare corporate manslaughter trial in France, prosecutors alleged negligence in the way Swiftair pilots were trained to deal with icy conditions and erratic data.
Swiftair, which was founded in 1986 as a cargo firm and 'wet lease' airline flying for other carriers that sell tickets for passengers, blamed shortcomings in regulation and manuals.
In Monday's judgement, the court rejected some prosecution arguments about poor training but said the captain had not had a proper proficiency check and the crew had not had the required number of refresher flights after a period of inactivity.
Monday's ruling marks the second time an airline has been found guilty of corporate manslaughter in France after Air France (AIRF.PA) and Airbus (AIR.PA) were both declared [USN:L1N41Y0AT TEXT:"guilty in May"] over the 2009 crash of a jetliner en route from Rio de Janeiro to Paris, killing all 228 people on board.
Both companies have appealed to France's highest court and are due to file arguments in coming days, with the case heading for a third full trial if May's appeals verdict is overturned.
The €225,000 maximum fine in such cases has often been criticised as a token penalty, but groups of victims' families in both accidents have said they are fighting for vindication after waging legal marathons through the courts.
items.raw_description: The Paris Criminal Court found Spanish company Swiftair guilty of corporate manslaughter on Monday over the 2014 crash of an Air Algerie flight that killed 116 people in northern Mali.

items.title: BioNTech to shutter three sites in Germany as no buyers emerge
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: German COVID‑19 vaccine maker BioNTech said on Monday that it would close German sites that it has failed to sell as it pivots away from pandemic-era manufacturing.
items.body:
German COVID‑19 vaccine maker BioNTech (22UAy.DE) said on Monday that it would close German sites that it has failed to sell as it pivots away from pandemic-era manufacturing.
"Despite the best efforts of all those involved and a wide-ranging sales process, it has unfortunately not been possible to finalise a sale," said a spokesperson.
The spokesperson added that the biotech firm had agreed with the works council on socially responsible solutions and supplementary redundancy terms for affected staff.
BioNTech [USN:L6N41I0HM TEXT:"said in May"] it would seek buyers for its German sites in Idar-Oberstein, Marburg and Tuebingen, as well as in Singapore, or otherwise wind them down.
The restructuring, affecting up to 1,860 jobs, was part of a production transfer of its COVID-19 vaccine to partner Pfizer (PFE.N) .
BioNTech, the initial inventor of the Western world's most commonly used immunisation shot during the pandemic, said in March that its two [USN:L8N3ZY0W8 TEXT:"co-founders"] would leave by the end of this year to start a new venture.
($1 = 0.8554 euros)
