items.title: Shein quarterly profit falls 67% as costs jump, Europe sales slump
items.author: Helen Reid
items.creator: Helen Reid
items.summary: Fast-fashion platform Shein reported plunging profit and sliding European sales on Monday in its first results as a public company, feeding investor worries over margin pressure and slowing growth.
items.body:
Fast-fashion platform Shein (0625.HK) reported plunging profit and sliding European sales on Monday in its first results as a public company, feeding investor worries over margin pressure and slowing growth.
Adjusted net profit was $228 million for the second quarter, down 67% from a year ago, and its margin was squeezed to just 2.1% from 6.2% last year as conflict in the Middle East pushed up jet fuel and freight costs for the retailer that sends cheap clothes by air to shoppers around the world.
Sales in Europe dropped sharply too in the quarter to end-June as Shein hiked prices and cut online advertising in anticipation of 3-euro [USN:L6N42Y0OM TEXT:"fees"] the European Union imposed on low-value e-commerce parcels starting July 1.
Shein reported $11.08 billion in sales for the second quarter, with Europe revenue down 13.9% to $3.77 billion and US revenue falling 6% to $2.5 billion. Overall sales were up 0.9% from a year ago as growth in Latin America offset declines in Shein's biggest markets.
Since its September 1 debut in Hong Kong, Shein's shares have dropped 27.3% from the offer price of HK$48.56 apiece, and the continued profit squeeze gave little to encourage investors.
"We estimate earnings landed more than 10% below the low end of the range implied by the prospectus," Jefferies analysts wrote.
Shein's 18.1% jump in fulfillment costs was well above Jefferies' expectations and was concerning, they said, given this was already before the European fees kicked in.
In a statement, Shein CEO and Chair Yangtian Xu said a key priority was increasing the amount of inventory in Europe.
Shein has been investing in warehouse space in Poland, opening a logistics hub in Wroclaw with 740,000 square metres of warehouse space in December last year. Industrial real estate firm CTP said it has this year leased an additional 66,000 square metres of warehouse space to Shein in Poland.
SHEIN PLANS SHIFT TO HIGHER-PRICED BRANDS Xu also said Shein plans to push into higher-priced clothes that will boost its profitability, and hinted at the company's strategy of expanding its family of brands, including through [USN:L6N43O16N TEXT:"acquisitions"].
"As the product mix shifts towards brands at higher price points, the platform’s overall average selling price will rise accordingly," he said in a statement. "Our vision is to become a richly diversified brand collection that meets consumers’ varied needs across multiple price points and occasions."
Known for selling $5 dresses and $10 jeans and running permanent discounts, Shein was already forced to raise prices in the US last year when the Trump administration ended de minimis - duty-free access for low-value ecommerce parcels - and this year faces the same challenge in Europe.
Shein has said the European fees could have a bigger impact than the end of de minimis in the US. The 3-euro fees apply per product category, adding up to 15 euros if a shopper buys five different types of item in one order.
The EU is also planning an additional 2-euro handling fee on low-value ecommerce parcels, to be implemented from November 1, adding to the pressure on Shein's business model.

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept 28 : Cerebras Systems plans to supply AI chips and hardware with capacity to consume roughly 100 megawatts to startup Gimlet Labs to help run its cloud computing business, the companies said on Monday.
The deal between Gimlet and Cerebras is part of rising interest from AI companies in procuring hardware that is capable of speedy AI calculations known as inference, the process in which a chatbot such as Anthropic's Claude generates a response to a user question.
Performing inference operations speedily can help in areas such as cybersecurity, voice applications and financial analysis, Gimlet CEO Zain Asgar said in an interview with Reuters. For this hardware, Gimlet plans to target selling to companies and startups that are building their entire products around AI in some way, Asgar said.
Gimlet plans to use the Cerebras hardware to run so-called frontier models — the cutting-edge AI models — that require enormous amounts of computing power to run speedily.

Cerebras plans to supply its CS-4 systems, which it unveiled over the summer, over one to two years, its CEO, Andrew Feldman, said. Gimlet plans to make the CS-4 hardware available in its cloud in 2027, the company said.
The deal is "further validation from Cerebras ... of how easy it is to deploy, even in heterogeneous environments," Feldman said, referring to installing the hardware alongside chips and systems from other companies.
Cerebras and Gimlet declined to disclose the financial terms of the deal. Gimlet will be responsible for maintaining and operating the systems once delivered by Cerebras. 
OpenAI and companies such as Nvidia have recognized the importance of the ability to perform speedy inference. Earlier this year, Cerebras signed a deal to supply OpenAI with chips. And last year, Nvidia signed a licensing deal with Groq for the company's chips and hardware.

By Krystal Hu
Sept 28 : Seligman Investments has doubled the deployable capital of its venture arm to $1 billion less than a year after launching it, betting that the physical bottlenecks of the artificial intelligence buildout will produce the next wave of large technology companies, its executives told Reuters.
Seligman Ventures, the private investment arm of the Silicon Valley-based technology investor, launched in February 2026 with $500 million and has since invested over $300 million across 14 investments in AI hardware, connectivity and cybersecurity.

The expansion reflects renewed investor interest in capital-intensive hardware after two decades in which Silicon Valley returns were built largely on software. Venture investment in U.S. and Canadian startups hit a record $392 billion in the first half of 2026, about $10.7 billion of which went into semiconductor startups, on pace to exceed last year's total, according to Crunchbase.
"The amount of deal flow we have gotten is 10 or 15 times more than what I anticipated when I joined," said Umesh Padval, managing partner at Seligman Ventures. "We didn't want to lose the AI, cybersecurity or the datacenter train." 
Seligman's portfolio spans much of what goes into a data center, from Nvidia competitor SambaNova to optical maker Lumilens.
The firm is pursuing a barbell strategy, pairing early-stage bets with late-stage and pre-IPO checks, Padval said. It will continue to look for investment opportunities in accelerators, networking, power and cooling, as well as cybersecurity.
The capital increase is also part of a broader push by public-market managers to reach technology companies earlier, as startups stay private for longer. Unlike many crossover funds, which are public-market investors that also buy into private companies, Seligman takes an active role, holding six board seats and three board observer seats. 
It is a second attempt at venture investing for Paul Wick, chief investment officer at Columbia Seligman Technology and Information Fund, part of Columbia Threadneedle Investments. An earlier late-stage effort launched in 1997 was wound down after the dot-com collapse. Wick cited a lack of board representation, reliance on third-party deal sourcing and team selection as the lessons from that period.
"This time around we have two people who are going on boards of companies," Wick said. "Our ability to protect ourselves and to better understand our private-company investments is just so enhanced."
The venture platform draws on a public-markets operation led by Wick, who manages the roughly $29 billion Columbia Seligman Technology and Information Fund. The firm also oversees a $7.5 billion technology hedge fund business.
That structure is central to Seligman's pitch against traditional venture firms. The venture team brings private sourcing and board involvement, and works with public market analysts to assess whether a startup can withstand competition from established players, executives said.
"We have a private knowledge of 400 companies in the private world. We marry that with public-market data analysis to bring out a thesis as to which ones we invest in," said Padval, who expects to make five to 10 new investments over the next 12 months.

Source: Reuters

Sept 28 : Meta Platforms has poached MongoDB CEO Chirantan "CJ" Desai to spearhead a new business designed to bring the social media giant's AI tools to corporate customers.
Shares of the database software provider tumbled 18 per cent in morning trading on Monday as he is leaving after less than a year as the top boss.
Desai, a veteran technology executive, took over the role from Dev Ittycheria. MongoDB has appointed Ittycheria as interim CEO as it searches for a permanent replacement.
"While the departure is disappointing, we believe MongoDB remains well-positioned strategically and view the share-price reaction as overdone," brokerage Piper Sandler said in a note.

Meta said on Monday it would bring its AI models, agents and tools to businesses under its new Meta Enterprise Platform, including the newly launched Muse, Meta Business Agent and coding tools.
The company launched Muse earlier this month, a personal AI agent designed to carry out tasks such as shopping, booking travel, sending emails and making payments on behalf of users.
Muse has rapidly climbed in Apple's App Store and Google Play rankings in recent weeks and has been described by analysts as potentially the biggest app launch in the US since ChatGPT in November 2022 that helped kick off the AI boom.
Desai will directly report to Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg in the newly created role of chief enterprise platform officer and will focus on turning the company's AI stack into products and services that companies can deploy for their own businesses.
Before joining MongoDB, Desai led product and engineering at Cloudflare and spent nearly eight years at ServiceNow, including as president and chief operating officer.
MongoDB provides database software used by businesses to build and run applications, with tools for data management, search, analytics and AI.

items.summary: SpaceX's giant Starship rocket reached orbit for the first time on Monday and deployed new Starlink satellites, achieving milestones in its 14th test flight despite an engine failure and a decision to cut the mission short.
items.body:
SpaceX's (SPCX.O) giant Starship rocket reached orbit for the first time on Monday and deployed new Starlink satellites, achieving milestones in its 14th test flight despite an engine failure and a decision to cut the mission short.
The uncrewed mission was scheduled to last 10 hours, but was reduced to three after one of Starship's three main engines shut down prematurely following separation from the spacecraft's lower-stage Super Heavy booster rocket.
It is unclear how much of a setback Monday's engine failure, the latest glitch since Starship test flights began in 2023, will pose for the goal of Elon Musk's newly public company to put the powerful spacecraft into routine service later this year.
Unlike past Starship flights, Monday's mission was both a high-stakes test of the next-generation rocket and an operational endeavor carrying millions of dollars' worth of Starlink satellites to orbit, representing Starship's first revenue-generating mission, even though its final design is still under development.
SpaceX shares fell 2% on Monday. Much of SpaceX's market worth and continued investor confidence in the company — valued at $2 trillion as of Friday's close — ride on the success of Starship, which was designed as the world's first fully reusable spacecraft.
The 40-story-tall vehicle, consisting of a Super Heavy booster rocket topped by the main upper-stage Starship vessel, launched from SpaceX's Starbase complex along the Gulf of Mexico near Brownsville.
The Super Heavy booster lofted the Starship upper stage into space before returning itself to Gulf waters for an engine-controlled splashdown, following hard landings for the booster on two previous missions. Some engines on that booster stopped working during its descent, SpaceX said.
Upon reaching space, one of Starship's three main engines shut down prematurely, a development that led SpaceX spokesperson Dan Huot to announce on the company's live stream of the mission that the craft would be unable to reach orbit.
"The team has made the call not to commit to orbit," Huot said.
But Huot reversed course minutes later after an update from engineers confirmed that the craft could still attempt to fire other onboard engines that would boost it into orbit, which Starship successfully did minutes later.
SATELLITES DEPLOYED Once in orbit, Starship deployed 26 next-generation Starlink satellites one by one at an altitude of roughly 269 km (161 miles), marking the ship's first orbital deployments.
"All 26 Starlink V3 operational satellites deployed and operating nominally," Musk wrote on X.
"Deploying all 26 Starlink V3 satellites into target orbit is a huge win, especially since this marks Starship's very first revenue-generating commercial flight," said Dean Sladen, quality manager and aerospace engineer at Accu Components. "But from an engineering perspective, the real story was how the team handled that engine failure during ascent."
Engine issues have popped up on some of Starship's previous suborbital flights in space, a lingering challenge for the program in an area crucial to the rocket's ability to maneuver in space. While that function is less critical for low-orbiting Starlink deployments, it is crucial for Starship's future assignments of taking NASA astronauts to the moon.
NASA administrator Jared Isaacman, writing on X, congratulated SpaceX on "getting Ship to orbit and managing every step in a safe, responsible, and especially inspirational way."
Starship's controlled descent into the Pacific culminated with a thruster maneuver that flipped the vehicle vertically so that it hit the sea in a nose-up position. Fire engulfed the base of the rocket as it touched down on the ocean surface before tipping on its side, followed by a large fireball. The company had not planned to recover and reuse the spacecraft from the sea following the mission.
TEST MISSION WITH REAL PAYLOAD Starship was built to launch SpaceX's Starlink satellites more frequently and carry future NASA missions to the moon. Reaching orbit, a primary benchmark for any new rocket designed to deliver payloads to space, was a long-delayed feat for Starship, which Musk once predicted would be achieved in 2022, to be followed by satellite deployments in 2023.
All 13 of Starship's previous test flights since 2023 were limited to suborbital space in a nearly decade-long development campaign that has cost SpaceX more than [USN:L1N4140YR TEXT:"$15 billion"] to date. Musk has said he envisions ultimately flying hundreds or thousands of Starship missions a year, a launch pace unprecedented in the space industry.
"Starship is 2 to 3 years away from hourly flights," Musk wrote on X on Sunday.
Analysts estimate Monday's launch of SpaceX's new V3 Starlink satellites equals hundreds of millions of dollars in projected revenue for its Starlink unit, based on the network's added customer capacity — underscoring Starship's role in [USN:L1N43U1F3 TEXT:"serving the company's profit nucleus"].
According to SpaceX, the V3 Starlink satellites deployed on Monday can handle 10 times more data than their predecessor V2 mini-sats that the company has launched 20 or 30 at a time on its workhorse Falcon 9 rockets. Seeking to build out his broadband satellite constellation at a faster pace, Musk wants to launch the V3s in batches of 60 per launch once Starship goes into routine operation.
Starship's orbital debut came three months after SpaceX [USN:L1N42K06V TEXT:"went public"] with a record-shattering IPO in June that made it the sixth-biggest US company by value and turned Musk, who founded it in 2002, into the world's first trillionaire.

items.title: Mirum's liver infection drug lowers virus levels in late-stage study
items.author: Sneha K
items.creator: Sneha K
items.summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals on Monday said its experimental hepatitis drug reduced levels of the virus in patients, meeting the main goal of a late-stage study.
items.body:
Mirum Pharmaceuticals (MIRM.O) on Monday said its experimental hepatitis drug reduced levels of the virus in patients, meeting the main goal of a late-stage study.
Here are some key details:
Mirum was testing brelovitug, an experimental monoclonal antibody that binds to the hepatitis B surface antigen, a protein found on the surface of the virus
The company was testing the treatment for chronic hepatitis delta virus, a liver infection that affects people already infected with hepatitis B
The disease, which the company estimates affects about 230,000 people in the US and Europe, can cause severe symptoms that can lead to liver damage and, in some cases, death
At 24 weeks, 56% of patients given 300 milligrams of brelovitug and 45% of those given 900 milligrams showed reduced hepatitis D virus levels and normal liver enzyme levels, compared with 0% in the delayed-treatment group, the company said
The company expects the drug to generate peak sales of at least $1 billion
The only FDA-approved treatment for the condition is Gilead's (GILD.O) [USN:L4N41Z1HU TEXT:"Hepcludex"]
"Brelovitug has a better benefit/risk profile," said RBC Capital Markets analyst Lisa Walter, adding that the latest results position it as the best-in-class treatment option
The drug was well tolerated across dose groups, with a safety profile consistent with previously reported data, Mirum said
Full results from the study will be presented at an upcoming medical congress, with the company expecting to submit a marketing application for the drug to the US FDA in the first half of 2027.

Sept 28 : REDLattice has agreed to go public in the US through a special purpose acquisition deal with blank-check firm Bold Eagle Acquisition, the companies said on Monday.
The transaction values the US-based defense technology company at a pre-money enterprise value of $1.25 billion.
Here are some details:
• The deal is expected to generate proceeds of up to roughly $610 million, including $335 million in committed capital from new and existing mutual fund and institutional investors.

• A SPAC is a shell company that raises capital through an initial public offering and then uses the funds to merge with or acquire a private company, taking it public without a traditional IPO.
• Founded in 2012, REDLattice provides lawful intercept, vulnerability research and intelligence acquisition solutions.
• "The company sells exclusively to government agencies at the nation-state or federal level and is a trusted partner to more than 100 customers across 23 countries," it added.

Sept 28 : AI firm Instinct said on Monday it raised $1 billion in its latest funding round, quadrupling its valuation to $10 billion, driven by soaring interest in agentic AI.
The round drew investments from Sequoia Capital, Benchmark Capital and Coatue. The startup's founder, Noah Shinn, told the Wall Street Journal last month that Instinct had raised $250 million at a $2.5 billion valuation.
Instinct is developing a personal agent that can perform day-to-day tasks autonomously. It was founded in 2025 by Shinn, who previously worked at Sierra, an AI customer service startup run by Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor.
Agentic AI is attracting strong interest from venture capitalists, who are betting that agents could eventually automate entire workflows traditionally handled by employees or software applications.

Instinct is now expanding beyond digital tasks with a concierge offering that can also call businesses on a user's behalf to make bookings, the firm said.

items.title: Dólar cotiza estable, mientras punto muerto entre EEUU e Irán impulsa al crudo y rendimientos
items.author: Chibuike Oguh, Samuel Indyk
items.creator: Chibuike Oguh, Samuel Indyk
items.summary: El dólar cotizó estable el lunes frente a sus principales pares, mientras la continua tensión entre Estados Unidos e Irán impulsó a los precios del petróleo y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro.
items.body:
El dólar cotizó estable el lunes frente a sus principales pares, mientras la continua tensión entre Estados Unidos e Irán impulsó a los precios del petróleo y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro.
Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos se mantienen sobre el 5% y en máximos de varias décadas, pero la confianza en el dólar se ha visto sometida a presión debido al largo conflicto en Oriente Medio, que ha obstaculizado el transporte de petróleo y gas a través del estrecho de Ormuz.
El euro cotizó en 1,1383 dólares, rondando un mínimo de dos meses frente al dólar, y la libra esterlina operó estable en 1,3256 dólares, pero cerca de su nivel más bajo en tres meses.
"Lo que sucede es que Estados Unidos rechazó la oferta iraní y los precios del petróleo se dispararon, ejerciendo una presión alcista sobre los rendimientos estadounidenses; eso es lo que está impulsando al dólar en términos generales", señaló Marc Chandler, estratega jefe de mercado de Bannockburn Forex.
Los futuros del crudo Brent un 1%, a 105,28 dólares por barril, después de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, rechazó un acuerdo de paz con Irán.
Los riesgos relacionados con el suministro energético y los sólidos fundamentos de la economía estadounidense han agravado el temor a la inflación y han llevado a los operadores a descontar una postura más agresiva de la Reserva Federal, mientras que el aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo también ha respaldado al dólar.
El índice dólar , que mide la cotización de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas, apenas varió a 101,20, cerca de un máximo de dos meses.
"La atención del mercado sigue centrada principalmente en los precios del petróleo, ya que sus últimas subidas reflejan el nuevo deterioro de las negociaciones entre Estados Unidos e Irán y el rechazo por parte del presidente Trump a la propuesta iraní de la semana pasada de reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz", dijeron analistas de Scotiabank, liderados por Shaun Osborne, en una nota a los inversores.
"El alcance y la duración de la subida de los precios de la energía son factores clave para los responsables de política monetaria de los bancos centrales, y están impulsando un aumento continuado de las expectativas de endurecimiento de la política monetaria por parte de los principales bancos centrales de las economías desarrolladas", agregó.
La atención del mercado se centrará ahora en la publicación de datos económicos de Estados Unidos: el índice PCE (USPCEM=ECI) el miércoles y las nóminas no agrícolas (USNFAR=ECI) el viernes; se espera que ambos indicadores respalden la continuidad del endurecimiento de la política monetaria.

Higher household costs are turning shoppers more selective and value-seeking. Retailers, including Walmart, Kohl's and American Eagle, have raised concerns on consumers' spending capacity ahead of the key shopping period that drives end-of-year sales.

items.title: サウジアラビアの石油パイプライン、修復経て輸出を再開－関係者
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： サウジアラビアは、ドローン攻撃を受けて損傷した国内横断の主要石油パイプラインを復旧させ、同パイプライン経由での原油輸出を開始した。事情を直接知る関係者が明らかにした。

国営石油会社サウジアラムコは先週、東西石油パイプラインをテストし、圧力を高める作業を行うなどして、週末までの本格的な輸送再開を目指していた。パイプラインの運用に詳しい関係者によると、海外向けの出荷は現在再開している。

サウジアラムコとサウジアラビアのエネルギー省は、コメントの要請に今のところ応じていない。

サウジアラビアは、ホルムズ海峡の代替として活用してきたパイプラインを、再び使えるようになった。供給確保を強く求めてきた買い手にとっては安心材料となる。

サウジアラビアは9月、ホルムズ海峡ルートの利用を増やしたことで、原油輸出全体を日量500万バレル超と、イラン戦争開始後の最高水準に押し上げた。供給の大半はアジア向けだ。

東西石油パイプラインが全面的に輸送能力を回復すれば、トレーダーはサウジアラビアがホルムズ海峡経由でどの程度の原油輸送を続けるかに注目することになる。事情に詳しい関係者は今月、全面復旧には約6週間かかる可能性があるとしていた。イラン戦争が長期化する中、船舶が時折攻撃を受けるなど、ホルムズ海峡ルートには依然としてリスクが伴う。

同時に、サウジアラビア西部に沿う紅海ルートは、イエメンの親イラン派武装勢力フーシ派の脅威にさらされている。フーシ派は今月、サウジ南西部のエネルギーインフラや、東西石油パイプラインの終点である紅海沿岸の港湾都市ヤンブーなどを標的に、攻撃を激化させている。

サウジアラビアのパイプラインの日量700万バレルの輸送能力のうち、通常は約200万バレルがサウジ西岸の製油所に送られ、残りが輸出されていた。この輸出分はイラン戦争中、市場の生命線となり、原油価格の急騰を抑えるのに役立っていた。

items.title: Ethiopian pro-government forces claim capture of strategic Tigray town
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ethiopia's military and allied militiamen captured a strategic town in the conflict-hit region of Tigray, a pro-government militia said on Monday, turning the tables after an opposition offensive launched from the region last week.
items.body:
Ethiopia's military and allied militiamen captured a strategic town in the conflict-hit region of Tigray, a pro-government militia said on Monday, turning the tables after an [USN:L6N45F0AV TEXT:"opposition offensive"] launched from the region last week.
Video posted by the pro-government Tigrai Peace Force on its Facebook page and verified by Reuters showed soldiers marching through the streets of Alamata, a town about 120 km (75 miles) south of Tigray's capital of Mekelle, waving Ethiopian flags.
Two diplomatic sources also said the town had fallen, while a source with links to pro-opposition forces told Reuters they were retreating from Alamata and expected the town to be under the federal military's control in a matter of hours.
The latest fighting pits Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government against the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), a guerrilla movement turned political party that dominated Ethiopian politics for nearly three decades until Abiy took office in 2018.
Spokespeople for the Ethiopian military and the TPLF did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The capture of Alamata would be a major boon to federal forces as they press towards the regional capital Mekelle, about 120 km (75 miles) to the north. An important supply hub for troops, food and fuel near Tigray's southern border with the neighbouring Amhara region, Alamata changed hands several times during a 2020-2022 civil war between federal forces and TPLF fighters.
The fighting in Tigray and the neighbouring regions of Amhara and Afar marks the collapse of a fragile, four-year-old peace deal that ended one of Africa's deadliest recent conflicts and raises the prospect of a broader war.
The renewed conflict adds to instability in the Horn of Africa, already unsettled by Sudan's civil war, frictions over Red Sea access and spillover from Middle East conflicts.
ETHIOPIAN MILITARY ACCUSES NEIGHBOURS OF BACKING OPPOSITION The 2020-2022 civil war stemmed from a breakdown in relations between the TPLF and Abiy.
In recent months, the TPLF and the federal government have traded accusations of violating the Pretoria Agreement, the November 2022 deal that ended that war. Three days before launching its offensive, the TPLF [USN:L6N45D0K7 TEXT:"announced a new alliance"] with six other armed groups across Ethiopia aimed at overthrowing Abiy's government.
In comments broadcast on state media on Sunday, the top Ethiopian military commander, Berhanu Jula, reiterated accusations that Ethiopia's neighbour and historical rival Eritrea was supporting the opposition forces, alongside Sudan's armed forces and Egypt.
Eritrea and Sudan's army have denied the allegations.
In a response to questions from Reuters, Egypt's foreign ministry spokesperson Nader Zaki said the country's policy is "full respect for the sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity of states ... and rejection of any practices that could undermine regional peace and stability."
TELECOMMUNICATIONS NETWORKS REMAIN DOWN IN TIGRAY The conflict has raised fears of a return to the humanitarian crisis experienced during the 2020-2022 war when the federal government severed communications with Tigray and access to food, cash and medicines was severely restricted.
The region is yet to recover and now faces drought linked to El Nino.
In Tigray, internet and phone networks remained disrupted for a fourth day. Four sources told Reuters on Friday that the TPLF had [USN:L6N45H08A TEXT:"ordered the networks"] shut down. The TPLF has not responded to requests for comment about this.
Daniel Meruts, a lawyer from Mekelle, told Reuters he had been stranded in Addis Ababa since the TPLF took over three airports in Tigray last week and flights were suspended.
“After communication, internet and phone lines were shut down, I haven't been able to connect with family...It is very heavy,” he said.
French aid group Medecins Sans Frontieres said it was seeing a sharp increase in war casualties at hospitals in Tigray.
The pace of war-wounded patients arriving at hospitals in the towns of Korem and Alamata more than doubled last week, it said late Monday.
The International Committee of the Red Cross in Ethiopia said on Monday that it evacuated 161 people from Mekelle to the capital of neighbouring Afar state, including African Union monitors, federal police, Ethiopian Airlines employees and Red Cross staff.

items.title: 米国債下落、10年債は07年以来の高利回り－原油高で追加利上げの思惑
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 28日の金融市場では米国債売りが一段と強まった。ホルムズ海峡の開放に関してイランが提示した最新の提案をトランプ米大統領が拒否したことを受け、原油相場が上昇した。S&P500種株価指数は今月の上昇分を帳消しにし、ナスダック100指数は約1.5%安。

米国債は大半の年限で利回りが10ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇した。10年債と30年債の利回りはそれぞれ2007年、2004年以来の高水準付近にある。米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の金融政策の影響を受けやすい短期債の利回りも急上昇した。

エネルギー価格の上昇がインフレにつながり、主要中央銀行による追加利上げ観測が広がったことから、世界的に債券売りが広がっている。米国では、企業活動の急拡大や政府債務の水準を巡る懸念も債券売りに拍車をかけている。

ウエストパック銀行の債券調査責任者ダミアン・マカロー氏は「FRBがタカ派的なメッセージを発し続けていることと、原油価格が100ドルを上回っていることが、債券売りを促す重要な要因となっている」と述べた。

イランがホルムズ海峡再開の条件を緩和しない姿勢を示したことから、原油価格は急上昇した。ニュースサイトのアクシオスによると、トランプ氏はイラン政府の最新提案を拒否したものの、今週中に交渉が再開すると予想している。

エネルギー価格の上昇で、FRBにはインフレ抑制に向けた利上げ圧力が強まっている。スワップ市場はあと3回の利上げを完全に織り込み、4回目の可能性も見込んでいる。

金融引き締め観測を背景に短期金利が急上昇し、2年債に対する10年債の上乗せ利回りは先週、一時17bpまで縮小。2025年初め以来の小幅なスプレッドとなった。

items.title: Nvidia sets biggest-ever buyback plan as AI chip competition weighs on stock performance
items.author: Anhata Rooprai
items.creator: Anhata Rooprai
items.summary: Nvidia boosted its share buyback authorization by a record $150 billion, eclipsing Apple's $110 billion approval in 2024, making a big bet on its own stock as intensifying AI-chip competition weighs on its performance relative to peers.
items.body:
Nvidia (NVDA.O) boosted its share buyback authorization by a record $150 billion, eclipsing Apple's (AAPL.O) [USN:L1N3H53L5 TEXT:"$110 billion"] approval in 2024, making a big bet on its own stock as intensifying AI-chip competition weighs on its performance relative to peers.
Shares of Santa Clara, California-based Nvidia rose more than 2%. Through Friday, the stock was up just over 20% this year, broadly in line with the Nasdaq 100 (.NDX) but trailing AMD (AMD.O) , which has more than doubled, and Intel (INTC.O) , which has more than tripled.
Technology companies are racing to build AI infrastructure, but investors are questioning whether the massive spending boom that propelled Nvidia to become the world's most valuable company can be sustained.
With strong demand for its pricey processors generating billions in cash, Nvidia is using part of the windfall to boost its remaining buyback capacity to $235 billion, which it expects to deploy through fiscal 2028.
"The AI buildout won't continue at its current pace forever, but Nvidia is signaling confidence that demand for its hardware and services has staying power," said Jacob Bourne, an analyst at Emarketer.
"Its cash generation is currently strong enough that it believes it can continue investing heavily in the business while also returning capital to shareholders," he added.
Nvidia shares were trading at about 16.5 times 12-month forward earnings, their lowest multiple since January 2015 and well below the 15-year average of 30, according to LSEG data, which some analysts see as a sign of slowing profit-growth expectations.
Ben Barringer, head of technology research at Quilter Cheviot, said the buyback echoes Apple's playbook of using repurchases to support its stock as growth slows and valuation multiples come under pressure.
[USN:L6N45H0X7 TEXT:"Stock buybacks fell"] about 50% between July and September 23 as companies turned more cautious amid heavy investment needs, partly driven by the AI boom fueling Nvidia's growth, and economic uncertainty.
"Our cash generation gives us the capacity to invest in the technologies that advance this transformation and return capital to shareholders," CEO Jensen Huang said in a statement.
Nvidia's growth outlook backs that stance. Last month, Nvidia forecast [USN:L6N44N14F TEXT:"about 70% revenue growth"] for fiscal 2028, reassuring investors who have questioned how long the AI spending surge can last after years of explosive growth.
Monday's $150 billion buyback increase exceeds the market capitalization of about 84% of the S&P 500 constituents, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Nvidia ended the July quarter with $22.44 billion in cash and cash equivalents. It last announced an [USN:L4N41X1UY TEXT:"$80 billion share buyback"] in May.

items.title: Tata Trusts offers strategic recast plan for Tata Sons to skip listing
items.summary: The reorganisation of the holdco can be done through the merger of Tata Electronics Systems Solutions Private Ltd (TESS) and Tata Consulting Engineers (TCE) with Tata Sons Pvt Ltd (TSPL), according to ...
items.body:
Home / Companies / News / Tata Trusts offers strategic recast plan for Tata Sons to skip listing

Tata Trusts offers strategic recast plan for Tata Sons to skip listing Tells Tata Sons board that TESS, TCE can merge with holdco

Earlier this month, the RBI rejected the Tata Sons application, asking the company to comply with the norms immediately (Image Credit: Bloomberg)

Nivedita Mookerji New Delhi 6 min read Last Updated : Sep 28 2026 | 11:35 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Tata Trusts on Monday evening announced a strategic reorganisation plan for Tata Sons, proposing to revert to its old operational model through an amalgamation process to remain a privately held company. The philanthropic organisation, led by Chairman Noel Tata, shared the plan with Tata Sons before briefing the media on it.  
Reiterating its position, Tata Trusts, the largest shareholder with a 66 per cent stake in Tata Sons, said the restructuring would give Tata Sons its own operations and revenues. This would ensure that the holding company of the salt-to-software conglomerate would “neither be a non-banking financial company (NBFC) nor a core investment company (CIC)”. Without the upper-layer NBFC and CIC tags, Tata Sons would not have to list, Tata Trusts maintained, while pointing out that the reorganisation would preserve the century-old organisational structure of the group.  
 

The reorganisation of the holdco can be done through the merger of Tata Electronics Systems Solutions Private Ltd (TESS) and Tata Consulting Engineers (TCE) with Tata Sons Pvt Ltd (TSPL), according to Tata Trusts. TESS is a fully owned subsidiary of Tata Electronics and TCE is a leading private sector engineering and project consultancy. Farokh N Subedar, advisor to Tata Trusts, spoke to reporters in Mumbai about the restructuring plan. Subedar, 71, is a Tata group veteran, having retired in 2017 as chief operating officer and company secretary of Tata Sons. He worked as vice-chairman of the Noel Tata-led Tata Investment Corporation till last year.  

Arguing that the proposed plan would be in the best interests of the Tata group as well as its stakeholders, in addition to being compliant with regulations, Tata Trusts said it had written to the Tata Sons board to consider and approve the proposal and to take necessary steps, including applying to the RBI for the necessary ‘no-objection certificate’. Tata Trusts, along with Tata Sons, would engage with the RBI on all aspects of the proposed rejig, a Tata Trusts statement said.  
Tata Sons did not comment. The Tata Trusts statement said the proposed strategic reorganisation of the business and operations of Tata Sons is not a new pathway. For almost 80 years of its 100-year existence, Tata Sons had operating businesses and operating revenues, which enabled it to fund its other, newer business ventures, the statement said. “To recall, as recently as 2004, Tata Consultancy Services was a business division of Tata Sons before it was demerged into a separate subsidiary.” The statement added that this was also the case with other operating businesses of Tata Sons.

Explainer: Why Tata Sons and Tata Trusts are locked in a power struggle

“Accordingly, the proposed reorganisation will result in Tata Sons reverting to its previous operating model, with its own operations and revenues, in addition to being a holding company for the Tata Group,” Tata Trusts said.  
This will also be in line with the previous classification (after 2004) by the Reserve Bank of India of Tata Sons as a non-banking, non-financial company, it stated.  
The RBI placed Tata Sons on the upper-layer NBFC list in September 2022, giving the company three years to get listed. In 2024, Tata Sons cleared all its debt and filed an application to voluntarily surrender its CIC status so that it could remain a private company. Earlier this month, the RBI rejected the Tata Sons application, asking the company to comply with the norms immediately.  

While the Tata Sons board on September 17 backed the proposal to list Tata Sons, as suggested by the RBI, Noel Tata, a nominee director at Tata Sons, opposed any listing move. Tata Trusts, which has opposed listing Tata Sons, said at the board meeting and thereafter that listing is not the only option. It suggested restructuring Tata Sons as a solution. Noel Tata had told Tata Sons that "considerable room remains" to negotiate and that the board should "occupy that room" rather than concede to listing.  
The Shapoorji Pallonji group, the second-largest shareholder of Tata Sons with over an 18 per cent stake, is supporting listing. Listing of Tata Sons would enable it to partly dilute its stake and reduce its mounting debts.  

Shriram Subramanian, founder and managing director of InGovern, a proxy advisory firm, told Business Standard that it may be difficult for the RBI to agree to a restructuring plan at this point since it has already rejected the Tata Sons application for deregistering its CIC status.  
Working out the math, Tata Trusts on Monday said the amalgamated entity, arising out of the merger of TESS and TCE with Tata Sons, will have an operating revenue of ₹1.05 trillion, far in excess of its income from financial assets of ₹40,072 crore, constituting 64.3 per cent of the total income of the amalgamated entity. Also, it will not meet the "principal business criteria” of an NBFC as well as the conditions applicable to a CIC (net assets aggregating over ₹2 trillion, out of which investment in group companies will be more than ₹1.77 trillion, representing less than 90 per cent of the aggregate net assets of the resultant entity), the statement pointed out.  

According to the RBI, any upper-layer NBFC with an asset size of over ₹1 trillion must go for listing. Tata Sons' standalone assets were pegged at more than ₹2 trillion.  
An amalgamation of genuine operating, non-financial companies (such as TESS and TCE) with an NBFC (such as Tata Sons) will need to be undertaken in accordance with the RBI provisions (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Voluntary Amalgamation) Directions, 2025, including the requirement to obtain a prior no-objection certificate from the regulator. “Given that Tata Sons will also cease to be a CIC upon the conclusion of the proposed reorganisation, it will require to surrender its certificate of registration,” Tata Trusts said.  

It mentioned that the restructuring would be in sync with the “unanimous resolutions passed by the boards of Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and Sir Ratan Tata Trust in July 2025 wherein it was agreed that all endeavours should be made to ensure that the status of Tata Sons as an unlisted private company should continue.”   Plan B for Tata Sons
Tata Trusts’ proposals:  
Merge Tata Electronics Systems Solutions and Tata Consulting Engineers with Tata Sons
Seek central bank’s prior no-objection for merger
Bring operating businesses into Tata Sons alongside its group investments
Ensure operating income exceeds the threshold needed to stay outside the NBFC/CIC framework
Keep group-company investments below 90% of net assets to avoid CIC classification
Surrender Tata Sons’ CIC registration after the restructuring

items.author: Darshan R, Fergal Smith
items.creator: Darshan R, Fergal Smith
items.summary: Canada's main stock index fell to a nearly two-month low on Monday as the global bond market sell-off continued and after a steep decline in the price of gold weighed on mining stocks.
items.body:
Canada's main stock index fell to a nearly two-month low on Monday as the global bond market sell-off continued and after a steep decline in the price of gold weighed on mining stocks.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) ended down 311.03 points, or 0.9%, at 35,489.86, its lowest closing level since July 31.
"Canadian equities are caught between the benefit of higher oil prices and the drag from rising bond yields, while elevated rates remain a risk to the country's housing market and leave bank stocks looking overbought," said Matt Skipp, president at SW8 Asset Management.
US Treasury yields rose and Canada's 10-year yield touched its highest level since October 2023 at 4.017%, as elevated oil prices fanned fears that inflation would stay higher for longer and prompt more Federal Reserve interest rate increases.
Canadian GDP data for July, due on Tuesday, could offer clues on the state of the domestic economy. Economists expect a flat reading compared to June.
The materials sector (.GSPTTMT) , which includes metal mining stocks, fell 3.7% as gold dropped 3.9% to a nearly eight-week low.
Heavily weighted financials (.SPTTFS) were also a drag, falling 0.7%.
[USN:L1N45J06Z TEXT:"U.S. crude oil futures"] settled up 0.2% at $92.60 a barrel, after easing off session highs on expectations that Qatari mediators would hold talks with the US and Iran to try to find a possible peace deal.
Energy (.SPTTEN) added 0.3%, while consumer discretionary was up 0.8% as Gildan Activewear (GIL.TO) clawed back some recent declines.
Donald Trump Jr.-backed Unusual Machines (UMAC.A) and an unnamed US asset management company have invested $10 million in Canadian drone services firm Draganfly (DPRO.CD) , boosting the company's shares.

Sept 28 : Donald Trump Jr.-backed Unusual Machines and an unnamed US asset management company have invested $10 million in Canadian drone services firm Draganfly, as defense sector investments gather pace amid persistent geopolitical tensions.
Draganfly said on Monday it would use the proceeds to accelerate the development of advanced strategic capabilities and to fund general working capital needs. Reuters was the first to report the investment.
Draganfly's New York-listed shares were up 5.2 per cent in pre-market trading.
Unusual Machines, which counts Trump Jr. as a member of its advisory board, is known for its drone motors and other control components.

The Trump family's investments in several companies have drawn scrutiny amid concerns about potential conflicts of interest, particularly its stakes in defense firms that regularly compete for government contracts.
Donald Trump Jr. and his brother Eric Trump have also backed Israeli drone-maker XTEND and Powerus.
Trump Jr. did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Draganfly develops and manufactures unmanned aircraft systems and related software for defense, public safety, agriculture and industrial inspection markets.
The company has supplied drones to Ukraine, where its systems have been used for mapping, humanitarian and other missions.
In February, it raised $50 million via a share offering to fund growth plans, working capital, deals and development.
The investment by Unusual Machines and the asset management company is based on Draganfly's closing price of $5.35 on September 25, the company said, and is expected to close by around September 30.
Unusual Machines and the asset management company will invest $5 million each.
Draganfly's New York-listed shares have fallen about 23 per cent so far this year, up to Friday's close, while those of Unusual Machines have surged about 89 per cent.

items.title: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo's life-threatening landfall
items.author: Aida Pelaez-fernandez, Raquel Cunha
items.creator: Aida Pelaez-fernandez, Raquel Cunha
items.summary: Mexican authorities urged residents of Baja California Sur to prepare for the imminent arrival of major Hurricane Polo on Monday, warning of deadly winds and flash floods.
items.body:
Mexican authorities urged residents of Baja California Sur to prepare for the imminent arrival of major Hurricane Polo on Monday, warning of deadly winds and flash floods.
"Conditions deteriorating over portions of Baja California as life-threatening winds and flash floods expected to occur soon," the US National Hurricane Center said in a post on X.
Restaurant and store owners in the small coastal towns of Loreto and Ciudad Constitucion boarded up doors and windows overnight to protect their businesses, in anticipation of worsening weather conditions.
Polo is expected to make landfall in the state of Baja California Sur in the evening, then move inland into southern Sonora on Tuesday morning, the NHC said in a bulletin.
Access to beaches has been restricted and maritime activities suspended in high-risk areas in the state, Laura Velazquez, head of Mexico's civil protection agency, said during Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum's morning news conference.
Velazquez asked citizens to remain calm as power and internet services will most likely be out for a few hours, until midnight.
On Monday afternoon, the Category 3 hurricane was about 80 miles (125 km) west-southwest of Cabo San Lazaro in Baja California Sur, with maximum sustained winds near 115 mph (185 kph) and higher gusts, according to the NHC.
The storm is expected to dump 6 to 12 inches (15 to 30 cm) of rain across the state, raising the risk of life-threatening flooding and mudslides.
Despite weakening slightly, Polo is expected to make landfall as a dangerous Category 3 hurricane, private forecaster AccuWeather said. It noted the storm was set to hit a sparsely populated area, though small towns, including Las Barrancas and San Juanico — both with fewer than 1,000 residents, according to the latest census — lie in its path.
Polo, which has tracked off Mexico's Pacific coast for several days, has brought heavy rain, destructive waves and strong winds, prompting evacuations, port closures and school cancellations.
After passing the Baja California peninsula, home to tourist destinations, including Los Cabos and the Arch of Cabo San Lucas, Polo is expected to weaken. However, it could still make a second landfall on mainland Mexico as a hurricane.
TWO LANDFALLS, WIDESPREAD IMPACT Polo is expected to make a second landfall in southern Sonora late Monday or early Tuesday, the NHC said.
The Baja California state government has opened temporary shelters in five municipalities for residents of high-risk areas. Early in the morning, 78 people had been evacuated as a precautionary measure to a shelter in Ciudad Constitucion.
The civil protection agency urged residents to stay home but said that if their homes are at risk, they should move to temporary shelters.
Sonora is expected to receive 4 to 6 inches (10 to 15 cm) of rain, with isolated totals of up to 8 inches (20 cm), raising the risk of life-threatening flooding and mudslides.
Storm surge could also bring significant coastal flooding and large, destructive waves to both the Baja California peninsula and Mexico's mainland Pacific coast.
STORM RACHEL EXPECTED TO BECOME HURRICANE Meanwhile, Tropical Storm Rachel, currently around 225 miles from Acapulco on the Pacific coast, was moving toward the west-northwest at a speed of 8 mph, according to the NHC.
Rachel is forecast to strengthen into a hurricane by midweek and remain offshore, moving parallel to Mexico's southwestern coast.

items.title: 来年の仏大統領選、決選投票は極右と極左の対決に＝世論調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２８日 ロイター] - 来年のフランス大統領選挙を巡って２８日に発表された世論調査によると、極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」
items.body:
[２８日 ロイター] - 来年のフランス大統領選挙を巡って２８日に発表された世論調査によると、極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」 を率いるマリーヌ・ルペン氏と、極左政党「不屈のフランス（ＬＦＩ）」を率いるジャンリュック・メランション氏が決選投票に進む見込み。

物価高、景気低迷、地政学的不安定が続く中、中道派は後れを取っている。

仏テレビ局など向けにトルーナ・ハリス・インタラクティブが実施した世論調査によると、ルペン氏は第１回投票で３５─３６％の得票率を獲得すると見込まれており、今月１４日に発表された従来調査の３３％から上昇。メランション氏は１７─１８％の得票率で、ルペン氏と共に決戦投票に進出する見通しだ。

中道派の有力候補であるエドゥアール・フィリップ氏は１３─１６％の得票率にとどまり、決選投票に進むには不十分と見られている。

決選投票でもルペン氏が優位に。調査によると、メランション氏との対決では６９％、フィリップ氏との対決では５７％の得票率で勝利する見込み。

items.title: 国債売却計画は金利低下に寄与、物価圧力強まれば利上げも＝英中銀副総裁

items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
［ロンドン　２８日　ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のラムズデン副総裁は２８日、保有国債削減に関する長期的な道筋に対し、市場は好意的に反応したもようで、借入コストがやや低下したと述べた。 

英中銀は１７日、４８８０億ポンド（６４７０億ドル）に上るギルト債（英国債）保有分の大半を２０３４年までに売却する計画を発表した。年間２００億ポンドのペースで売却を進める一方、短期債は満期償還を待ち、紙幣発行の裏付けとして１２００億ポンドの長期債は保有し続ける方針だ。発表後、英国債価格は長期債を中心に上昇し、利回りが低下した。
items.body:
［ロンドン　２８日　ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のラムズデン副総裁は２８日、保有国債削減に関する長期的な道筋に対し、市場は好意的に反応したもようで、借入コストがやや低下したと述べた。 

英中銀は１７日、４８８０億ポンド（６４７０億ドル）に上るギルト債（英国債）保有分の大半を２０３４年までに売却する計画を発表した。年間２００億ポンドのペースで売却を進める一方、短期債は満期償還を待ち、紙幣発行の裏付けとして１２００億ポンドの長期債は保有し続ける方針だ。発表後、英国債価格は長期債を中心に上昇し、利回りが低下した。  

ラムスデン氏はロンドンでの講演で、「１週間余り前に公表した一連の発表には多くの情報が含まれていたが、十分に理解され、好意的に受け止められたようだ」と述べた。「これは、市場が総額でより大規模な量的引き締め（ＱＴ）、あるいはより速いペースでのＱＴを予想していたことを示唆する」とし「今後のＱＴの道筋に関する不確実性が解消され、リスクプレミアムが低下した可能性もある」と述べた。

「金融政策は引き続き引き締め的だが、インフレ見通しに対する上振れ圧力が強まり続ければ、政策金利の引き上げが妥当となり得る」と述べた。

英中銀は今月の金融政策委員会で、６対３で政策金利の据え置きを決めた。ラムスデン氏は据え置きを支持した。

金融政策が既に引き締め的だったこともあり、英中銀はイラン戦争開始以降、利上げをしていない。

items.title: 円が対ドルで急反発､一時156円台半ば－三村財務官が再び円安警告
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 28日の外国為替市場で円がドルに対して急速に反発し、1週間ぶりの高値を付けた。政府当局者が円安にあらためて警告を発したことに反応した。

円は0.5%高の156円51銭まで上昇。三村淳財務官が、円の過小評価は問題とする意向を日米両政府が共有したメッセージは「非常にクリア」との認識を示したと、ロイター通信がインタビューを基に報道。この報道後に円は急速に下げを消し、上昇に転じた。

円は全般的に上昇し、ユーロに対しても一時0.5%高の178円20銭に達した。

円売り圧力が再び高まる中で、政府高官から円安を警戒する声が最近続いていた。高市早苗首相はトランプ米大統領との先週の会談で、「円の過小評価は問題」との懸念を共有したと表明。片山さつき財務相も25日夜のベッセント米財務長官との電話会談で、円が過小評価されているとの見方を再確認し、日米協力の一段の強化で合意したと述べていた。

ノムラ・インターナショナルの通貨ストラテジスト、宮入祐輔氏は「これにより、近い将来に日本の当局が実際介入してくる可能性に市場は十分警戒するはずだ」と指摘。「三村氏は以前、沈黙を保つことで市場に介入への警戒感を持たせる戦略を示していたが、その三村氏さえ25日から口先介入に加わった」と語った。

ロイター通信によると、三村氏は、市場がメッセージを額面通り受け止めてくれればいいと述べ、全体を見ながら対応を考えていると説明。再び介入の用意があるかについては、コメントを控えた。最近の円相場の動きに安心しているとも、満足しているとも言わず、追加介入の可能性に含みを持たせた格好だ。

ノムラの宮入氏は、三村氏までもが円安警戒論に加わったという事実は、当局が介入を準備している可能性を示唆するとの見解を示した。

日米当局は7月、円を押し上げようと15年ぶりの協調介入を実施。7月末から8月初めにかけ、日本側だけで月次で過去最大となる15兆3993億円の円買い介入を行った。

items.title: EU sanctions 10 individuals, 17 entities over alleged unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia
items.summary: The Council of the European Union on Monday imposed restrictive measures on 10 individuals and 17 entities over their alleged involvement in the unlawful deportation and forcible transfer of Ukrainian ...
items.body:
EU sanctions 10 individuals, 17 entities over alleged unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia The Council of the European Union on Monday imposed restrictive measures on 10 individuals and 17 entities over their alleged involvement in the unlawful deportation and forcible transfer of Ukrainian children to Russia and temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine.
ANI | Updated: 28-09-2026 22:55 IST | Created: 28-09-2026 22:55 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The Council of the European Union on Monday imposed restrictive measures on 10 individuals and 17 entities over their alleged involvement in the unlawful deportation and forcible transfer of Ukrainian children to Russia and temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine. According to a press release issued by the Council of the EU, those targeted are considered responsible for actions involving the transfer of Ukrainian children, their forced assimilation and what the bloc described as "indoctrination and militarised education."
The latest sanctions target individuals and organisations involved in activities that the EU says undermine or threaten Ukraine's "territorial integrity, sovereignty and independence." Among the entities listed are the Moscow City Tourism Committee and two Russian companies operating in children's recreation, tourism and entertainment services. The EU said these organisations were involved in activities focused on Russian history, war commemorations and military-patriotic education.
The sanctions also cover children's camps and sports centres in Russia and temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine, which the EU said played a role in cultural reorientation, propaganda-based education and military-patriotic activities aimed at integrating Ukrainian children into Russian identity frameworks. The package additionally includes the Songdowon International Children's Camp, a state-operated institution in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The Council said the camp participates in organised programmes involving the transfer of Ukrainian children from temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine in coordination with Russia and aimed at promoting pro-Russian narratives. Among the individuals sanctioned is Rustam Minnikhanov, President of the Republic of Tatarstan, whom the EU accused of facilitating the illegal deportation of Ukrainian children to camps located in the region.
The list also includes the Minister and deputy Ministers of Education and Science of certain occupied territories and the Minister of Sports and Tourism of the self-proclaimed Donetsk People's Republic, as well as heads of children's camps and schools. The EU said those listed are subject to an asset freeze, while EU citizens and companies are prohibited from making funds, financial assets or economic resources available to them. The individuals are also subject to a travel ban preventing them from entering or transiting through EU territory.
"The relevant legal acts have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union," the Council said. The EU said Russia is estimated to have deported and forcibly transferred more than 20,500 Ukrainian children since the start of its war of aggression against Ukraine, describing the actions as "serious breaches of international law and a violation of the fundamental rights of the child."
According to the Council, the transfers also aim to "erase Ukrainian identity and undermine the preservation of its future generations." The latest measures follow the European Council's conclusions of June 18, 2026, in which EU leaders reiterated their condemnation of Russia's war against Ukraine and reaffirmed support for Ukraine's independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity within its internationally recognised borders.
The European Council also said efforts to limit Russia's ability to wage war should continue and expressed the EU's readiness to increase pressure on Russia, including through further sanctions. (ANI)

items.title: 米ロ軍縮協議、再開なら長期の交渉必要＝ロシア大統領府
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　２８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２８日　ロイター］ - ロシア大統領府は２８日、ロシアと米国の軍備管理を巡る協議は本来ならとうに再開されているべきであり、実際に再開する場合には長期にわたる慎重な交渉が必要になるとの認識を示した。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は記者団に「これは非常に複雑な問題であり、極めて長期にわたる綿密な専門家協議が必要だ」と述べ、そうした協議は既に再開されているべきだったと指摘した。

米ロ間の新戦略兵器削減条約（新ＳＴＡＲＴ）は２０２６年２月に失効しており、その後の核軍備管理の枠組みが課題となっている。

トランプ米大統領は、米ロに中国を加えた３カ国の軍備管理交渉を呼びかけているが、中国は、自国の核戦力はロシアや米国よりはるかに小規模であるため、こうした協議に参加する必要はないと主張している。これについて、ペスコフ氏は、中国は参加しない意向を繰り返し明確にしており、ロシア側が把握する限り、その立場に変化はないと述べた。

items.title: トルコ政府、46社の資産凍結解除　投資ファンド調査巡り＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Can Sezer　Ezgi Erkoyun

[イスタンブール ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Can Sezer　Ezgi Erkoyun

[イスタンブール ２８日 ロイター] - トルコ政府は、投資ファンドに関する調査の下で４６社に科していた資産凍結命令を解除した。メディアが２８日に報じた。

今回の危機は、出来高の少ない複数の株式で価格操作の疑いが浮上し、投資ファンドに巨額の損失と解約圧力をもたらしたことを受け勃発。当局が金融の安定を支えるための緊急措置を講じるに至った。当局は、４６社、１８のファンド、４２人の個人の資産を凍結し、３７人に対して海外渡航禁止措置を科していた。

トルコ市場に打撃を与えた危機を背景に、与党幹部も辞任していた。

シムシェキ財務相は、市場を混乱させる取引に関与した者に対する法的手続きが継続中だと述べるとともに、政府がファンド投資家の権利を保護していると付け加えた。

ＲＢＣブルーベイのストラテジスト、ティム・アッシュ氏は「個人的には、トルコの資本市場を巡ってより根本的な改革に向けた動きが進んでいると考えている」と述べた。

items.title: 英空軍基地攻撃計画、外国政府関与の可能性を捜査　容疑者5人保釈
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Toby Shepheard

[ロンドン／フェアフォード（イングランド）　２８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Toby Shepheard

[ロンドン／フェアフォード（イングランド）　２８日　ロイター] - 英警察は２８日、米軍が使用する空軍基地への攻撃を企てたとみられる事件について、外国政府のために活動する人物が関与していた可能性があるか捜査していると明らかにした。この事件に関連して逮捕した容疑者５人については保釈するとした。

逮捕された５人はいずれもロンドン出身で２０代前半の英国人。英国南部フェアフォード空軍基地に向かう白いバン３台が走行しているとの地元農場主からの通報を受け、警察が２７日に拘束した。フェアフォード基地は、対イラン作戦に従事する米軍爆撃機の拠点となっている。

英国の対テロ警察トップを務めるローレンス・テイラー氏は、５人は２８日中に厳格な条件付きで保釈されると明らかにした。ただ、保釈は「捜査が終了したことを意味しない」とし、「複数の捜査線に沿って捜査を進めている」と表明。イランに直接言及しなかったものの、今回の事件に地政学的情勢が関係しているかどうか大きな関心が集まっていることは認識しているとし、「あらゆる可能性を排除せずに捜査している。外国政府の代理人などによって実行された可能性についても検証している」と述べた。

警察はこれまでのところ、逮捕された５人とイランとの関連性を指摘していない。捜査に詳しい関係筋によると、イランに関連した犯行だった可能性のほか、ロシアによる破壊工作やイスラム過激派による計画の可能性についても調べられているという。

在英イラン大使館は２８日、この件にイラン政府が関与しているとの見方を否定。この事件とイランを結び付けようとする動きを「断固として拒否し、強く非難する」とし、こうした「根拠がなく悪意に満ちた憶測」は英国での「反イラン感情をあおるプロパガンダ」を助長するだけだとＸに投稿した。

イランのイスラム革命防衛隊は７月、攻撃の出撃拠点として使われる基地は正当な標的になるとし、英国に対し米軍爆撃機のフェアフォード基地からの出撃を認めないよう警告していた。

トランプ米大統領は２８日、英警察が逮捕された５人の保釈を決めたことについて、自分なら保釈しないと述べた。 

フェアフォード空軍基地周辺での事件を受け、在英米国大使館は安全警報を発令し、米国民に対し警戒を怠らず、「自身の安全確保に十分留意する」よう呼びかけた。英国内のその他の米空軍基地でも警備体制が強化されている。

items.title: Stocks fall as higher oil prices, Treasury yields weigh
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak, Johann Cherian
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Johann Cherian
items.summary: US stocks fell on Monday as oil prices and Treasury yields increased, with investors weighing uncertainty over the prospects for an Iran war peace deal and the impact on the Federal Reserve's rate path.
items.body:
US stocks fell on Monday as oil prices and Treasury yields increased, with investors weighing uncertainty over the prospects for an Iran war peace deal and the impact on the Federal Reserve's rate path.
Crude prices had jumped after US President Donald Trump [USN:L6N45I080 TEXT:"rejected a peace deal"] from Iran but [USN:L1N45J06Z TEXT:"pared gains"] on expectations that Qatari mediators would hold talks with the two countries to find a possible deal.
After retreating from highs at the start of the month, oil prices have accelerated higher in recent days as hopes that a peace deal may be on the horizon have diminished.
The rising prices of crude and diesel fuel have fanned inflation worries and pushed US [USN:L6N45K0ZW TEXT:"Treasury yields higher"], along with comments from Fed officials indicating that more rate hikes might be needed if price pressures fail to moderate after the central bank raised interest rates by 25 basis points earlier this month.
"Iran is driving oil prices, and oil prices are driving inflation, and inflation is driving interest rates," said Jack Ablin, chief investment strategist and founding partner at Cresset Capital Management in Chicago. "We're getting to a point now where interest rates are looking pretty attractive relative to equities, which is really the first time in close to 20 years, so that's something that we're certainly paying attention to."
"It's less of an earnings story right now than it is a valuation story," he said. "When you get an asset class that has been fighting with one arm tied behind its back for 20 years, now all of a sudden it's looking pretty competitive."
WALL STREET INDEXES FALL The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) fell 347.11 points, or 0.67%, to 51,481.51, the S&P 500 (.SPX) lost 59.72 points, or 0.77%, to 7,683.69 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) lost 248.34 points, or 0.92%, to 26,820.38.
The decline for the S&P was its largest daily percentage drop since August 20.
Boeing (BA.N) shares tumbled 6.9% as one of the biggest drags on the Dow after US Federal Aviation Administration [USN:L1N45K0PN TEXT:"said it will delay"] certification of Boeing's long-delayed 737 MAX 10 until a newly disclosed software issue is resolved.
Bucking the broader trend was a 1.6% gain in Nvidia (NVDA.O) shares after the chip giant announced a [USN:L6N45K0LZ TEXT:"$150 billion share repurchase"] authorization, the biggest-ever company share buyback.
Iran announced a peace proposal at last week's United Nations General Assembly in New York, saying it had been relayed to the United States through Qatari mediators. While Trump said on Saturday he had rejected the offer, he told Axios on Sunday that he expected US negotiators to continue talks this week.
Federal Reserve Governor [USN:S0N44V00J TEXT:"Lisa Cook said"] on Monday she expects continued inflationary pressure in coming months stemming from AI-related demand and higher oil prices, though she stopped short of saying more interest rate hikes will be needed.
Expectations for a rate hike from the Fed at its October meeting have climbed in recent days, in part due to economic data indicating the economy was growing at a solid pace. Markets are currently pricing in a 70.3% chance for an increase of at least 25 basis points at the central bank's meeting next month, up from 57.6% a week ago and 17.7% a month earlier, according to CME FedWatch .
Several key economic releases are due this week, which could help shape the path of Fed policy, including a reading on inflation and the labor market, culminating in Friday's government payrolls report.
Tesla (TSLA.O) shares slumped 3.9% after brokerage J.P.Morgan lowered its price target on the stock, citing weak deliveries in the third quarter.
Declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 3.55-to-1 ratio on the New York Stock Exchange and by a 2.56-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq.
The S&P 500 posted four new 52-week highs and 29 new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 40 new highs and 249 new lows.
Volume on US exchanges was 16.71 billion shares, compared with the 16.85 billion average for the full session over the last 20 trading days.

items.title: タイ憲法裁、2月総選挙巡る異議申し立て退ける
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Panarat Thepgumpanat　Panu Wongcha-um

[バンコク ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Panarat Thepgumpanat　Panu Wongcha-um

[バンコク ２８日 ロイター] - タイの憲法裁判所は２８日、２月の総選挙の合法性に異議を唱える申し立てを退け、使用された投票用紙は投票の秘密を侵害していないとの判断を下した。

選挙ではアヌティン首相が率いる与党「タイの誇り党」が勝利。同党は経済の停滞や汚職疑惑などにより、国民の信頼を勝ち取ることに苦戦しているが、再選挙の可能性は回避された。

今回の訴訟は、投票用紙に印刷されたバーコードやＱＲコードを用いて有権者がどの候補者や政党を選んだかを特定できる可能性があるとして、オンブズマンが異議を申し立てていた。

憲法裁は、一部の投票用紙のバーコードが有権者の特定に利用される可能性はあったものの、それらは選挙当局による管理目的でのみ記載されたものであり、個々の投票を追跡する意図はなかったと述べた。また、有権者名簿などの保管体制は「十分に安全」だとした。

一方で、今後の選挙においてこのようなコードの使用を控えるよう勧告も行った。

items.title: Apple, Amazon face revived UK consumer lawsuit over product sales
items.author: Sam Tabahriti
items.creator: Sam Tabahriti
items.summary: Britain's Competition Appeal Tribunal allowed part of a revived consumer lawsuit against Apple and Amazon to proceed on Monday over claims they restricted competition.
items.body:
Britain's Competition Appeal Tribunal allowed part of a revived consumer lawsuit against Apple (AAPL.O) and Amazon (AMZN.O) to proceed on Monday over claims they restricted competition.
The lawsuit alleges Apple and Amazon agreed in 2018 to limit which sellers could offer Apple and Beats-branded products on Amazon's UK website, reducing competition and inflating prices.
The tribunal allowed claims relating to Apple products bought through Amazon's marketplace to proceed, but rejected one covering those bought directly from Apple and other retailers.
An Apple spokesperson said it "strongly" disagreed with the claims and its aim in reaching the agreement with Amazon was to tackle counterfeit products on the marketplace.
Amazon welcomed the tribunal's decision, adding that the remaining claim was "without merit".
"We're confident that this will become clear throughout the process," an Amazon spokesperson said.
The claimant said the part of the case which was allowed to proceed could be worth between £289 million ($383 million) and £306 million, including interest.
Judge Kelyn Bacon said claims relating to Amazon marketplace purchases were "plausible, credible and grounded in the facts", but rejected wider claims relating to other retailers because they rested on a "complex and speculative theory of harm".
The three-judge tribunal last year refused to allow a largely similar lawsuit brought by consumer law academic Christine Riefa to go ahead because of concerns about the proposed class representative and litigation funding.
The claim was later refiled by Justin Le Patourel, who replaced Riefa as the proposed representative of consumers.
A spokesperson for Le Patourel welcomed the ruling, but said it was disappointing that parts of the claim were not certified.
The tribunal ruled there was a realistic basis for arguing that restrictions on resellers could have led to higher prices for consumers buying Apple products through Amazon.
However, it said there was not enough evidence at this stage to support claims that the alleged conduct also increased prices for Apple products sold in Apple's stores or by other retailers.

items.title: 中国、AI人材の渡航制限を家族まで拡大－米国への技術流出防ぐ措置
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国は、民間企業のAI分野の主要人材に対する海外渡航制限を、その家族にも拡大した。重要なノウハウや情報の米国への流出を防ぐ措置をさらに強化した格好だ。

事情に詳しい関係者によると、政府機関は最近、著名なスタートアップ創業者のほか、AI関連分野で戦略的に重要な企業のトップら、対象者に制限の拡大について通知し始めた。国家安全保障上、極めて重要とみなされる業務に携わる一部のAI・半導体企業幹部については、配偶者や子どもなどの近親者も、短期間の海外旅行でも渡航前に中国政府の承認を得ることが必要になったという。

海外渡航を全面的に禁止するものではないが、今回の新たな制限により、すでに前例のない制約に直面しているテクノロジー業界が、さらに萎縮する可能性が高い。ブルームバーグ・ニュースは5月、中国が今年に入ってからアリババグループやDeepSeek（ディープシーク）など民間企業のAI分野の主要人材の海外渡航を制限していると報じていた。AIや半導体製造で大きな進歩を遂げる中、自国の技術を守ろうとする中国政府の強い姿勢の表れだ。

関係者によると、対象となる全ての人材の家族が新たな制限に従う必要があるのかどうかは明らかではない。中国はこれとは別に、刑事捜査や国内の産業・技術安全保障に違反する可能性があるケースに対し、出国禁止措置を執行できる規則を15日に施行した。

関係者によると、中国政府は今後、対象となる人材を順次リストに追加していく方針だ。

中国工業情報省は、ファクスで送付されたコメント要請に応じなかった。

中国政府は長く、有力大学の研究者や原子力科学者、国有企業の幹部といった主要人材に海外渡航制限を課しており、その家族も同様に対象となっている。中国政府は、優秀なAI・テック分野の技術者を同国にとっての戦略的資産と見なし、渡航制限の対象を民間人材まで広げている。

原題：China Broadens Travel Curbs to Encompass Family of Top AI Talent（抜粋）

items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 高市早苗首相は28日、政府の「インテリジェンス機能の強化に関する有識者会議」の初会合で、政府全体の情報活動の中長期的な推進方策を「国家情報戦略」としてまとめ、公表する考えを示した。

官邸で開催した同会議で高市首相は、日本でも外国の情報機関員が関わる先端技術の不正流出や、世論の誘導を目的とした偽情報拡散の脅威が高まっていると指摘。国民の安全を守るためには「情報力の強化が不可欠」と語った。

自民、日本維新の会の連立与党は高市政権発足時にまとめた連立政権合意書で、「インテリジェンス政策」を柱の一つに据えた。先の国会で国家情報会議設置法などが成立しているが、スパイ防止関連法制の制定や対外情報庁の創設などの課題がなお残っている。政府としては同会議の専門家による協議を踏まえ、戦略策定も含め、実現を図る方針だ。

木原稔官房長官は午前の記者会見で、同会議について国際情勢、経済安全保障、先端科学技術、サイバー、情報発信など、さまざまな分野の専門家による幅広い議論を期待していると述べた。関連施策については「有識者会議における多角的な議論を踏まえながら、着実に進めたい」と語った。

同会議は渡部俊也東大名誉教授やNTTの松原実穂子チーフ・サイバーセキュリティ・ストラテジストら17人で構成されている。

items.title: エヌビディアがＡＩエージェント安全対策ツール、脱出・暴走を阻止
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stephen Nellis

［サンフランシスコ　２８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Stephen Nellis

［サンフランシスコ　２８日　ロイター］ - 米エヌビディアは２８日、人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント向けの安全対策ソフトウエア群を公開した。これらのツールがあればＡＩ開発プラットフォームのハギング・フェイスへの不正侵入を防げたとしている。

ハギング・フェイスは、オープンＡＩの「暴走」エージェント群による攻撃を受けた。その数カ月後にエヌビディアが１３０億ドルで買収した。

エヌビディアが２８日公開したツールの一つ「ＯｐｅｎＳｈｅｌｌ（オープンシェル）」は、エヌビディア製の中央演算処理装置（ＣＰＵ）のハードウエア機能を使い、エージェントを隔離環境内にとどめる。同社はアーム・ホールディングスやインテルとも協力し、両社のＣＰＵでもこのシステムを動作させられるよう取り組んでいると説明した。

エヌビディアは、アンソロピックを含む数十社のパートナーと共にこれらのツールを展開する。

エヌビディアのエンタープライズコンピューティング担当バイスプレジデント兼ゼネラルマネジャー、ジャスティン・ボイタノ氏は、このツール群があれば今夏に公表されたハギング・フェイスへの攻撃を防げたと述べた。

ボイタノ氏は記者説明会で「われわれが把握している限り、最先端のＡＩ研究機関でモデル評価の初期段階からこの新たなセキュリティープラットフォームを使っていれば、不正侵入を防げた可能性がある」と説明。「われわれはオープンな形でこの取り組みを進めており、あらゆる関係者に協力を呼びかけたい」と述べた。

別のシステム「Ｓｅｎｔｒｙ（セントリー）」は、エヌビディア製の別の半導体をＯｐｅｎＳｈｅｌｌと組み合わせて使い、制御を外れたエージェントがＣＰＵ上のコンテナと呼ばれる隔離環境から脱出しようとすると、その動作を遮断する。

エヌビディアのＡＩソフトウエア担当シニアディレクター、アリ・ゴルシャン氏によると、これらのツールは数式を使い、エージェントが制限を回避しようとする動きを検知する。

ゴルシャン氏は説明会で「ここでわれわれが問題にしているのは、まさにエージェントとしての振る舞いだ。つまり、エージェントの集団と、それらがどのように連携して動作するかということだ」と述べた。

米ＡＩ開発大手のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックは現在、自社のエージェントが企業や政府のシステムに不正侵入した多数の事例を調査している。ＡＩブームの大部分を支える半導体を供給し、世界最大の企業となったエヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、ＡＩの安全性に関する広範な規制を求める声に反対しており、制御不能になったエージェントへの対応を、自動車の安全性向上と同様に、技術で解決すべき問題と位置付けている。

items.title: SOCAR matches Eni's fuel price cap, helping Italy tame costs
items.author: Giuseppe Fonte, Francesca Landini
items.creator: Giuseppe Fonte, Francesca Landini
items.summary: Azerbaijan's state oil company (SOCAR) will match a price cap on fuels sold in Italy adopted by Eni , sources said on Monday, helping Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's efforts to tame rising energy costs amid global supply disruptions.
items.body:
Azerbaijan's state oil company (SOCAR) will match a price cap on fuels sold in Italy adopted by Eni (ENI.MI) , sources said on Monday, helping Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's efforts to tame rising energy costs amid global supply disruptions.
Asking not to be named, people familiar with the matter told Reuters SOCAR was capping diesel prices at the pump at €2.19 ($2.49) per litre and petrol at €1.99 per litre. It was not immediately clear when the cap would be introduced.
Officials from Meloni's office said they were in contact with Kuwait's Q8, a third major player in the Italian fuels market. They said Q8 was sending "positive signals" about its willingness to also put a lid on pump prices.
Eni's cap became fully effective on Monday but has so far had little impact in lowering average fuel prices for motorists, according to industry minister data on Monday.
Self-service prices for petrol stood at €2.152 per litre on Monday from €2.159 on Sunday, while diesel prices also eased marginally to €2.369 from €2.377. Prices on motorway networks were €2.214 for petrol and €2.420 for diesel.
"Despite Eni's extensive distribution network, the impact on national averages was quite small," Italy's National Consumers Union said in a statement.
SOCAR, which sells fuel in Italy through its local unit Italiana Petroli (IP), said on Sunday it would [USN:L1N45J054 TEXT:""progressively""] implement a cap, without disclosing the new prices.
The sources said the company had begun to align with Eni at some of its service stations but the impact was not incorporated in the industry ministry's data issued early on Monday.
SOCAR and Eni control more than 40% of Italy's pump station network.
Rising energy and consumer prices due to the Middle East conflict has been a major headache for Meloni, who has tried for months to shield households and businesses while keeping Italy's strained finances in check.
Prior to Eni's decision, Meloni had repeatedly renewed temporary cuts in fuel excise duties in order to curb costs for motorists, at a total cost, including tax breaks for truck drivers, of around €2.8 billion in lost revenue.
The government's latest cut, which is set to expire on October 5, only covers diesel and was reduced on Saturday to around 6 cents per litre from 12 cents.
Eni shares were up by around 2.2% as of 1320 GMT as traders bet that profits arising from the energy crisis will more than offset costs associated with the price cap.
Broker Intermonte said the cap could persuade Rome to pull back from mooted plans to introduce a windfall tax on energy companies.
Amid the ongoing efforts to curb price rises, a government official told Reuters on Monday that Rome was considering easing regulations in requirements in order to help refiners boost their domestic production.
($1 = 0.8800 euros)

items.title: ＡＩ関連株取引、最近の調整経て再活況も＝ＪＰモルガン
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
[２８日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガンのアナリストらは２８日、最近のグローバルなＡＩ（人工知能）取引の調整により、投資家のポジション状況が改善され、バリュエーションも魅力的になったことから、特に半導体株で投資家の再参入が促される可能性があると述べた。

詳細は以下の通り。

• リポートで「テックは過去の成功水準には戻らないかもしれない。とはいえ、基調的なシナリオは前向きであり、ＡＩ関連セクター内には多くの投資機会が存在する」と指摘。

• ＡＩ分野における投資家のポジションが整理され、ほとんどの分野でバリュエーションが大幅に低下した一方、最近の減速懸念にもかかわらず、設備投資は引き続き堅調となる可能性が高いと指摘。

• 堅調な業績とマクロ面のボラティリティー低下を背景に、今後の良好なトレーディングが見込まれるという。

items.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi is scheduled to meet mediators in New York on Monday to discuss the latest proposals and developments in the situation between Tehran and Washington, ...
items.body:
Iranian FM Araghchi to meet mediators in NYC, days after Trump rejects Tehran's peace overture Iranian Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi is scheduled to meet mediators in New York on Monday to discuss the latest proposals and developments in the situation between Tehran and Washington, days after US President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal linked to the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz as the conflict in West Asia continues.
ANI | Updated: 28-09-2026 21:36 IST | Created: 28-09-2026 21:36 IST

Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Iranian Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi is scheduled to meet mediators in New York on Monday to discuss the latest proposals and developments in the situation between Tehran and Washington, days after US President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian proposal linked to the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz as the conflict in West Asia continues. According to an ISNA report, Araghchi, along with an Iranian delegation, will meet mediators on Monday morning to discuss the "latest proposals and views on the current situation".
No representative from the US side is expected to attend the meeting, as per ISNA. The meeting comes after a Qatari delegation travelled to the United States last week and presented an Iranian proposal to American officials regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for economic relief.
Last week, on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly, Araghchi outlined a seven-day proposal under which Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz if certain conditions were met by Washington. Iran said the proposal was conveyed through intermediaries and linked the reopening of the waterway to measures including an easing of US military pressure.
However, on Sunday, US Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz said Washington had rejected the proposal, claiming Tehran had sought sanctions relief and access to "billions in frozen assets" before negotiations on its nuclear programme. Waltz said the US would ultimately need to reach "some type of agreement" with Iran, but that US President Donald Trump would keep all "options on the table".
Araghchi disputed Waltz's account of the proposal, saying the US ambassador had not seen the plan. He also said Tehran remained ready for diplomacy while preparing for the possibility of renewed hostilities.
"We are fully prepared for the war to be resumed. We stand firm in the face of any new aggression, even if it comes to a doomsday war. We don’t care about U.S. midterm elections. We care about our national interests. At the same time, we stand ready for diplomacy. It is up to President Trump to choose," Araghchi said in an interview with NBC's "Meet the Press". The Strait of Hormuz has remained a central point of contention in the confrontation, with Iran saying it is prepared to reopen the waterway as part of an agreement, while the US has rejected Tehran's latest proposal.
Monday's meeting in New York is expected to focus on the latest proposals and positions being conveyed through mediators, with no direct US participation in the scheduled discussions. (ANI)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ミラノ　２８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ミラノ　２８日　ロイター］ - イタリア・シチリア島のカターニア空港の運営会社は、エトナ山から噴出する火山灰の影響で２８日も航空便の運航停止を継続すると発表した。運航停止は３日連続となる。

運営会社ＳＡＣの最新の通知によると、同空港では２８日２１５９ＧＭＴ（日本時間２９日午前６時５９分）まで全便の運航を停止する。同空港は旅客数でイタリア第５位。

ＳＡＣは利用客に対し、空港に向かう前に航空会社に運航状況を確認するよう呼びかけた。今後も最新情報を提供するという。

エトナ山は欧州で最も標高が高く、最も活動が活発な火山で、カターニア空港の航空便に頻繁に支障をもたらしている。この夏は火山灰の噴出が特に激しく、休暇シーズンの最盛期に数千人の旅行者が影響を受けた。

items.title: エヌビディア、AIの暴走防ぐ新システム発表－二重の安全機能
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米エヌビディアは、二重構造の新たなセキュリティーシステムを発表した。OpenAIのAIモデルが最近、オープンソースAIプラットフォームのハギングフェイスに侵入した問題もこのシステムで防げた可能性があるとしている。

半導体以外へ製品群を急速に広げているエヌビディアは、自社ハードウエア上で稼働するオープンソースのセキュリティーソフトウエア2本を投入する。AIエージェントがアクセスできる対象をリアルタイムで制御し、ルールに違反すれば動作を停止させる仕組みだ。

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（CEO）は、新たなAI規制の必要性には否定的な見方を示す一方、ソフトウエアについては徹底した安全性試験が必要だと主張している。

最先端のAI研究機関が早い段階からこの技術を使ってモデルを評価していれば、ハギングフェイスへの侵入を防げた可能性があると、エヌビディアのエンタープライズAI担当バイスプレジデント、ジャスティン・ボイタノ氏は28日の発表に先立つ記者説明で述べた。「われわれが把握している限り、この新たなセキュリティープラットフォームで侵入を防げた可能性がある」と説明した。

7月のハギングフェイスの事例を含め、自律型AIエージェントによる問題行動はAI業界を揺さぶり、開発ペースを落とすよう求める声につながっている。エヌビディアは新製品「オープン・エージェント・セーフティー・プラットフォーム」で、AI開発を抑制せずに侵入を防ぐ手段を提供する。フアン氏はこれまで、AIが人間の制御不能になるリスクはそれほど深刻ではないと繰り返し述べてきた。

ボイタノ氏は、OpenAIや競合のアンソロピックが新システムを訓練時の監視に利用する計画があるかについてコメントせず、両社に確認するよう促した。

フアン氏はここ数日、安全性を巡る問題について、規制強化や国際的な連携ではなく、エンジニアリングで対応すべき課題だとの見方を示している。AIが人類滅亡につながり得るとの一部AI開発者の主張には、トランプ米大統領と歩調を合わせて反論する一方、AIには厳格な安全性試験が必要だとも強調した。

items.title: 高市首相、外国人政策への取り組みアピール－来月の指針改定を前に
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 高市早苗首相は先週末、10月1日から外国人政策のガイドライン（指針）が改定されるのを前に、ソーシャルメディアを通じて政府の取り組みをアピールした。

高市首相は27日、自身のX（旧ツイッター）に、政府は在留外国人数の増加に伴って不安や不公平感を感じる国民がいることを認識していると投稿。その上で、外国人政策を秩序あるものとし、「国民と外国人の双方が安全・安心に生活していけるようにする」ため、幅広い施策に取り組んでいると記した。

一連の投稿では、在留資格の審査の厳格化や不法滞在者の取り締まり強化など、すでに実施されている措置についても触れた。

取り組みの成果を示すためとみられる投稿として、高市首相は今年上半期の「経営・管理」のカテゴリーでの在留資格認定件数が前年同期比90%減少したことに言及。また、同期間の送還全体の人数が同15%増加したことも明らかにした。

永住許可に関するガイドラインでは、申請者の世帯年収が、日本人世帯の平均年収を上回る水準を継続して維持することを原則として求めている。この他、一定水準の日本語能力を証明することや、日本の制度・ルールなどへの理解度も要件に含まれている。

8月に発表された東京大学の調査によれば、2026年の調査対象者の56.3%が外国人のさらなる受け入れに反対。24年の35.6%から大幅に増加した。外国人の受け入れに反対する人は、性別・世代を問わず増加しているが、特に若い世代でより顕著だという。

原題：Japan’s Takaichi Touts Sweeping Changes in Immigration Rules（抜粋）

items.title: スウェーデン社民党首、中道左派の組閣断念　左翼党の支持失う
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ストックホルム　２８日　ロイター］ - 今月１３日にスウェーデンで行われた総選挙で僅差で過半数を獲得した中道左派連合を率いる社会民主労働党のアンデション党首は２８日、組閣断念を表明した
items.body:
［ストックホルム　２８日　ロイター］ - 今月１３日にスウェーデンで行われた総選挙で僅差で過半数を獲得した中道左派連合を率いる社会民主労働党のアンデション党首は２８日、組閣断念を表明した 。連合の一角を占める左翼党が週末、対立する穏健党の議長候補を支持すると表明したことを受けて判断した。　

アンデション氏は会見で、左翼党の方針が自身の組閣に向けた取り組みを損なったとし、「これまでの協議を踏まえると、現時点で私が組閣することは不可能だと結論付けざるを得ない」と語った。

議会議長は今後、政権樹立に必要な支持確保に向けた交渉を誰に委ねるか判断する見通しで、クリステション首相に打診する可能性が高い。クリステション氏が率いる穏健党は、社会民主党に次ぐ第２党。

９月１３日の総選挙では、中道左派の野党連合が議席３４９のうち１７６議席を獲得し、中道右派の１７３議席を上回って僅差の過半数を得た。反移民を掲げる極右のスウェーデン民主党への支持低下が野党連合の過半数につながった。

左翼党はこれまで、首相としてはアンデション氏だけを支持するとしていた。中道右派による組閣の試みが失敗した場合、アンデション氏に改めて組閣の機会が与えられる可能性が高い。

議長は議会に対して最大４人の候補者を提示できるが、いずれも否決されればスウェーデンは再選挙を実施することになる。

２０１８年には組閣までに１３４日を要した。
